title: A Survey on LLM-Integrated Hardware Design Verification
title_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）集成硬件设计验证综述

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into hardware verification to automate specification interpretation, verification-artifact generation, debugging, formal reasoning, and tool orchestration. This survey provides a systematic review of LLM-assisted hardware functional verification across SystemVerilog assertion generation, stimulus and testbench generation, bug localization and design repair, model checking and equivalence checking, SAT/SMT optimization, and emerging agentic verification workflows. We organize the literature by methodology, verification objective, tool interaction, benchmark, and evaluation criterion, and examine both inference-time techniques—including prompting, retrieval, structured reasoning, and agentic workflows—and training-time adaptation. Across these areas, a common pattern emerges: LLMs are most effective as semantic reasoning, search, and orchestration components embedded within verification-aware workflows, while simulators, formal engines, coverage tools, and solvers provide executable feedback and correctness evidence. However, tool acceptance alone does not establish verification correctness, since assertions, tests, repairs, or proofs may satisfy available checks without faithfully capturing the complete design intent. We therefore identify semantic alignment between specifications and verification evidence, scalable integration with deterministic tools, generalization to unseen designs, and rigorous evaluation of correctness, cost, robustness, and human effort as key challenges. Finally, we discuss emerging directions toward specification-centered, neuro-symbolic, and persistent agentic verification systems that combine LLM flexibility with independently checkable verification evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地集成到硬件验证中，以实现规格解释、验证产物生成、调试、形式化推理和工具协调的自动化。 本综述系统梳理了 LLM 辅助的硬件功能验证方法，涵盖 SystemVerilog 断言生成、激励与测试平台生成、错误定位与设计修复、模型检查与等价性检查、SAT/SMT 优化，以及新兴的智能体式验证流程。 我们按方法论、验证目标、工具交互、基准和评估标准对文献进行了分类，并考察了推理阶段的多种技术——包括提示工程、检索、结构化推理和智能体式流程——以及训练阶段的适配方法。 在这些领域中出现了一个共同模式：LLM 在嵌入于验证感知型工作流程中的语义推理、搜索和协调组件方面效果最佳，而模拟器、形式化引擎、覆盖率工具和求解器则提供可执行的反馈与正确性证据。 然而，仅靠工具的接受度并不能确立验证的正确性，因为断言、测试、修复或证明可能通过现有检查，却无法忠实反映完整的设计意图。 因此，我们将规格与验证证据之间的语义对齐、与确定性工具的可扩展集成、对未见设计的泛化能力，以及对正确性、成本、鲁棒性和人力投入的严格评估，确定为关键挑战。 最后，我们探讨了面向以规格为中心、神经符号结合及持续智能体式验证系统的创新方向，这些系统旨在融合 LLM 的灵活性，同时提供可独立验证的正确性证据。

paragraphs.en: Computing systems have become indispensable to modern society, supporting a wide range of applications with increasingly stringent requirements for functionality, performance, reliability, safety, security, and energy efficiency. At the hardware level, System-on-Chip (SoC) designs have become a dominant architecture, with modern chips integrating tens to hundreds of billions of transistors and increasingly heterogeneous and tightly coupled functional blocks [ 1 , 2 ] . This growing hardware complexity, coupled with society’s increasing reliance on computing systems in safety-, security-, and mission-critical applications, makes ensuring hardware correctness and dependability increasingly challenging and essential. Consequently, rigorous hardware verification is a fundamental requirement for identifying design errors and establishing confidence that hardware implementations conform to their intended specifications before deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 计算系统已成为现代社会不可或缺的一部分，为各种应用提供支持，而这些应用对功能、性能、可靠性、安全性、保障性和能源效率的要求日益严苛。 在硬件层面，片上系统（SoC）设计已成为主流架构，现代芯片集成了数十亿至数百亿个晶体管，以及日益异构且紧密耦合的功能模块 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 这种不断增长的硬件复杂性，加上社会对计算系统在安全、保障和任务关键型应用中的依赖日益加深，使得确保硬件的正确性和可靠性变得愈发具有挑战性和必要性。 因此，严格的硬件验证是识别设计错误、并在部署前确认硬件实现符合预期规格的基本要求。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, hardware verification has become one of the most challenging, costly, and resource-intensive stages of the IC design process [ 3 ] , aiming to establish that hardware implementations conform to their functional requirements and design intent. While verification spans both pre-silicon verification and post-silicon validation, pre-silicon verification is particularly critical because defects that escape into fabrication can require costly silicon re-spins, cause substantial schedule delays, and incur significant financial losses [ 4 ] . Yet, growing hardware complexity has made pre-silicon verification increasingly difficult to scale. The 2024 Wilson Research Group Functional Verification Study [ 5 ] reports that peak IC/ASIC verification teams average over 14 engineers, compared with approximately 12 design engineers, while design engineers spend about 50% of their time on verification. Overall, verification is estimated to consume 60–70% of IC development cost and schedule [ 6 , 7 ] , highlighting the need for greater automation and productivity in modern hardware verification.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，硬件验证已成为集成电路设计流程中最具挑战性、成本最高且资源消耗最大的阶段之一 [ 3 ] ，其目标是确保硬件实现符合功能要求和设计意图。 虽然验证涵盖了硅前验证和硅后验证两个阶段，但硅前验证尤其关键，因为若缺陷未被发现而进入制造环节，可能导致昂贵的硅片重新流片、严重的进度延误以及巨大的经济损失 [ 4 ] 。 然而，硬件复杂性的持续增加使得硅前验证的扩展变得越来越困难。 2024 年威尔逊研究集团的功能验证研究报告 [ 5 ] 指出，集成电路/专用集成电路（ASIC）的验证团队平均拥有超过 14 名工程师，而设计工程师则约为 12 名；同时，设计工程师约有 50% 的时间用于验证工作。 总体而言，据估计，验证环节占集成电路开发成本和时间的 60–70% [ 6 , 7 ] ，这凸显了现代硬件验证对更高程度自动化和效率提升的迫切需求。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] are increasingly used across the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) stack because they can interpret and generate diverse hardware artifacts, including specifications, RTL, assertions, testbenches, and tool logs. Their flexible natural-language interface enables reasoning across heterogeneous information and interaction with EDA tools through retrieval-augmented and agentic workflows [ 11 , 12 ] . Consequently, LLMs have been explored for specification analysis [ 13 , 14 ] , RTL and hardware generation [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] , design-space exploration [ 19 ] , verification planning [ 20 ] , assertion and testbench generation [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] , bug localization and repair [ 26 , 27 ] , and autonomous verification [ 28 ] . Recent approaches increasingly integrate LLMs with simulators, formal verification engines, synthesis tools, and external knowledge to ground generation and enable iterative refinement [ 29 , 28 ] . Despite substantial progress, significant challenges remain in ensuring correctness, mitigating hallucinations, preserving design intent, scaling to industrial-scale designs, and establishing rigorous evaluation methodologies tailored to hardware engineering tasks motivating systematic research into trustworthy and autonomous LLM-integrate hardware verification.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）[ 8 , 9 , 10 ] 正越来越多地应用于电子设计自动化（EDA）的全流程中，因为它们能够解释和生成各种硬件产物，包括规格说明、RTL代码、断言、测试平台和工具日志。 其灵活的天然语言接口支持跨异构信息的推理，并能够通过检索增强和智能体式的工作流与EDA工具进行交互 [ 11 , 12 ] 。 因此，LLM已被探索用于规格分析 [ 13 , 14 ] 、RTL代码和硬件生成 [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] 、设计空间探索 [ 19 ] 、验证规划 [ 20 ] 、断言和测试平台生成 [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] 、错误定位与修复 [ 26 , 27 ] 以及自主验证 [ 28 ] 。 近期的方法越来越多地将LLM与模拟器、形式化验证引擎、综合工具及外部知识相集成，以生成结果的现实依据并支持迭代优化 [ 29 , 28 ] 。 尽管取得了显著进展，但在确保正确性、减少幻觉、保留设计意图、扩展至工业级设计规模以及建立针对硬件工程任务的严格评估方法方面，仍存在重大挑战；这些问题也推动了关于可信且自主的LLM集成硬件验证的系统性研究。

paragraphs.en: The rapid adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred a growing body of survey literature on their applications in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Existing surveys consistently identify LLMs as a transformative technology across the chip design flow, but they differ substantially from the scope of this survey. Pan et al. [ 11 ] provide a broad EDA-wide treatment spanning system-level design, RTL design, logic synthesis, physical design, and analog design, with verification appearing as one component of a much larger design-automation landscape. Xu et al. [ 12 ] similarly frame LLMs as a general technology across the chip flow, including specification optimization, HDL generation, testing, debugging, synthesis, and back-end task execution. Consequently, they relegate functional verification to brief sub-sections, missing technical nuances like Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) infrastructure composition. Yang et al. [ 30 ] narrow the focus to Verilog code generation, explicitly organizing the literature around models, datasets, metrics, generation techniques, and alignment, but their inclusion criteria exclude studies focused solely on repair or testing without generation. The recent Agentic EDA survey [ 28 ] targets autonomous orchestration of the RTL-to-GDSII flow and emphasizes perception–cognition–action loops, tool execution, and the sim-to-silicon gap rather than the detailed methodology of verification tasks. The work in [ 31 ] focuses primarily on vulnerability identification (e.g., Common Weakness Enumerations) and threat modeling. While they leverage testbenches and assertions, their core metric is security compliance rather than general functional coverage closure. A verification-specific survey by Liu et al. [ 32 ] is closest in spirit, but it is compact and organized as a high-level overview of assertion generation, testbench generation, debugging, and holistic verification frameworks. Consequently, these works do not provide comprehensive coverage of the rapidly expanding landscape of LLM-driven hardware functional verification, including emerging techniques for testbench generation, assertion generation, coverage closure, bug localization, debugging, design repair, verification agents, benchmark development, and evaluation methodologies. This gap has become increasingly pronounced as the field has grown rapidly since 2024, with dozens of verification-focused studies appearing in leading EDA venues.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的迅速采用推动了关于其在电子设计自动化（EDA）领域应用的综述文献的不断增长。现有的综述一致将 LLM 视为贯穿芯片设计流程的一项变革性技术，但它们在研究范围上与本文存在显著差异。Pan 等人 [11] 提供了一项覆盖整个 EDA 领域的广泛研究，内容涉及系统级设计、RTL 设计、逻辑综合、物理设计和模拟设计，其中验证只是更宏大的设计自动化图景中的一个组成部分。Xu 等人 [12] 同样将 LLM 定位为贯穿芯片设计流程的一项通用技术，包括规格优化、HDL 生成、测试、调试、综合以及后端任务执行。因此，他们将功能验证仅简要地置于子章节中，忽略了诸如通用验证方法学（UVM）基础设施构建等技术细节。Yang 等人 [30] 将焦点缩小到 Verilog 代码生成，明确围绕模型、数据集、指标、生成技术和对齐策略组织文献，但其纳入标准排除了仅关注修复或测试而未涉及生成的研究。近期的“智能体驱动 EDA”综述 [28] 聚焦于从 RTL 到 GDSII 流程的自主协调，并强调感知–认知–行动循环、工具执行以及仿真到实际芯片之间的鸿沟，而非验证任务的具体方法学。[31] 中的工作主要关注漏洞识别（例如，通用弱点枚举）和威胁建模。尽管他们利用了测试台和断言，但其核心指标是安全合规性，而非通用的功能覆盖度闭合。Liu 等人 [32] 进行的一项专门针对验证的综述在研究精神上最为接近本文，但该综述内容较为简略，且仅以高层概述的形式介绍了断言生成、测试台生成、调试和整体验证框架。因此，这些工作未能全面涵盖由 LLM 驱动硬件功能验证这一快速扩展的领域，包括测试台生成、断言生成、覆盖度闭合、错误定位、调试、设计修复、验证智能体、基准开发及评估方法等新兴技术。自 2024 年以来，随着该领域的迅速增长，这一差距变得愈发明显，已有数十项聚焦于验证的研究发表在顶尖的 EDA 会议和期刊上。

paragraphs.en: As a result, researchers and practitioners currently lack a unified and systematic understanding of how LLMs are being applied across the full verification workflow, the associated benchmark ecosystems, and the remaining technical challenges. Table I summarizes the structural coverage gaps of existing literature across the four pillars of the proposed survey paper.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，研究人员和实践者目前对大型语言模型在整个验证工作流程中的具体应用方式、相关的基准生态系统以及尚未解决的技术挑战，仍缺乏统一且系统的理解。 表 I 总结了现有文献在本文提出的调查框架所涵盖的四个核心领域中的结构性覆盖空白。

sents.en: As a result, researchers and practitioners currently lack a unified and systematic understanding of how LLMs are being applied across the full verification workflow, the associated benchmark ecosystems, and the remaining technical challenges.
sents.zh: 因此，研究人员和实践者目前对大型语言模型在整个验证工作流程中的具体应用方式、相关的基准生态系统以及尚未解决的技术挑战，仍缺乏统一且系统的理解。

sents.en: Table I summarizes the structural coverage gaps of existing literature across the four pillars of the proposed survey paper.
sents.zh: 表 I 总结了现有文献在本文提出的调查框架所涵盖的四个核心领域中的结构性覆盖空白。

paragraphs.en: This survey provides a comprehensive review of recent research on LLM-integrated hardware functional verification, a rapidly emerging research area with unique workflows, artifacts, evaluation criteria, and tool-integration requirements that are not adequately captured by broader LLM-for-EDA surveys. Unlike prior reviews that treat verification as a secondary component of the design flow, this survey systematically organizes the literature across the complete verification pipeline, including SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation, testbench and stimulus generation, bug localization, debugging, design repair, and autonomous verification agents. In addition, the survey provides a unified comparison of datasets, benchmarks, tools, and evaluation frameworks used throughout the field, identifies common limitations such as hallucination, tool orchestration, and scalability, and highlights emerging research directions including multimodal LLMs, agentic verification systems, and human-in-the-loop verification workflows. By treating hardware verification as an integrated feedback-driven process rather than a collection of isolated applications, this survey establishes a comprehensive reference for researchers and practitioners and provides a roadmap for advancing LLM-integrated verification from proof-of-concept demonstrations to dependable engineering practice.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述全面回顾了近期关于集成大型语言模型（LLM）的硬件功能验证的研究。这一领域迅速兴起，具有独特的流程、产出物、评估标准和工具集成要求，而这些内容在更广泛的“LLM用于电子设计自动化（EDA）”综述中并未得到充分涵盖。 与以往将验证视为设计流程次要环节的综述不同，本综述系统地整理了贯穿完整验证流程的文献，包括SystemVerilog断言（SVA）生成、测试台与激励生成、错误定位、调试、设计修复以及自主验证智能体。 此外，本综述对这一领域使用的数据集、基准测试、工具和评估框架进行了统一比较，指出了幻觉、工具协同和可扩展性等常见局限性，并强调了新兴的研究方向，包括多模态LLM、智能体驱动验证系统以及人在回路中的验证流程。 通过将硬件验证视为一个集成的反馈驱动过程，而非一系列孤立的应用，本综述为研究人员和实践者建立了一份全面的参考指南，并为推动集成LLM的验证从概念验证演示迈向可靠的工程实践提供了路线图。

paragraphs.en: A typical hardware design flow, illustrated in Fig. 1 , progresses through increasingly concrete representations from system requirements to fabricated silicon. System and architectural specifications define functional requirements, interfaces, and performance, power, and area (PPA) objectives, which are refined into microarchitecture and synthesizable RTL. The RTL is transformed through logic synthesis into a gate-level netlist and subsequently through physical design, including floorplanning, placement, clock-tree synthesis, and routing, followed by physical verification and signoff before tapeout and fabrication. Fabricated devices then undergo post-silicon validation for functionality, performance, and power.
paragraphs.zh: 典型的硬件设计流程（如图 1 所示）会逐步从系统需求过渡到具体的硅片实现。 系统和架构规范定义了功能需求、接口以及性能、功耗和面积（PPA）目标，这些目标随后被细化为微架构和可综合的 RTL。 RTL 经过逻辑综合转化为门级网表，接着通过物理设计流程（包括布局规划、布图、时钟树综合和布线），最后进行物理验证和签核，之后才能进行流片和制造。 制造出的器件随后会经历后硅片验证，以检查其功能、性能和功耗是否符合要求。

sents.en: A typical hardware design flow, illustrated in Fig. 1 , progresses through increasingly concrete representations from system requirements to fabricated silicon.
sents.zh: 典型的硬件设计流程（如图 1 所示）会逐步从系统需求过渡到具体的硅片实现。

sents.zh: RTL 经过逻辑综合转化为门级网表，接着通过物理设计流程（包括布局规划、布图、时钟树综合和布线），最后进行物理验证和签核，之后才能进行流片和制造。

sents.zh: 制造出的器件随后会经历后硅片验证，以检查其功能、性能和功耗是否符合要求。

paragraphs.en: Verification is a cross-cutting activity throughout this flow rather than an isolated design stage. At the RTL and gate levels, functional verification employs simulation, constrained-random testing, assertions, functional coverage, formal methods, and RTL-to-netlist equivalence checking. Physical implementation is validated through static timing analysis, design-rule checking (DRC), layout-versus-schematic (LVS) checking, and power- and signal-integrity analysis, followed by post-silicon validation. Because verification can expose design defects or specification violations at any stage, the flow is inherently iterative, with verification results potentially triggering revisions to earlier design stages. This survey focuses on functional (logic) verification at the RTL and gate levels.
paragraphs.zh: 验证是贯穿整个流程的一项跨领域活动，而非一个孤立的设计阶段。 在 RTL 和门级阶段，功能验证会采用仿真、约束随机测试、断言、功能覆盖、形式化方法以及 RTL 到网表的等价性检查。 物理实现通过静态时序分析、设计规则检查（DRC）、布局与原理图一致性检查（LVS）以及电源和信号完整性分析进行验证，随后再进行流片后验证。 由于验证可能在任何阶段暴露设计缺陷或规格违反问题，因此该流程本质上具有迭代性，验证结果可能会触发对早期设计阶段的修改。 本综述重点关注 RTL 和门级阶段的功能（逻辑）验证。

paragraphs.en: Hardware functional verification aims to establish that an implementation conforms to its intended functional and temporal behavior. It primarily combines simulation-based verification, formal methods, and hardware-assisted techniques. Simulation remains the dominant approach, exercising the design with directed or constrained-random stimuli and using coverage metrics to guide verification progress; methodologies such as the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) support reusable and modular verification environments [ 33 ] . Formal methods, including model checking and equivalence checking, mathematically establish specified properties or behavioral equivalence and can expose corner cases that are difficult to reach through simulation [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] . These techniques commonly rely on Boolean SAT [ 37 , 38 ] and Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers [ 39 , 40 ] , while emulation and FPGA-based prototyping accelerate the execution of large workloads that are impractical to explore through software simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件功能验证旨在确认实现符合其预期的功能和时序行为。 它主要结合基于模拟的验证、形式化方法和硬件辅助技术。 模拟仍然是主流方法，通过定向或约束随机刺激对设计进行测试，并利用覆盖率指标指导验证进展；诸如通用验证方法论（UVM）之类的框架支持可重用和模块化的验证环境 [ 33 ] 。 形式化方法，包括模型检查和等价性检查，能够数学上证明指定的属性或行为等价性，并能揭示通过模拟难以触及的边界情况 [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] 。 这些技术通常依赖布尔 SAT [ 37 , 38 ] 和可满足性模理论（SMT）求解器 [ 39 , 40 ] ，而仿真和基于 FPGA 的原型设计则能加速大型工作负载的执行，这些工作负载通过软件模拟进行探索是不切实际的。

sents.zh: 硬件功能验证旨在确认实现符合其预期的功能和时序行为。

sents.en: It primarily combines simulation-based verification, formal methods, and hardware-assisted techniques.

sents.zh: 这些技术通常依赖布尔 SAT [ 37 , 38 ] 和可满足性模理论（SMT）求解器 [ 39 , 40 ] ，而仿真和基于 FPGA 的原型设计则能加速大型工作负载的执行，这些工作负载通过软件模拟进行探索是不切实际的。

paragraphs.en: A typical functional-verification flow develops a testbench that generates stimulus, drives the design under test (DUT), monitors responses, and checks observed behavior against expected results. Verification engineers must also develop test scenarios, assertions, checkers, and coverage models, followed by iterative simulation, failure diagnosis, and regression testing. Coverage metrics help identify untested functionality and guide subsequent verification, but no single metric can establish verification completeness [ 33 ] . Moreover, verification remains difficult to scale because modern designs exhibit enormous input and state spaces, long temporal behaviors, and complex interactions among components and software. Simulation may fail to exercise difficult-to-reach behaviors, while formal methods face state-space explosion and scalability limitations [ 34 , 41 ] . Developing verification artifacts, diagnosing failures determining whether apparent coverage gaps represent genuine verification deficiencies also requires substantial hardware expertise and engineering effort. These challenges motivate increasing interest in automation, including LLM-based methods for generating verification artifacts, exploring design behavior, and assisting verification and debugging.
paragraphs.zh: 典型的函数验证流程会开发一个测试平台，该测试平台能够生成激励信号、驱动被测设计（DUT）、监控响应，并将观察到的行为与预期结果进行比对。 验证工程师还必须制定测试场景、断言、检查器和覆盖率模型，然后进行迭代仿真、故障诊断和回归测试。 覆盖率指标有助于识别未测试的功能并指导后续验证，但没有任何单一指标能够确定验证的完整性 [ 33 ] 。 此外，验证的扩展性仍然难以提升，因为现代设计具有巨大的输入和状态空间、长时间的行为过程，以及组件与软件之间的复杂交互。 仿真可能无法触发难以触及的行为，而形式化方法则面临状态空间爆炸和可扩展性限制的问题 [ 34 , 41 ] 。 开发验证工件、诊断故障，并判断表面上的覆盖率缺口是否代表真正的验证缺陷，也需要深厚的硬件专业知识和大量的工程投入。 这些挑战促使人们越来越关注自动化技术，包括利用大语言模型（LLM）生成验证工件、探索设计行为以及辅助验证和调试的方法。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are deep learning models trained on large-scale text and source-code corpora to learn general-purpose representations of language, programming constructs, and domain knowledge. Most modern LLMs are based on the Transformer architecture [ 42 ] , whose self-attention mechanism enables effective modeling of long-range dependencies and highly parallelized training. LLMs are typically developed through large-scale pre-training followed by post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning and preference- or feedback-based optimization, which adapts general capabilities toward instruction following and task-specific behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）是一种深度学习模型，通过在大规模文本和源代码语料库上进行训练，学习语言的通用表示、编程结构以及领域知识。 大多数现代大型语言模型都基于 Transformer 架构 [42]，其自注意力机制能够有效地建模长距离依赖关系，并支持高度并行化的训练。 大型语言模型通常通过大规模预训练，随后进行后训练（例如监督微调以及基于偏好或反馈的优化）来开发，从而将通用能力适配到指令遵循和特定任务行为中。

sents.en: LLMs are typically developed through large-scale pre-training followed by post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning and preference- or feedback-based optimization, which adapts general capabilities toward instruction following and task-specific behavior.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型通常通过大规模预训练，随后进行后训练（例如监督微调以及基于偏好或反馈的优化）来开发，从而将通用能力适配到指令遵循和特定任务行为中。

paragraphs.en: LLMs can be adapted to downstream tasks through prompting, including few-shot and reasoning-oriented strategies such as chain-of-thought prompting [ 43 ] . These capabilities are particularly relevant to hardware verification, where an LLM may need to interpret specifications, identify relationships among signals and modules, generate assertions or test scenarios, and reason about verification failures. However, LLM-generated reasoning and artifacts are not correctness guarantees, motivating the use of external knowledge and deterministic verification mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 通过提示，大语言模型可以适应下游任务，包括少样本和推理导向的策略，例如思维链提示 [43]。 这些能力与硬件验证尤其相关，因为在大语言模型可能需要解释规范、识别信号和模块之间的关系、生成断言或测试场景，并对验证失败进行推理。 然而，大语言模型生成的推理和产物并不能保证正确性，因此有必要借助外部知识和确定性验证机制。

sents.en: LLMs can be adapted to downstream tasks through prompting, including few-shot and reasoning-oriented strategies such as chain-of-thought prompting [ 43 ] .
sents.zh: 通过提示，大语言模型可以适应下游任务，包括少样本和推理导向的策略，例如思维链提示 [43]。

sents.en: These capabilities are particularly relevant to hardware verification, where an LLM may need to interpret specifications, identify relationships among signals and modules, generate assertions or test scenarios, and reason about verification failures.
sents.zh: 这些能力与硬件验证尤其相关，因为在大语言模型可能需要解释规范、识别信号和模块之间的关系、生成断言或测试场景，并对验证失败进行推理。

sents.en: However, LLM-generated reasoning and artifacts are not correctness guarantees, motivating the use of external knowledge and deterministic verification mechanisms.
sents.zh: 然而，大语言模型生成的推理和产物并不能保证正确性，因此有必要借助外部知识和确定性验证机制。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) [ 44 ] supplements model knowledge with task-specific information retrieved at inference time. For hardware verification, retrieved context may include specifications, RTL modules, interface descriptions, protocol documentation, assertions, verification plans, or debugging records. LLMs can also interact with external tools, using approaches such as ReAct [ 45 ] and Toolformer [ 46 ] , to invoke simulators, formal engines, compilers, coverage analyzers, or other EDA tools and use their outputs to refine subsequent actions. This tool-grounded interaction is particularly important for verification because deterministic tools can independently evaluate generated artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）[ 44 ]通过在推理时检索任务特定信息来补充模型知识。 在硬件验证中，检索到的上下文可能包括规格说明、RTL模块、接口描述、协议文档、断言、验证计划或调试记录。 LLM还可以与外部工具进行交互，采用ReAct [ 45 ]和Toolformer [ 46 ]等方法调用模拟器、形式化验证引擎、编译器、覆盖率分析器或其他EDA工具，并利用其输出结果优化后续操作。 这种基于工具的交互在验证中尤为重要，因为确定性工具能够独立评估生成的产物。

sents.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) [ 44 ] supplements model knowledge with task-specific information retrieved at inference time.
sents.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）[ 44 ]通过在推理时检索任务特定信息来补充模型知识。

sents.en: For hardware verification, retrieved context may include specifications, RTL modules, interface descriptions, protocol documentation, assertions, verification plans, or debugging records.

sents.zh: 这种基于工具的交互在验证中尤为重要，因为确定性工具能够独立评估生成的产物。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLM systems extend these capabilities by decomposing complex tasks into multiple steps, maintaining intermediate state, invoking tools, and iteratively refining results; multi-agent frameworks can further assign specialized roles such as planning, generation, verification, and debugging [ 47 ] . These workflows, however, must manage the limited context available to each model invocation. Large RTL hierarchies, specifications, testbenches, waveforms, and tool logs can exceed practical context limits, motivating long-context models, retrieval, summarization, and structured representations. Together, reasoning, retrieval, tool use, and agentic orchestration provide the foundation for applying LLMs to hardware verification, while deterministic verification tools remain essential for validating their outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型系统通过将复杂任务分解为多个步骤、维护中间状态、调用工具并迭代优化结果来扩展这些能力；多智能体框架还可以进一步分配规划、生成、验证和调试等专门角色 [ 47 ] 。 然而，这些工作流程必须管理每次模型调用所可用的有限上下文。 大型 RTL 层次结构、规范、测试台、波形和工具日志可能超出实际上下文限制，因此推动了长上下文模型、检索、摘要和结构化表示的发展。 推理、检索、工具使用和智能体式协调共同构成了将大语言模型应用于硬件验证的基础，而确定性验证工具对于验证其输出仍然至关重要。

paragraphs.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows is enabling increasingly autonomous and machine-augmented hardware design workflows. Early efforts such as VeriGen demonstrated domain adaptation by fine-tuning open-source models on Verilog corpora [1]. Subsequent approaches have explored natural-language-driven RTL generation and iterative refinement, with frameworks such as AutoChip incorporating compiler and simulation feedback into multi-turn generation loops to identify and correct syntactic and functional errors [2], while RTLCoder demonstrated the effectiveness of domain-specific training data and lightweight open-source models on benchmarks such as RTLLM and VerilogEval [3].
paragraphs.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）整合到电子设计自动化（EDA）流程中，正使得硬件设计流程日益具备自主性，并得到机器的增强。 早期的尝试，例如 VeriGen，通过在 Verilog 语料库上微调开源模型实现了领域自适应 [1]。 后续的方法探索了以自然语言驱动的 RTL 生成与迭代优化；例如 AutoChip 框架将编译器和仿真反馈纳入多轮生成循环中，以识别并纠正语法和功能性错误 [2]，而 RTLCoder 则证明了领域特定训练数据和轻量级开源模型在 RTLLM 和 VerilogEval 等基准测试中的有效性 [3]。

sents.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows is enabling increasingly autonomous and machine-augmented hardware design workflows.
sents.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）整合到电子设计自动化（EDA）流程中，正使得硬件设计流程日益具备自主性，并得到机器的增强。

sents.en: Early efforts such as VeriGen demonstrated domain adaptation by fine-tuning open-source models on Verilog corpora [1].
sents.zh: 早期的尝试，例如 VeriGen，通过在 Verilog 语料库上微调开源模型实现了领域自适应 [1]。

sents.en: Subsequent approaches have explored natural-language-driven RTL generation and iterative refinement, with frameworks such as AutoChip incorporating compiler and simulation feedback into multi-turn generation loops to identify and correct syntactic and functional errors [2], while RTLCoder demonstrated the effectiveness of domain-specific training data and lightweight open-source models on benchmarks such as RTLLM and VerilogEval [3].
sents.zh: 后续的方法探索了以自然语言驱动的 RTL 生成与迭代优化；例如 AutoChip 框架将编译器和仿真反馈纳入多轮生成循环中，以识别并纠正语法和功能性错误 [2]，而 RTLCoder 则证明了领域特定训练数据和轻量级开源模型在 RTLLM 和 VerilogEval 等基准测试中的有效性 [3]。

paragraphs.en: Hardware verification is another major application area. LLM-based approaches have been developed to automate verification collateral generation, including testbenches through frameworks such as AutoBench [4], and assertion generation from natural-language design specifications through systems such as AssertLLM [5]. These methods reduce the manual effort required to translate design intent into executable verification artifacts while retaining conventional simulation and formal-verification tools as the final validation mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件验证是另一个主要应用领域。 基于大语言模型的方法已被开发出来，用于自动化生成验证辅助材料，包括通过 AutoBench [4] 等框架生成测试平台，以及通过 AssertLLM [5] 等系统从自然语言设计规范中生成断言。 这些方法减少了将设计意图转化为可执行验证产物所需的人工投入，同时保留了传统仿真和形式化验证工具作为最终的验证机制。

sents.en: Hardware verification is another major application area.
sents.zh: 硬件验证是另一个主要应用领域。

sents.en: LLM-based approaches have been developed to automate verification collateral generation, including testbenches through frameworks such as AutoBench [4], and assertion generation from natural-language design specifications through systems such as AssertLLM [5].

paragraphs.en: Beyond RTL generation and verification, LLMs are being applied across the EDA optimization stack. At the HLS level, approaches such as C2HLSC and HLSPilot use LLMs to transform and optimize HLS code [6], [7]. At the physical-design level, agent-based frameworks such as ChatEDA employ LLMs to decompose design tasks, generate tool scripts, and orchestrate conventional EDA tools from RTL through physical implementation [8]. Collectively, these efforts exploit three capabilities of LLMs—cross-domain semantic mapping, pattern recognition, and automated reasoning—to bridge high-level design intent with executable artifacts, including HDL code, verification programs, and EDA scripts. Rather than replacing established EDA algorithms, LLMs increasingly serve as intelligent interfaces and assistants that automate repetitive tasks, guide design-space exploration, and enable engineers to focus on architecture, corner cases, and other tasks requiring domain expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 除了 RTL 生成与验证之外，LLM 正被应用于整个 EDA 优化流程。 在 HLS 层面，C2HLSC 和 HLSPilot 等方法利用 LLM 来转换和优化 HLS 代码 [6], [7]。 在物理设计层面，ChatEDA 等基于智能体的框架使用 LLM 分解设计任务、生成工具脚本，并协调从 RTL 到物理实现的常规 EDA 工具 [8]。 总体而言，这些工作利用了 LLM 的三项能力——跨域语义映射、模式识别和自动化推理——以连接高层设计意图与可执行产物，包括 HDL 代码、验证程序和 EDA 脚本。 LLM 并非取代成熟的 EDA 算法，而是越来越多地充当智能接口和助手，用于自动化重复性任务、指导设计空间探索，并帮助工程师专注于架构、边界情况以及其他需要领域专业知识的任务。

paragraphs.en: Assertion-Based Verification (ABV) expresses expected hardware behavior as executable properties that can be evaluated through simulation or formally proven against an implementation. SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) are the dominant assertion language, used in approximately 80% of projects employing ABV [ 5 ] . SVAs capture functional and temporal requirements, such as protocol rules, request–response relationships, ordering constraints, and reset behavior, thereby providing an explicit representation of design intent. They improve observability and debugging and enable formal exploration of behaviors that may be difficult to exercise through simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于断言的验证（ABV）将预期的硬件行为表示为可执行的属性，这些属性可以通过仿真进行评估，或针对具体实现进行形式化证明。 SystemVerilog 断言（SVAs）是主流的断言语言，在采用 ABV 的项目中约有 80% 使用了它 [5]。 SVAs 能够捕捉功能性和时序性要求，例如协议规则、请求-响应关系、顺序约束和复位行为，从而为设计意图提供明确的表示。 它们提升了可观察性和调试能力，并使得那些通过仿真难以触发的行为能够被形式化探索。

sents.en: Assertion-Based Verification (ABV) expresses expected hardware behavior as executable properties that can be evaluated through simulation or formally proven against an implementation.
sents.zh: 基于断言的验证（ABV）将预期的硬件行为表示为可执行的属性，这些属性可以通过仿真进行评估，或针对具体实现进行形式化证明。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advantages, developing high-quality SVAs remains knowledge-intensive and time-consuming. Verification engineers must interpret requirements distributed across natural-language specifications, tables, diagrams, and timing descriptions; identify the behaviors that require verification; map abstract concepts to implementation signals; and encode them using precise temporal semantics. Ambiguous or incomplete specifications further widen this semantic gap between high-level design intent and executable assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这些优势，开发高质量的 SVA 仍然需要大量专业知识且耗时较长。 验证工程师必须解读分布在自然语言规范、表格、图表和时序描述中的需求；确定需要验证的行为；将抽象概念映射到实现信号；并使用精确的时间语义对其进行编码。 模糊或不完整的规范会进一步加剧高层设计意图与可执行断言之间的语义鸿沟。

sents.en: Despite these advantages, developing high-quality SVAs remains knowledge-intensive and time-consuming.
sents.zh: 尽管存在这些优势，开发高质量的 SVA 仍然需要大量专业知识且耗时较长。

sents.en: Verification engineers must interpret requirements distributed across natural-language specifications, tables, diagrams, and timing descriptions; identify the behaviors that require verification; map abstract concepts to implementation signals; and encode them using precise temporal semantics.
sents.zh: 验证工程师必须解读分布在自然语言规范、表格、图表和时序描述中的需求；确定需要验证的行为；将抽象概念映射到实现信号；并使用精确的时间语义对其进行编码。

sents.en: Ambiguous or incomplete specifications further widen this semantic gap between high-level design intent and executable assertions.
sents.zh: 模糊或不完整的规范会进一步加剧高层设计意图与可执行断言之间的语义鸿沟。

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, automated SVA generation must address more than syntactic correctness. A useful assertion must be syntactically valid , semantically consistent with the intended requirement , and correctly aligned with implementation signals and cycle-level timing . These requirements are distinct: an assertion may compile successfully yet express the wrong behavior, while an assertion formally proven against RTL may still misrepresent the specification. Signal and timing alignment is particularly challenging because specifications often describe behavior abstractly, whereas SVAs must identify concrete signals, sampling events, delays, and temporal relationships. Beyond individual assertions, practical generation should produce an assertion set that provides adequate specification coverage while avoiding vacuous, redundant, or inconsistent properties.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，自动化的 SVA 生成必须解决的问题不仅限于句法正确性。 一个有用的断言必须具有句法有效性、与预期需求在语义上一致，并且与实现信号和周期级时序正确对齐。 这些要求各不相同：一个断言可能成功编译却表达了错误的行为，而一个经过形式化证明与 RTL 一致的断言仍可能未能准确反映规格说明。 信号与时序的对齐尤其具有挑战性，因为规格说明通常以抽象方式描述行为，而 SVA 必须识别具体的信号、采样事件、延迟和时序关系。 除了单个断言之外，实用的生成过程还应产生一个能够充分覆盖规格说明的断言集合，同时避免空泛、冗余或不一致的特性。

sents.en: Accordingly, automated SVA generation must address more than syntactic correctness.
sents.zh: 因此，自动化的 SVA 生成必须解决的问题不仅限于句法正确性。

sents.en: A useful assertion must be syntactically valid , semantically consistent with the intended requirement , and correctly aligned with implementation signals and cycle-level timing .
sents.zh: 一个有用的断言必须具有句法有效性、与预期需求在语义上一致，并且与实现信号和周期级时序正确对齐。

sents.en: These requirements are distinct: an assertion may compile successfully yet express the wrong behavior, while an assertion formally proven against RTL may still misrepresent the specification.
sents.zh: 这些要求各不相同：一个断言可能成功编译却表达了错误的行为，而一个经过形式化证明与 RTL 一致的断言仍可能未能准确反映规格说明。

sents.en: Signal and timing alignment is particularly challenging because specifications often describe behavior abstractly, whereas SVAs must identify concrete signals, sampling events, delays, and temporal relationships.
sents.zh: 信号与时序的对齐尤其具有挑战性，因为规格说明通常以抽象方式描述行为，而 SVA 必须识别具体的信号、采样事件、延迟和时序关系。

sents.en: Beyond individual assertions, practical generation should produce an assertion set that provides adequate specification coverage while avoiding vacuous, redundant, or inconsistent properties.
sents.zh: 除了单个断言之外，实用的生成过程还应产生一个能够充分覆盖规格说明的断言集合，同时避免空泛、冗余或不一致的特性。

paragraphs.en: Before LLMs, automated assertion generation primarily relied on templates, rules, static analysis, and mining of simulation traces. GoldMine [ 68 ] mines candidate invariants from simulation traces, maps them to predefined assertion templates, and applies formal verification to eliminate invalid candidates. A-Team [ 69 ] combines templates with data mining and coverage-guided heuristics, while HARM [ 70 ] uses user-provided propositions, templates, and metrics to generate temporal properties.
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）出现之前，自动化断言生成主要依赖模板、规则、静态分析和对模拟轨迹的挖掘。 GoldMine [ 68 ] 从模拟轨迹中挖掘候选不变量，将其映射到预定义的断言模板，并应用形式化验证以排除无效的候选项。 A-Team [ 69 ] 将模板与数据挖掘及覆盖率引导的启发式方法相结合，而 HARM [ 70 ] 则利用用户提供的命题、模板和指标来生成时态属性。

sents.en: Before LLMs, automated assertion generation primarily relied on templates, rules, static analysis, and mining of simulation traces.
sents.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）出现之前，自动化断言生成主要依赖模板、规则、静态分析和对模拟轨迹的挖掘。

sents.en: GoldMine [ 68 ] mines candidate invariants from simulation traces, maps them to predefined assertion templates, and applies formal verification to eliminate invalid candidates.
sents.zh: GoldMine [ 68 ] 从模拟轨迹中挖掘候选不变量，将其映射到预定义的断言模板，并应用形式化验证以排除无效的候选项。

sents.en: A-Team [ 69 ] combines templates with data mining and coverage-guided heuristics, while HARM [ 70 ] uses user-provided propositions, templates, and metrics to generate temporal properties.
sents.zh: A-Team [ 69 ] 将模板与数据挖掘及覆盖率引导的启发式方法相结合，而 HARM [ 70 ] 则利用用户提供的命题、模板和指标来生成时态属性。

paragraphs.en: These approaches provide predictable and structured generation, but their expressiveness is constrained by predefined templates, propositions, or observed execution behavior. Consequently, they can struggle with previously unseen property structures, complex temporal relationships, and requirements expressed only at the specification level. Trace-mining methods may also infer properties that happen to hold for the observed implementation rather than properties representing intended behavior. More fundamentally, conventional approaches have limited capability to interpret unstructured specifications and determine what properties should be verified , leaving a semantic gap between design requirements and generated assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法能够生成可预测且结构化的结果，但其表达能力受限于预定义的模板、命题或观察到的执行行为。 因此，它们可能难以处理此前未见的属性结构、复杂的时间关系以及仅在规格说明层面表达的需求。 轨迹挖掘方法也可能推断出那些恰好对已观察到的实现成立，而非代表预期行为的属性。 更根本的是，传统方法在解释非结构化规格说明和确定应验证哪些属性方面能力有限，从而在设计需求与生成的断言之间留下了语义鸿沟。

sents.zh: 这些方法能够生成可预测且结构化的结果，但其表达能力受限于预定义的模板、命题或观察到的执行行为。

paragraphs.en: LLMs offer a complementary capability by interpreting natural-language requirements, generating code, and reasoning across heterogeneous design information. They can potentially extract behavioral relationships from specifications, translate them into temporal properties, and, when RTL is available, map specification concepts to concrete signals and implementation structures. Retrieval and multimodal techniques can further incorporate information from large documents, tables, diagrams, and waveforms. These capabilities make LLMs particularly attractive for bridging the specification-to-assertion semantic gap.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 通过解释自然语言需求、生成代码以及跨异构设计信息进行推理，提供了互补的能力。 它们有可能从规范中提取行为关系，将其转化为时序属性，并在 RTL 可用时，将规范概念映射到具体的信号和实现结构。 检索和多模态技术还可以进一步整合来自大型文档、表格、图表和波形图的信息。 这些能力使得 LLM 在跨越从规范到断言的语义鸿沟方面尤其具有吸引力。

sents.en: LLMs offer a complementary capability by interpreting natural-language requirements, generating code, and reasoning across heterogeneous design information.
sents.zh: LLM 通过解释自然语言需求、生成代码以及跨异构设计信息进行推理，提供了互补的能力。

sents.en: They can potentially extract behavioral relationships from specifications, translate them into temporal properties, and, when RTL is available, map specification concepts to concrete signals and implementation structures.
sents.zh: 它们有可能从规范中提取行为关系，将其转化为时序属性，并在 RTL 可用时，将规范概念映射到具体的信号和实现结构。

sents.en: Retrieval and multimodal techniques can further incorporate information from large documents, tables, diagrams, and waveforms.
sents.zh: 检索和多模态技术还可以进一步整合来自大型文档、表格、图表和波形图的信息。

sents.en: These capabilities make LLMs particularly attractive for bridging the specification-to-assertion semantic gap.
sents.zh: 这些能力使得 LLM 在跨越从规范到断言的语义鸿沟方面尤其具有吸引力。

paragraphs.en: However, LLM generation is probabilistic and provides no correctness guarantee. Generated assertions may contain syntax errors, incorrect temporal relationships, erroneous signal mappings, or properties that appear plausible but do not reflect design intent. Recent approaches therefore increasingly combine LLM generation with structured design representations, retrieval, simulation, formal verification, coverage analysis, and iterative refinement. In such workflows, LLMs provide semantic interpretation and candidate generation, while deterministic verification tools provide feedback for validation and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，大语言模型的生成具有概率性，无法保证正确性。 生成的断言可能包含语法错误、不正确的时序关系、错误的信号映射，或者看似合理但并未反映设计意图的属性。 因此，近期的方法越来越多地将大语言模型生成与结构化设计表示、检索、模拟、形式化验证、覆盖分析和迭代优化相结合。 在此类工作流程中，大语言模型提供语义解释和候选生成，而确定性验证工具则提供反馈以进行验证和优化。

sents.en: However, LLM generation is probabilistic and provides no correctness guarantee.
sents.zh: 然而，大语言模型的生成具有概率性，无法保证正确性。

sents.en: Generated assertions may contain syntax errors, incorrect temporal relationships, erroneous signal mappings, or properties that appear plausible but do not reflect design intent.
sents.zh: 生成的断言可能包含语法错误、不正确的时序关系、错误的信号映射，或者看似合理但并未反映设计意图的属性。

sents.zh: 因此，近期的方法越来越多地将大语言模型生成与结构化设计表示、检索、模拟、形式化验证、覆盖分析和迭代优化相结合。

sents.en: In such workflows, LLMs provide semantic interpretation and candidate generation, while deterministic verification tools provide feedback for validation and refinement.
sents.zh: 在此类工作流程中，大语言模型提供语义解释和候选生成，而确定性验证工具则提供反馈以进行验证和优化。

paragraphs.en: A key distinction is whether assertions are generated before or after RTL becomes available. Pre-RTL approaches derive properties primarily from specifications and therefore preserve greater independence from implementation errors, but face difficulties in mapping abstract requirements to concrete signals and cycle-level timing. Post-RTL approaches use implementation information to improve signal and timing grounding and produce more readily executable assertions, but risk generating properties that reproduce erroneous RTL behavior rather than independently checking the specification. Thus, effective LLM-based SVA generation must balance specification fidelity with implementation grounding , using RTL to resolve implementation details without allowing it to override the verification intent established by the specification.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键区别在于，断言是在 RTL 可用之前生成，还是在 RTL 可用之后生成。 RTL 之前的方法主要从规范中推导出属性，因此能更好地保持对实现错误的独立性，但难以将抽象需求映射到具体的信号和时钟周期级时序。 RTL 之后的方法利用实现信息来增强信号和时序的落地性，并生成更易执行的断言，但也存在生成重复错误 RTL 行为而非独立验证规范的风险。 因此，有效的基于 LLM 的 SVA 生成必须在规范保真度与实现落地性之间取得平衡，利用 RTL 解决实现细节，同时避免其覆盖规范所确立的验证意图。

sents.en: A key distinction is whether assertions are generated before or after RTL becomes available.
sents.zh: 一个关键区别在于，断言是在 RTL 可用之前生成，还是在 RTL 可用之后生成。

sents.en: Pre-RTL approaches derive properties primarily from specifications and therefore preserve greater independence from implementation errors, but face difficulties in mapping abstract requirements to concrete signals and cycle-level timing.
sents.zh: RTL 之前的方法主要从规范中推导出属性，因此能更好地保持对实现错误的独立性，但难以将抽象需求映射到具体的信号和时钟周期级时序。

sents.zh: 因此，有效的基于 LLM 的 SVA 生成必须在规范保真度与实现落地性之间取得平衡，利用 RTL 解决实现细节，同时避免其覆盖规范所确立的验证意图。

paragraphs.en: Inference-time approaches generate SVAs using pretrained LLMs without modifying their model parameters. Compared with fine-tuning-based methods, they can readily incorporate new specifications, RTL designs, retrieved knowledge, and verification-tool feedback. Existing methods have evolved from direct natural-language translation toward structured, multimodal, tool-grounded, and agentic workflows that address different stages of the specification-to-SVA transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时方法利用预训练的 LLM 生成 SVA，而无需修改其模型参数。 与基于微调的方法相比，它们能够轻松融入新的规范、RTL 设计、检索到的知识以及验证工具的反馈。 现有方法已从直接的自然语言翻译，逐步发展为结构化、多模态、以工具为基础且具备智能体特性的工作流程，用于处理从规范到 SVA 转换的不同阶段。

sents.en: Inference-time approaches generate SVAs using pretrained LLMs without modifying their model parameters.
sents.zh: 推理时方法利用预训练的 LLM 生成 SVA，而无需修改其模型参数。

sents.en: Compared with fine-tuning-based methods, they can readily incorporate new specifications, RTL designs, retrieved knowledge, and verification-tool feedback.
sents.zh: 与基于微调的方法相比，它们能够轻松融入新的规范、RTL 设计、检索到的知识以及验证工具的反馈。

sents.en: Existing methods have evolved from direct natural-language translation toward structured, multimodal, tool-grounded, and agentic workflows that address different stages of the specification-to-SVA transformation.
sents.zh: 现有方法已从直接的自然语言翻译，逐步发展为结构化、多模态、以工具为基础且具备智能体特性的工作流程，用于处理从规范到 SVA 转换的不同阶段。

paragraphs.en: NL2SVA [ 48 ] is among the earliest LLM-based approaches and translates manually provided natural-language property descriptions into an intermediate representation containing signal information, partial translations, and candidate SVAs. Model checking is subsequently used to validate the assertions, with human intervention when refinement is required. Although this workflow demonstrates the feasibility of combining LLM generation with formal verification, it assumes that relevant requirements have already been extracted from the specification and therefore does not automate the more difficult task of identifying verification properties from complete design documents.
paragraphs.zh: NL2SVA [ 48 ] 是最早基于大型语言模型的方法之一，它将人工提供的自然语言属性描述转换为包含信号信息、部分翻译结果和候选 SVA 的中间表示。 随后使用模型检查来验证断言，在需要进一步精化时由人工介入。 尽管该工作流程展示了将大型语言模型生成与形式化验证相结合的可能性，但它假设相关需求已从规范中提取出来，因此并未实现从完整设计文档中识别验证属性这一更具挑战性的任务的自动化。

sents.en: NL2SVA [ 48 ] is among the earliest LLM-based approaches and translates manually provided natural-language property descriptions into an intermediate representation containing signal information, partial translations, and candidate SVAs.
sents.zh: NL2SVA [ 48 ] 是最早基于大型语言模型的方法之一，它将人工提供的自然语言属性描述转换为包含信号信息、部分翻译结果和候选 SVA 的中间表示。

sents.en: Model checking is subsequently used to validate the assertions, with human intervention when refinement is required.
sents.zh: 随后使用模型检查来验证断言，在需要进一步精化时由人工介入。

sents.en: Although this workflow demonstrates the feasibility of combining LLM generation with formal verification, it assumes that relevant requirements have already been extracted from the specification and therefore does not automate the more difficult task of identifying verification properties from complete design documents.
sents.zh: 尽管该工作流程展示了将大型语言模型生成与形式化验证相结合的可能性，但它假设相关需求已从规范中提取出来，因此并未实现从完整设计文档中识别验证属性这一更具挑战性的任务的自动化。

paragraphs.en: AssertLLM [ 23 ] extends this direction toward end-to-end generation from complete specifications. Rather than directly prompting an LLM with the entire document, it decomposes the task into specification analysis, signal mapping, and assertion generation, thereby producing structured intermediate descriptions before generating SVAs. It also incorporates assertion-related knowledge through retrieval and processes textual and waveform information. This decomposition reduces the reasoning burden of a single inference step and makes intermediate results more inspectable. However, because AssertLLM derives its design knowledge primarily from the specification, implementation details absent from the specification can remain unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: AssertLLM [ 23 ] 将这一方向延伸至基于完整规范的全流程生成。 与其直接用整个文档提示大型语言模型，它更倾向于将任务分解为规范分析、信号映射和断言生成，从而在生成 SVA 之前先产出结构化的中间描述。 它还通过检索整合与断言相关的知识，并处理文本和波形信息。 这种任务分解减轻了一次推理步骤的推理负担，并使中间结果更易于检查。 然而，由于 AssertLLM 的设计知识主要源自规范，因此规范中未包含的实现细节可能无法得到解决。

sents.en: AssertLLM [ 23 ] extends this direction toward end-to-end generation from complete specifications.
sents.zh: AssertLLM [ 23 ] 将这一方向延伸至基于完整规范的全流程生成。

sents.en: Rather than directly prompting an LLM with the entire document, it decomposes the task into specification analysis, signal mapping, and assertion generation, thereby producing structured intermediate descriptions before generating SVAs.
sents.zh: 与其直接用整个文档提示大型语言模型，它更倾向于将任务分解为规范分析、信号映射和断言生成，从而在生成 SVA 之前先产出结构化的中间描述。

sents.en: It also incorporates assertion-related knowledge through retrieval and processes textual and waveform information.
sents.zh: 它还通过检索整合与断言相关的知识，并处理文本和波形信息。

sents.en: This decomposition reduces the reasoning burden of a single inference step and makes intermediate results more inspectable.
sents.zh: 这种任务分解减轻了一次推理步骤的推理负担，并使中间结果更易于检查。

sents.en: However, because AssertLLM derives its design knowledge primarily from the specification, implementation details absent from the specification can remain unresolved.
sents.zh: 然而，由于 AssertLLM 的设计知识主要源自规范，因此规范中未包含的实现细节可能无法得到解决。

paragraphs.en: AssertionForge [ 25 ] addresses this limitation by jointly grounding generation in the specification and RTL. It constructs a hardware-specific knowledge graph (KG) from specification concepts and fuses it with RTL entities and relationships, followed by multi-resolution context extraction for SVA generation. Compared with the primarily specification-centered decomposition of AssertLLM, this representation explicitly connects high-level requirements with implementation-level signals and dependencies, improving the context available for assertion generation. The tradeoff is increased preprocessing complexity and greater dependence on the RTL: errors in KG construction or an incorrect implementation can propagate into generated properties, potentially weakening their independence as specification-level checks.
paragraphs.zh: AssertionForge [ 25 ] 通过将生成过程同时基于规格说明和 RTL 进行落地，解决了这一局限性。 它从规格说明概念中构建一个针对硬件的特定知识图谱（KG），并将其与 RTL 实体和关系融合，随后通过多分辨率上下文提取来生成 SVA。 与 AssertLLM 主要基于规格说明的分解方法相比，这种表示方式明确地将高层需求与实现层的信号和依赖关系连接起来，从而提升了断言生成时可用的上下文信息。 其权衡在于预处理复杂度的增加以及对 RTL 的更强依赖：KG 构建中的错误或实现错误可能会传播到生成的属性中，进而可能削弱这些属性作为规格说明层检查的独立性。

sents.en: AssertionForge [ 25 ] addresses this limitation by jointly grounding generation in the specification and RTL.
sents.zh: AssertionForge [ 25 ] 通过将生成过程同时基于规格说明和 RTL 进行落地，解决了这一局限性。

sents.zh: 其权衡在于预处理复杂度的增加以及对 RTL 的更强依赖：KG 构建中的错误或实现错误可能会传播到生成的属性中，进而可能削弱这些属性作为规格说明层检查的独立性。

paragraphs.en: AutoSVA2 [ 49 ] similarly introduces intermediate rules to constrain SVA generation. Collectively, these approaches show that intermediate representations—including structured descriptions, rules, and knowledge graphs—are useful for decomposing the large semantic jump from heterogeneous specifications to temporal logic. However, additional representations also create new points at which information can be omitted or incorrectly transformed.
paragraphs.zh: AutoSVA2 [ 49 ] 同样引入了中间规则来约束 SVA 的生成。 总体而言，这些方法表明，中间表示——包括结构化描述、规则和知识图谱——对于分解从异构规范到时态逻辑之间的巨大语义跳跃是有益的。 然而，额外的表示也会产生新的信息可能被遗漏或错误转换的环节。

sents.en: AutoSVA2 [ 49 ] similarly introduces intermediate rules to constrain SVA generation.
sents.zh: AutoSVA2 [ 49 ] 同样引入了中间规则来约束 SVA 的生成。

sents.en: Collectively, these approaches show that intermediate representations—including structured descriptions, rules, and knowledge graphs—are useful for decomposing the large semantic jump from heterogeneous specifications to temporal logic.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这些方法表明，中间表示——包括结构化描述、规则和知识图谱——对于分解从异构规范到时态逻辑之间的巨大语义跳跃是有益的。

sents.en: However, additional representations also create new points at which information can be omitted or incorrectly transformed.
sents.zh: 然而，额外的表示也会产生新的信息可能被遗漏或错误转换的环节。

paragraphs.en: Hardware specifications frequently encode critical behavior in tables, timing diagrams, waveforms, equations, and figures rather than text alone. AssertLLM [ 23 ] incorporates waveform information, while AssertCoder [ 52 ] more explicitly decomposes multimodal specification processing by converting diagrams, waveforms, tables, and formulas into structured representations such as pseudocode, formal expressions, L a T e X , or JSON before assertion generation. SANGAM [ 24 ] likewise employs specialized Spec Analyzer, Signal Mapper, and Waveform Analyzer components to extract complementary information from specifications. These approaches reduce dependence on textual descriptions and can recover timing or structural information unavailable in prose. Their effectiveness, however, depends on the accuracy of multimodal interpretation; an incorrectly interpreted waveform or table can introduce semantic errors before SVA generation begins.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件规格通常将关键行为编码在表格、时序图、波形图、方程和图表中，而不仅仅是文本本身。 AssertLLM [ 23 ] 整合了波形信息，而 AssertCoder [ 52 ] 则更明确地分解了多模态规格的处理流程：在生成断言之前，它将图表、波形、表格和公式转换为伪代码、形式化表达式、L a T e X 或 JSON 等结构化表示。 SANGAM [ 24 ] 同样使用了专门的规格分析器、信号映射器和波形分析器组件，从规格中提取互补信息。 这些方法减少了对文本描述的依赖，并能够恢复纯文本中无法获取的时序或结构信息。 然而，它们的有效性取决于多模态解读的准确性；如果波形或表格被错误解读，在 SVA 生成开始之前就可能引入语义错误。

sents.en: Hardware specifications frequently encode critical behavior in tables, timing diagrams, waveforms, equations, and figures rather than text alone.
sents.zh: 硬件规格通常将关键行为编码在表格、时序图、波形图、方程和图表中，而不仅仅是文本本身。

sents.en: AssertLLM [ 23 ] incorporates waveform information, while AssertCoder [ 52 ] more explicitly decomposes multimodal specification processing by converting diagrams, waveforms, tables, and formulas into structured representations such as pseudocode, formal expressions, L a T e X , or JSON before assertion generation.

sents.en: SANGAM [ 24 ] likewise employs specialized Spec Analyzer, Signal Mapper, and Waveform Analyzer components to extract complementary information from specifications.
sents.zh: SANGAM [ 24 ] 同样使用了专门的规格分析器、信号映射器和波形分析器组件，从规格中提取互补信息。

sents.en: These approaches reduce dependence on textual descriptions and can recover timing or structural information unavailable in prose.
sents.zh: 这些方法减少了对文本描述的依赖，并能够恢复纯文本中无法获取的时序或结构信息。

sents.en: Their effectiveness, however, depends on the accuracy of multimodal interpretation; an incorrectly interpreted waveform or table can introduce semantic errors before SVA generation begins.
sents.zh: 然而，它们的有效性取决于多模态解读的准确性；如果波形或表格被错误解读，在 SVA 生成开始之前就可能引入语义错误。

paragraphs.en: Explicit reasoning provides another mechanism for bridging specifications and temporal properties. Spec2Assertion [ 53 ] applies Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and progressive regularization in the pre-RTL setting, encouraging the model to reason about antecedents, consequents, temporal relationships, and cycle dependencies before constructing an SVA. AssertCoder [ 52 ] extends multi-step reasoning to structured multimodal inputs, whereas AssertGen [ 54 ] first extracts verification objectives from the specification and subsequently maps them to RTL signals. The latter approaches therefore combine explicit reasoning with implementation grounding, addressing a major limitation of purely pre-RTL reasoning. Nevertheless, a plausible reasoning trace is not evidence of semantic correctness: incorrect timing assumptions or incomplete interpretation of the requirement can still produce well-formed but incorrect assertions.
paragraphs.zh: 显式推理为连接规范与时间属性提供了另一种机制。 Spec2Assertion [ 53 ] 在预 RTL 阶段应用了思维链（CoT）提示和渐进式正则化，鼓励模型在构建 SVA 之前对前件、后件、时间关系和循环依赖进行推理。 AssertCoder [ 52 ] 将多步推理扩展到了结构化的多模态输入，而 AssertGen [ 54 ] 则首先从规范中提取验证目标，随后将其映射到 RTL 信号。 因此，后两种方法将显式推理与实现基础相结合，解决了纯粹预 RTL 推理的一个主要局限性。 然而，一个看似合理的推理过程并不能证明语义正确性：错误的时序假设或对需求的不完整解读仍可能生成结构正确但内容错误的断言。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) provides external knowledge without modifying the LLM. AssertLLM [ 23 ] , for example, retrieves SVA-related verification knowledge to improve generation, whereas AssertionForge [ 25 ] uses graph-based retrieval over design-specific relationships. The distinction is important: general verification knowledge primarily helps the model understand how to express assertions, while design-specific retrieval helps determine what behavior should be expressed . The latter is therefore more directly relevant to specification-to-RTL semantic alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）无需修改大型语言模型（LLM），即可提供外部知识。 例如，AssertLLM [ 23 ] 会检索与 SVA 相关的验证知识以改进生成效果，而 AssertionForge [ 25 ] 则通过基于图的结构检索设计特定的关系。 这种区别很重要：通用验证知识主要帮助模型理解如何表达断言，而设计特定的检索则有助于确定应表达何种行为。 因此，后者与从规范到 RTL 的语义对齐更为直接相关。

sents.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) provides external knowledge without modifying the LLM.
sents.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）无需修改大型语言模型（LLM），即可提供外部知识。

paragraphs.en: Most recent frameworks further couple generation with iterative feedback. NL2SVA [ 48 ] introduced model-checking feedback with human-guided refinement, while general self-refinement methods such as Self-Refine [ 71 ] demonstrated that LLMs can critique and revise their own outputs. ChIRAAG [ 50 ] applies verification-tool feedback to SVA correction by interpreting errors and regenerating failed assertions. Such feedback is particularly effective for syntax and tool-detectable errors because compilers and formal engines provide objective diagnostics. Its ability to correct semantic errors is more limited: a property that successfully compiles or is proven against the RTL may still encode the wrong requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 最新的框架进一步将生成与迭代反馈相结合。 NL2SVA [ 48 ] 引入了模型检查反馈与人类引导的优化，而像 Self-Refine [ 71 ] 这样的通用自我优化方法则表明，大型语言模型能够批判并修改自身的输出。 ChIRAAG [ 50 ] 通过解释错误并重新生成失败的断言，将验证工具的反馈应用于 SVA 的修正。 这类反馈对语法错误和工具可检测的错误尤其有效，因为编译器和形式化引擎能够提供客观的诊断信息。 它在纠正语义错误方面的能力则更为有限：一个成功通过编译或在 RTL 上被证明正确的属性，可能仍然编码了错误的要求。

sents.en: Most recent frameworks further couple generation with iterative feedback.
sents.zh: 最新的框架进一步将生成与迭代反馈相结合。

paragraphs.en: SANGAM [ 24 ] extends linear self-refinement into candidate search through Monte Carlo Tree Self-Refine (MCTSr). After multimodal specification processing, it explores multiple reasoning trajectories for individual signals and uses the resulting traces to generate assertions. Compared with one-shot or linear refinement, this approach reduces dependence on a single stochastic generation and can explore alternatives involving different signal dependencies or temporal relationships. However, its effectiveness depends critically on the reward or selection criterion; optimizing primarily for formal-tool success can favor assertions that are provable but weak, vacuous, or semantically misaligned. SANGAM therefore represents a shift from simply repairing a generated assertion toward searching the space of candidate interpretations.
paragraphs.zh: SANGAM [ 24 ] 通过蒙特卡洛树自我精炼（MCTSr）将线性自我精炼扩展至候选搜索。 在多模态规格处理之后，它会为单个信号探索多种推理路径，并利用由此产生的轨迹生成断言。 与一次性或线性精炼方法相比，这种方法减少了对单次随机生成的依赖，并能够探索涉及不同信号依赖关系或时间关系的替代方案。 然而，其有效性在很大程度上取决于奖励或选择标准；若主要针对形式化工具的成功进行优化，则可能倾向于生成可被证明但较弱、空洞或在语义上不一致的断言。 因此，SANGAM 代表了一种从单纯修复已生成的断言转向搜索候选解释空间的方法转变。

sents.zh: SANGAM [ 24 ] 通过蒙特卡洛树自我精炼（MCTSr）将线性自我精炼扩展至候选搜索。

paragraphs.en: AssertCoder [ 52 ] and AssertGen [ 54 ] further incorporate mutation testing to evaluate whether generated assertions detect injected RTL faults. This provides stronger evidence of verification usefulness than syntax or proof success alone because it evaluates fault-detection capability. Nevertheless, mutation score remains dependent on the representativeness of the injected faults and does not by itself establish that an assertion faithfully represents the specification.
paragraphs.zh: AssertCoder [ 52 ] 和 AssertGen [ 54 ] 进一步引入了变异测试，以评估生成的断言能否检测出注入的 RTL 故障。 与仅依赖语法或证明成功相比，这种方法为验证的有效性提供了更有力的证据，因为它直接评估了故障检测能力。 然而，变异分数仍然取决于所注入故障的代表性，它本身并不能证明某个断言能够忠实地反映规格说明。

sents.en: AssertCoder [ 52 ] and AssertGen [ 54 ] further incorporate mutation testing to evaluate whether generated assertions detect injected RTL faults.
sents.zh: AssertCoder [ 52 ] 和 AssertGen [ 54 ] 进一步引入了变异测试，以评估生成的断言能否检测出注入的 RTL 故障。

paragraphs.en: The progression from task decomposition and iterative refinement naturally leads to agentic workflows, in which specialized components coordinate specification analysis, retrieval, assertion generation, tool execution, and repair. AssertLLM [ 23 ] and SANGAM [ 24 ] already exhibit elements of role-based decomposition, although their primary contributions are structured generation and search rather than autonomous tool orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 从任务分解和迭代优化到智能体工作流的演进是顺理成章的，在这一流程中，专门化的组件会协同完成规范分析、信息检索、断言生成、工具执行和修复。 AssertLLM [ 23 ] 和 SANGAM [ 24 ] 已经展现出基于角色的分解要素，尽管它们的主要贡献在于结构化生成与搜索，而非自主的工具协调。

sents.en: The progression from task decomposition and iterative refinement naturally leads to agentic workflows, in which specialized components coordinate specification analysis, retrieval, assertion generation, tool execution, and repair.
sents.zh: 从任务分解和迭代优化到智能体工作流的演进是顺理成章的，在这一流程中，专门化的组件会协同完成规范分析、信息检索、断言生成、工具执行和修复。

sents.en: AssertLLM [ 23 ] and SANGAM [ 24 ] already exhibit elements of role-based decomposition, although their primary contributions are structured generation and search rather than autonomous tool orchestration.
sents.zh: AssertLLM [ 23 ] 和 SANGAM [ 24 ] 已经展现出基于角色的分解要素，尽管它们的主要贡献在于结构化生成与搜索，而非自主的工具协调。

paragraphs.en: More explicit agentic approaches extend this decomposition. ChatSVA [ 55 ] formulates SVA generation as an end-to-end multi-agent workflow with specialized stages for specification processing, functional-checkpoint extraction, and assertion generation, while its AgentBridge infrastructure supports construction of task-specific data. SuperSAGA [ 56 ] uses a supervisor–subordinate architecture combining RAG, human-reviewed verification plans, formal-tool feedback, and iterative assertion refinement. SVAgent [ 57 ] applies agentic decomposition specifically to hardware-security verification by breaking complex security requirements into finer-grained verification tasks before SVA generation.
paragraphs.zh: 更明确的智能体方法扩展了这种分解。 ChatSVA [ 55 ] 将 SVA 生成构建为一个端到端的多智能体工作流程，其中包含专门用于规范处理、功能检查点提取和断言生成的阶段，同时其 AgentBridge 基础设施支持构建任务特定的数据。 SuperSAGA [ 56 ] 采用一种主管-下属架构，结合了 RAG、人工审核的验证计划、形式化工具反馈以及迭代断言优化。 SVAgent [ 57 ] 将智能体分解专门应用于硬件安全验证，通过先将复杂的安全需求分解为更细粒度的验证任务，然后再进行 SVA 生成。

sents.en: More explicit agentic approaches extend this decomposition.
sents.zh: 更明确的智能体方法扩展了这种分解。

sents.zh: SVAgent [ 57 ] 将智能体分解专门应用于硬件安全验证，通过先将复杂的安全需求分解为更细粒度的验证任务，然后再进行 SVA 生成。

paragraphs.en: This direction also overlaps increasingly with broader agentic formal-verification systems. Saarthi [ 58 ] , ProofLoop [ 59 ] , and KG-based agentic formal-verification frameworks [ 60 ] coordinate assertion generation with mechanisms such as verification rulebooks, knowledge-graph retrieval, formal-tool queries, counterexample-guided refinement, and coverage feedback. These systems expand the role of the LLM from an assertion generator to an orchestrator of the verification process. However, greater autonomy also increases pipeline complexity, inference and tool-execution cost, and opportunities for error propagation. Consequently, agentic decomposition is most useful when intermediate artifacts such as extracted requirements, signal mappings, verification plans, and candidate assertions can themselves be independently validated rather than trusting only the final output.
paragraphs.zh: 这一方向也与更广泛的智能体形式化验证系统日益重叠。 Saarthi [ 58 ]、ProofLoop [ 59 ] 以及基于知识图谱的智能体形式化验证框架 [ 60 ]，将断言生成与验证规则书、知识图谱检索、形式化工具查询、反例引导的优化和覆盖反馈等机制相协调。 这些系统将大型语言模型的角色从断言生成器扩展为验证过程的协调者。 然而，更强的自主性也会增加流程的复杂性、推理和工具执行成本，以及错误传播的可能性。 因此，当中间产物（如提取的需求、信号映射、验证计划和候选断言）本身能够被独立验证，而不仅仅是依赖最终输出时，智能体分解最为有效。

sents.en: This direction also overlaps increasingly with broader agentic formal-verification systems.
sents.zh: 这一方向也与更广泛的智能体形式化验证系统日益重叠。

sents.en: Consequently, agentic decomposition is most useful when intermediate artifacts such as extracted requirements, signal mappings, verification plans, and candidate assertions can themselves be independently validated rather than trusting only the final output.
sents.zh: 因此，当中间产物（如提取的需求、信号映射、验证计划和候选断言）本身能够被独立验证，而不仅仅是依赖最终输出时，智能体分解最为有效。

paragraphs.en: Overall, inference-time SVA generation has evolved along several complementary dimensions. Early methods such as NL2SVA focus on translating explicitly provided requirements, whereas AssertLLM expands generation to complete specifications through task decomposition. AssertionForge and AssertGen strengthen specification-to-RTL grounding; AssertCoder and SANGAM incorporate multimodal information; Spec2Assertion emphasizes explicit reasoning; SANGAM further introduces search over alternative reasoning trajectories; and recent agentic frameworks coordinate these capabilities with external verification tools. Thus, the field is moving from direct NL-to-SVA translation toward specification understanding, design grounding, candidate generation, verification, and iterative refinement .
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，推理阶段的 SVA 生成已在几个相互补充的维度上不断发展。 早期方法（如 NL2SVA）专注于翻译明确提供的要求，而 AssertLLM 则通过任务分解将生成过程扩展到完整的规范。 AssertionForge 和 AssertGen 强化了从规范到 RTL 的落地能力；AssertCoder 和 SANGAM 整合了多模态信息；Spec2Assertion 强调显式推理；SANGAM 进一步引入了对替代推理路径的搜索；而近期的智能体框架则将这些能力与外部验证工具协同起来。 因此，该领域正从直接的 NL-to-SVA 翻译，逐步转向规范理解、设计落地、候选生成、验证和迭代优化。

sents.en: Overall, inference-time SVA generation has evolved along several complementary dimensions.
sents.zh: 总体而言，推理阶段的 SVA 生成已在几个相互补充的维度上不断发展。

sents.en: Early methods such as NL2SVA focus on translating explicitly provided requirements, whereas AssertLLM expands generation to complete specifications through task decomposition.
sents.zh: 早期方法（如 NL2SVA）专注于翻译明确提供的要求，而 AssertLLM 则通过任务分解将生成过程扩展到完整的规范。

sents.en: AssertionForge and AssertGen strengthen specification-to-RTL grounding; AssertCoder and SANGAM incorporate multimodal information; Spec2Assertion emphasizes explicit reasoning; SANGAM further introduces search over alternative reasoning trajectories; and recent agentic frameworks coordinate these capabilities with external verification tools.
sents.zh: AssertionForge 和 AssertGen 强化了从规范到 RTL 的落地能力；AssertCoder 和 SANGAM 整合了多模态信息；Spec2Assertion 强调显式推理；SANGAM 进一步引入了对替代推理路径的搜索；而近期的智能体框架则将这些能力与外部验证工具协同起来。

sents.en: Thus, the field is moving from direct NL-to-SVA translation toward specification understanding, design grounding, candidate generation, verification, and iterative refinement .
sents.zh: 因此，该领域正从直接的 NL-to-SVA 翻译，逐步转向规范理解、设计落地、候选生成、验证和迭代优化。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progression, three limitations remain common. First, stronger RTL grounding improves signal mapping and executability but can compromise independence from implementation errors, whereas specification-only methods preserve verification intent but struggle with implementation-level details. Second, tool feedback provides reliable evidence for syntax, satisfiability, and behavior relative to the RTL, but does not by itself establish semantic agreement with the specification. Third, increasingly elaborate reasoning, search, and multi-agent pipelines improve robustness at the expense of latency, tool calls, computational cost, and additional opportunities for intermediate errors. Future inference-time methods therefore need to combine specification fidelity and implementation grounding while independently validating intermediate representations and evaluating generated assertion sets using complementary measures of semantic correctness, coverage, non-vacuity, and realistic fault-detection capability.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但仍有三个局限性普遍存在。 首先，更强的 RTL 基础能够提升信号映射和可执行性，但可能削弱对实现错误的独立性；而仅基于规范的方法虽然能保留验证意图，却难以处理实现层面的细节。 其次，工具反馈能为语法、可满足性以及相对于 RTL 的行为提供可靠证据，但本身无法确立与规范之间的语义一致性。 第三，日益复杂的推理、搜索和多智能体流程虽然提升了稳健性，但也带来了延迟增加、工具调用增多、计算成本上升以及中间环节出错机会增多的代价。 因此，未来的推理时方法需要兼顾规范的保真度与实现的基础性，同时独立验证中间表示，并利用互补的语义正确性、覆盖性、非空性和现实故障检测能力等指标来评估生成的断言集。

paragraphs.en: Training-time approaches adapt an LLM to SVA generation by updating its parameters using hardware-verification-specific data. Unlike inference-time methods, which rely on prompting, retrieval, structured context, search, or tool feedback without modifying the underlying model, fine-tuning attempts to internalize SVA syntax, temporal semantics, and recurring hardware-property patterns. This can improve generation consistency and enable smaller open-source models to perform specialized verification tasks. However, because SVA generation involves multiple stages—including requirement extraction, signal mapping, temporal reasoning, and assertion construction—most existing training-time methods focus on particular subtasks rather than learning the complete specification-to-SVA process.
paragraphs.zh: 训练时方法通过用硬件验证专用数据更新大型语言模型（LLM）的参数，使其适应 SVA 生成。 与依赖提示、检索、结构化上下文、搜索或工具反馈而不修改底层模型的推理时方法不同，微调试图将 SVA 的句法、时间语义和重复出现的硬件属性模式内化。 这可以提升生成的稳定性，并让较小的开源模型能够执行专门的验证任务。 然而，由于 SVA 生成涉及多个阶段——包括需求提取、信号映射、时间推理和断言构建——大多数现有的训练时方法都只关注特定的子任务，而非学习完整的从规范到 SVA 的完整流程。

paragraphs.en: Aditi and Hsiao [ 61 ] provide an early demonstration of fine-tuning for SVA generation by adapting CodeT5 and PLBart to translate natural-language property descriptions into assertions. The generated SVA is additionally translated back into natural language and compared with the original description, providing an interpretable consistency check between the input requirement and generated property. This work demonstrates that task-specific training can teach models the correspondence between natural-language temporal behavior and SVA constructs. However, it assumes that the desired property has already been identified and expressed as a concise natural-language statement. It therefore addresses property translation rather than the broader problem of extracting verification requirements from complete specifications. Moreover, back-translation measures linguistic consistency rather than behavioral correctness; an assertion can appear consistent in natural language while still containing incorrect temporal semantics or failing to represent the RTL behavior correctly.
paragraphs.zh: Aditi 和 Hsiao [ 61 ] 通过调整 CodeT5 和 PLBart 将自然语言属性描述翻译为断言，首次展示了 SVA 生成的微调方法。 生成的 SVA 还会被反向翻译回自然语言，并与原始描述进行比较，从而在输入要求与生成的属性之间提供可解释的一致性检查。 这项工作表明，针对特定任务的训练可以教会模型自然语言中的时序行为与 SVA 结构之间的对应关系。 然而，该方法假设所需的属性已经被识别，并以简洁的自然语言陈述形式表达出来。 因此，它解决的是属性翻译问题，而非从完整规范中提取验证要求的更广泛问题。 此外，反向翻译衡量的是语言一致性而非行为正确性；一个断言在自然语言中可能看似一致，但仍可能包含错误的时序语义或未能正确表示 RTL 行为。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid-NL2SVA follows a similar property-translation formulation but combines domain-specific fine-tuning with inference-time augmentation. It fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct using a synthetic dataset constructed from hardware-design textbooks and Verilog collected from 67 designs, containing 4,070 SVAs paired with one-sentence natural-language descriptions generated using OpenAI o4-mini. The resulting model shows substantial improvement after fine-tuning, while retrieval-based augmentation further improves generation. Compared with the earlier CodeT5/PLBart approach, Hybrid-NL2SVA benefits from a stronger pretrained code model, a larger hardware-specific dataset, and a hybrid training/inference strategy. Nevertheless, both approaches share the same fundamental abstraction: they assume that a relevant property has already been extracted and expressed in natural language. Their results therefore demonstrate improved NL-to-SVA translation , but provide limited evidence for full specification-driven assertion generation. In addition, synthetic natural-language labels and automatically collected assertions make performance dependent on the semantic quality of the constructed training pairs.
paragraphs.zh: Hybrid-NL2SVA 遵循类似的属性翻译公式，但将领域特定的微调与推理时的增强技术相结合。 它使用一个合成数据集对 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 进行微调，该数据集由硬件设计教材和来自 67 个设计的 Verilog 代码构建而成，包含 4,070 个 SVA 以及使用 OpenAI o4-mini 生成的一行自然语言描述。 经过微调后，所得模型表现出显著改进，而基于检索的增强技术进一步提升了生成效果。 与早期的 CodeT5/PLBart 方法相比，Hybrid-NL2SVA 受益于更强大的预训练代码模型、更大的硬件特定数据集以及混合的训练/推理策略。 尽管如此，这两种方法都共享相同的根本抽象假设：它们假定相关属性已经被提取并以自然语言表达出来。 因此，它们的结果展示了自然语言到 SVA 的翻译效果有所提升，但为完全基于规格驱动的断言生成提供的证据有限。 此外，合成自然语言标签和自动收集的断言使得模型性能依赖于所构建训练对的语义质量。

sents.zh: 因此，它们的结果展示了自然语言到 SVA 的翻译效果有所提升，但为完全基于规格驱动的断言生成提供的证据有限。

paragraphs.en: AssertCraft [ 51 ] moves closer to specification-driven generation by fine-tuning an LLM using assertion-related examples extracted and filtered from open-source repositories together with synthetic data. Rather than relying exclusively on the fine-tuned model, AssertCraft combines task-specific adaptation with an inference-time iterative refinement loop in which candidate assertions can be repaired using a non-fine-tuned LLM. This hybrid architecture is significant because it treats fine-tuning and inference-time reasoning as complementary: fine-tuning provides domain-specific generation capability, while iterative refinement addresses errors that remain after generation.
paragraphs.zh: AssertCraft [ 51 ] 通过利用从开源仓库中提取和筛选出的与断言相关的示例以及合成数据对大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调，使其更趋近于以规范为导向的生成方式。 AssertCraft 并未完全依赖微调后的模型，而是将任务特定的适配与推理时的迭代优化循环相结合，在这一循环中，候选断言可以通过未经微调的 LLM 进行修复。 这种混合架构具有重要意义，因为它将微调和推理时的推理视为互补环节：微调提供了领域特定的生成能力，而迭代优化则解决了生成后仍存在的错误。

sents.en: AssertCraft [ 51 ] moves closer to specification-driven generation by fine-tuning an LLM using assertion-related examples extracted and filtered from open-source repositories together with synthetic data.
sents.zh: AssertCraft [ 51 ] 通过利用从开源仓库中提取和筛选出的与断言相关的示例以及合成数据对大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调，使其更趋近于以规范为导向的生成方式。

sents.zh: 这种混合架构具有重要意义，因为它将微调和推理时的推理视为互补环节：微调提供了领域特定的生成能力，而迭代优化则解决了生成后仍存在的错误。

paragraphs.en: This design also illustrates an important difficulty in evaluating training-time approaches. Improvements in AssertCraft arise from several interacting components, including dataset construction, task decomposition, the fine-tuned generator, and iterative refinement. Consequently, end-to-end improvements cannot necessarily be attributed to fine-tuning alone without controlled ablation. More generally, fine-tuning can improve the model’s prior knowledge of SVA patterns but does not eliminate the need for specification grounding or external verification. A model trained on high-quality assertion examples may still generate a property that is inappropriate for the particular design being verified.
paragraphs.zh: 这一设计也揭示了评估训练时方法时所面临的一个关键难题。 AssertCraft 的改进源于多个相互作用的组件，包括数据集构建、任务分解、微调后的生成器以及迭代优化。 因此，在没有受控消融分析的情况下，端到端的改进并不必然可以完全归因于微调本身。 更普遍地讲，微调可以提升模型对 SVA 模式的先验知识，但并未消除对规格基础设定或外部验证的需求。 即使在高质量断言示例上训练过的模型，仍可能生成一个与待验证特定设计不相符的属性。

paragraphs.en: VERT [ 62 ] further emphasizes the value of domain-specific training data. It constructs a large SVA dataset from open-source hardware designs and uses it to fine-tune DeepSeek Coder and LLaMA 3.1 models, which are subsequently compared with GPT-4o across multiple hardware designs. The results show that smaller open-source models adapted to hardware-verification data can outperform a substantially larger general-purpose closed-source model on the evaluated SVA-generation tasks. This provides important evidence that, for specialized verification tasks, domain adaptation can compensate for model scale. Fine-tuned open-source models also enable local deployment, which is attractive when proprietary RTL and specifications cannot be exposed to external model providers.
paragraphs.zh: VERT [ 62 ] 进一步强调了领域特定训练数据的重要性。 它从开源硬件设计中构建了一个大型 SVA 数据集，并以此对 DeepSeek Coder 和 LLaMA 3.1 模型进行微调，随后在多种硬件设计上与 GPT-4o 进行了比较。 结果表明，经过硬件验证数据适配的较小规模开源模型，在评估的 SVA 生成任务上能够超越一个规模大得多的通用闭源模型。 这为以下结论提供了重要证据：对于专门的验证任务而言，领域自适应可以弥补模型规模的不足。 经过微调的开源模型还支持本地部署，这在无法将专有 RTL 和规格暴露给外部模型提供商的情况下极具吸引力。

sents.en: VERT [ 62 ] further emphasizes the value of domain-specific training data.
sents.zh: VERT [ 62 ] 进一步强调了领域特定训练数据的重要性。

sents.en: It constructs a large SVA dataset from open-source hardware designs and uses it to fine-tune DeepSeek Coder and LLaMA 3.1 models, which are subsequently compared with GPT-4o across multiple hardware designs.
sents.zh: 它从开源硬件设计中构建了一个大型 SVA 数据集，并以此对 DeepSeek Coder 和 LLaMA 3.1 模型进行微调，随后在多种硬件设计上与 GPT-4o 进行了比较。

sents.en: The results show that smaller open-source models adapted to hardware-verification data can outperform a substantially larger general-purpose closed-source model on the evaluated SVA-generation tasks.
sents.zh: 结果表明，经过硬件验证数据适配的较小规模开源模型，在评估的 SVA 生成任务上能够超越一个规模大得多的通用闭源模型。

sents.en: This provides important evidence that, for specialized verification tasks, domain adaptation can compensate for model scale.
sents.zh: 这为以下结论提供了重要证据：对于专门的验证任务而言，领域自适应可以弥补模型规模的不足。

sents.en: Fine-tuned open-source models also enable local deployment, which is attractive when proprietary RTL and specifications cannot be exposed to external model providers.
sents.zh: 经过微调的开源模型还支持本地部署，这在无法将专有 RTL 和规格暴露给外部模型提供商的情况下极具吸引力。

paragraphs.en: VERT, however, also exposes a recurring limitation of current training-time methods: the granularity and provenance of training data strongly determine what the model learns. Assertions mined from open-source repositories provide realistic SVA syntax and recurring temporal patterns, but snippet-level examples contain limited information about the complete specification and design context from which the assertions originated. Consequently, strong performance on local assertion-generation tasks does not necessarily imply that the model can identify appropriate verification objectives from a full specification, reason across module hierarchies, or construct a comprehensive assertion set for an unseen IP.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，VERT 也暴露出当前训练时方法的一个反复出现的局限性：训练数据的颗粒度和来源在很大程度上决定了模型能学到什么。 从开源仓库中挖掘出的断言提供了逼真的 SVA 语法和重复出现的时间模式，但片段级的示例仅包含有限信息，无法反映这些断言所源自的完整规范和设计背景。 因此，在本地断言生成任务上表现优异，并不必然意味着该模型能够从完整规范中识别出合适的验证目标、跨越模块层级进行推理，或为未见的 IP 构建全面的断言集。

sents.zh: 因此，在本地断言生成任务上表现优异，并不必然意味着该模型能够从完整规范中识别出合适的验证目标、跨越模块层级进行推理，或为未见的 IP 构建全面的断言集。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these studies demonstrate a progression from fine-tuning for direct NL-to-SVA translation toward domain-adapted models embedded within larger verification pipelines. Aditi and Hsiao [ 61 ] establish the feasibility of learning mappings between natural-language properties and SVA; Hybrid-NL2SVA scales this formulation using a modern code LLM, synthetic data, and retrieval; AssertCraft [ 51 ] combines fine-tuning with iterative inference-time refinement; and VERT [ 62 ] demonstrates that sufficiently specialized training can make smaller open-source models competitive with or superior to larger general-purpose models. Thus, training-time and inference-time techniques are increasingly complementary rather than competing alternatives: fine-tuning internalizes recurring domain knowledge, while retrieval, structured context, RTL grounding, and verification-tool feedback provide design-specific information that cannot reasonably be encoded in model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些研究展示了一个演进过程：从针对直接自然语言到SVA翻译的微调，转向嵌入在更大验证流程中的领域自适应模型。 Aditi和Hsiao [61] 证明了学习自然语言属性与SVA之间映射的可行性；Hybrid-NL2SVA利用现代代码LLM、合成数据和检索技术扩展了这一方法；AssertCraft [51] 将微调与推理阶段的迭代优化相结合；而VERT [62] 则表明，足够专业的训练可以使较小的开源模型在性能上与较大的通用模型相当甚至更优。 因此，训练阶段和推理阶段的技术正日益成为互补而非相互竞争的替代方案：微调将重复出现的领域知识内化于模型之中，而检索、结构化上下文、RTL grounding以及验证工具的反馈则提供了无法合理编码到模型参数中的特定设计信息。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, current training-time methods remain primarily focused on learning how to express properties as SVAs , rather than determining which properties are required to adequately verify a design . Most training datasets consist of assertion snippets or pairs of natural-language descriptions and SVAs, with relatively limited representation of complete specifications, RTL hierarchy, verification intent, and relationships among multiple properties. Dataset construction also introduces risks from noisy repository assertions, automatically generated descriptions, duplicated examples, and possible overlap between training and evaluation designs. These issues make data quality, provenance, and contamination control particularly important when evaluating fine-tuned models.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当前的训练时方法仍然主要关注如何学习将属性表示为 SVA，而不是确定需要哪些属性才能充分验证一个设计。 大多数训练数据集由断言片段或自然语言描述与 SVA 的配对组成，其中完整规范、RTL 层次结构、验证意图以及多个属性之间的关系等内容的代表性相对有限。 数据集构建还会带来风险，例如来自噪声丰富的代码库断言、自动生成的描述、重复的例子，以及训练设计与评估设计之间可能存在的重叠。 这些问题使得在评估微调模型时，数据质量、来源和污染控制变得尤为重要。

sents.zh: 这些问题使得在评估微调模型时，数据质量、来源和污染控制变得尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: Future training-time methods therefore require datasets that preserve richer relationships among specifications, RTL, verification objectives, assertions, and verification outcomes . Training objectives could similarly move beyond next-token prediction on individual assertions toward learning specification-to-property alignment, signal grounding, temporal reasoning, and assertion-set construction. Importantly, fine-tuning should not replace deterministic verification: compilation, simulation, formal analysis, vacuity checking, and mutation testing remain necessary for independently evaluating generated properties. A promising direction is therefore a hybrid architecture in which domain-specific training provides efficient hardware-verification knowledge, while inference-time retrieval and reasoning supply design-specific context and formal tools provide objective feedback on correctness and verification effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，未来的训练阶段方法需要能够保留规格说明、RTL、验证目标、断言和验证结果之间更丰富关系的数据集。 训练目标同样可以超越对单个断言的下一个词预测，转向学习从规格说明到属性的对齐、信号接地、时序推理以及断言集构建。 重要的是，微调不应取代确定性验证：编译、模拟、形式化分析、空值检查和变异测试仍然是独立评估所生成属性所必需的。 因此，一个有前景的方向是混合架构：其中领域特定的训练提供高效的硬件验证知识，而推理阶段的检索与推理则提供设计特定的上下文，形式化工具则对正确性和验证有效性提供客观反馈。

paragraphs.en: The inference- and training-time methods reviewed above employ different mechanisms to improve SVA generation, ranging from structured prompting, retrieval, reasoning, and formal-tool feedback to domain-specific fine-tuning. Evaluating these methods, however, requires determining not only whether an LLM can produce executable SVA code, but also whether the generated properties faithfully capture verification intent and effectively detect incorrect behavior. Existing evaluations can therefore be viewed as providing increasingly strong but complementary forms of evidence: syntactic validity , formal consistency , coverage , fault-detection capability , and ultimately specification alignment .
paragraphs.zh: 上文介绍的推理和训练阶段的方法采用了不同的机制来改进 SVA 生成，包括结构化提示、检索、推理和形式化工具反馈，以及领域特定的微调。 然而，评估这些方法不仅需要确定大型语言模型（LLM）能否生成可执行的 SVA 代码，还需要判断所生成的属性是否忠实地体现了验证意图，并能有效检测错误行为。 因此，现有的评估可以被视为提供了逐步增强但相互补充的证据形式：语法有效性、形式一致性、覆盖性、故障检测能力，以及最终的规格对齐性。

sents.zh: 上文介绍的推理和训练阶段的方法采用了不同的机制来改进 SVA 生成，包括结构化提示、检索、推理和形式化工具反馈，以及领域特定的微调。
