sents.zh: 因此，现有的评估可以被视为提供了逐步增强但相互补充的证据形式：语法有效性、形式一致性、覆盖性、故障检测能力，以及最终的规格对齐性。

paragraphs.en: Syntactic validity is the most basic and widely reported metric. It measures whether generated assertions can be parsed, compiled, and accepted by SystemVerilog verification tools. This metric is inexpensive, deterministic, and particularly useful for measuring whether prompting or fine-tuning improves knowledge of SVA syntax. However, compilation establishes only that an assertion is executable; a syntactically correct property may still check the wrong behavior, use inappropriate timing, or encode an incorrect requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 句法有效性是最基础且被广泛报道的指标。 它衡量生成的断言是否能够被解析、编译，并被 SystemVerilog 验证工具接受。 该指标成本低廉、结果确定，尤其适用于衡量提示或微调是否提升了 SVA 句法的掌握程度。 然而，编译仅能证明一个断言是可执行的；一个句法正确的属性仍可能检查错误的行为、使用不当的时序，或编码了错误的要求。

sents.en: Syntactic validity is the most basic and widely reported metric.
sents.zh: 句法有效性是最基础且被广泛报道的指标。

sents.en: It measures whether generated assertions can be parsed, compiled, and accepted by SystemVerilog verification tools.
sents.zh: 它衡量生成的断言是否能够被解析、编译，并被 SystemVerilog 验证工具接受。

paragraphs.en: Formal property verification (FPV) provides stronger behavioral evidence by checking generated assertions against an RTL implementation using formal verification tools such as JasperGold or SymbiYosys. If a trusted golden RTL implementation is assumed to correctly realize the specification, successful proof provides evidence that the generated assertion is consistent with the expected design behavior, while counterexamples can identify incorrect properties. FPV is therefore widely used in benchmarks such as AssertLLM [ 23 ] , VERT [ 62 ] , AssertionBench [ 64 ] , and FVEval [ 65 ] . However, FPV is not a direct semantic oracle. A weak, vacuous, or incorrectly interpreted assertion may still be provable, and results depend on the RTL, assumptions, constraints, and formal environment. Proofs may also time out or remain inconclusive for complex designs. Thus, FPV primarily establishes consistency with the analyzed implementation , not necessarily correctness with respect to the original specification.
paragraphs.zh: 形式属性验证（FPV）通过形式验证工具（如 JasperGold 或 SymbiYosys）将生成的断言与 RTL 实现进行比对，从而提供更强的行为证据。 如果假设一个可信的基准 RTL 实现能够正确体现规格要求，那么验证成功便证明生成的断言与预期的设计行为一致，而反例则能识别出错误的属性。 因此，FPV 被广泛用于 AssertLLM [ 23 ]、VERT [ 62 ]、AssertionBench [ 64 ] 和 FVEval [ 65 ] 等基准测试中。 然而，FPV 并非直接的语义判定器。 一个弱、空泛或解释错误的断言可能仍然可以被验证，且结果取决于 RTL、假设、约束以及形式化环境。 对于复杂设计，验证过程也可能超时或无法得出明确结论。 因此，FPV 主要确立的是与所分析实现的一致性，而非必然地证明其相对于原始规格的正确性。

paragraphs.en: Coverage analysis complements FPV by measuring how generated properties relate to the implementation. Existing work reports metrics such as cone of influence (COI), proof coverage, formal coverage, and, depending on the environment, statement, branch, or toggle coverage. AssertLLM [ 23 ] introduced COI-based analysis alongside FPV, while later benchmarks such as VERT [ 62 ] and AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] employ broader coverage measurements. Coverage can expose trivial assertions that constrain or observe little of the design and can assess the collective reach of an assertion set. Nevertheless, high coverage does not imply correct verification intent: a property may involve many RTL signals while still encode behavior inconsistent with the specification.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖分析通过衡量生成的属性与实现之间的关系，对 FPV 起到补充作用。 现有研究报告了多种指标，例如影响锥（COI）、证明覆盖、形式覆盖，以及根据具体环境不同的语句、分支或切换覆盖。 AssertLLM [ 23 ] 在 FPV 的基础上引入了基于 COI 的分析方法，而后续的基准测试如 VERT [ 62 ] 和 AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] 则采用了更广泛的覆盖度测量方法。 覆盖分析可以揭示那些对设计约束或观察作用微乎其微的冗余断言，并能评估一组断言的整体覆盖范围。 然而，高覆盖度并不意味着验证意图正确：一个属性可能涉及大量 RTL 信号，但其编码的行为仍可能与规范不一致。

sents.zh: 覆盖分析通过衡量生成的属性与实现之间的关系，对 FPV 起到补充作用。

sents.en: Nevertheless, high coverage does not imply correct verification intent: a property may involve many RTL signals while still encode behavior inconsistent with the specification.
sents.zh: 然而，高覆盖度并不意味着验证意图正确：一个属性可能涉及大量 RTL 信号，但其编码的行为仍可能与规范不一致。

paragraphs.en: Mutation testing evaluates a different dimension—whether assertions can detect erroneous implementations. Mutations are introduced into an otherwise correct RTL design, and generated assertions are evaluated according to whether they fail on the faulty versions. AssertCoder [ 52 ] , VERT [ 62 ] , and AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] use mutation-based evaluation to complement syntax, proof, and coverage metrics. Compared with proving assertions only against golden RTL, mutation testing provides stronger evidence of practical fault-detection capability and assertion strength. However, its validity depends strongly on the realism, diversity, and relevance of the injected faults. Easily detected or artificial mutations may inflate performance, while generating representative semantic bugs at scale remains difficult. Mutation score should therefore be interpreted as a measure of fault-detection effectiveness , rather than direct proof of specification correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 变异测试评估的是另一个维度——断言能否检测出错误的实现。 在原本正确的 RTL 设计中引入变异，并根据生成的断言在错误版本中是否失效来对其进行评估。 AssertCoder [ 52 ]、VERT [ 62 ] 和 AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] 使用基于变异的评估方法，以补充语法、证明和覆盖率指标。 与仅将断言针对黄金 RTL 进行证明相比，变异测试能为实际故障检测能力和断言强度提供更强的证据。 然而，其有效性在很大程度上取决于所注入故障的真实性、多样性和相关性。 易于检测或人为制造的变异可能会夸大性能表现，而大规模生成具有代表性的语义错误仍然十分困难。 因此，变异得分应被解释为故障检测有效性的衡量标准，而非规格正确性的直接证明。

paragraphs.en: These metrics evaluate complementary properties rather than interchangeable notions of correctness. Syntax checking establishes executability ; FPV establishes consistency with RTL under the verification environment ; coverage measures interaction with or reach into the design ; and mutation testing measures ability to detect selected faults . The strongest objective, specification alignment , asks whether an assertion accurately captures the intended requirement. This remains the most difficult dimension to evaluate automatically because neither the RTL nor generated mutations provide an independent semantic oracle when the objective is to verify the implementation against a natural-language specification. Consequently, no single existing metric is sufficient, motivating evaluation frameworks that combine multiple complementary measures.
paragraphs.zh: 这些指标评估的是相互补充的特性，而非可以互换的正确性概念。 语法检查确保可执行性；FPV 确保在验证环境中与 RTL 的一致性；覆盖率衡量与设计之间的交互或覆盖范围；而变异测试则衡量检测特定故障的能力。 最强的目标——规格对齐——旨在判断某个断言是否准确捕捉了预期的需求。 这仍然是最难自动评估的维度，因为当目标是验证实现是否符合自然语言规格时，既不是 RTL 也不是生成的变异能够提供独立的语义判据。 因此，任何单一的现有指标都不足以满足需求，这促使人们采用结合多种互补措施的评估框架。

paragraphs.en: Existing SVA benchmarks differ substantially in task formulation, design scale, input context, and evaluation methodology, reflecting the evolution from property translation toward specification- and design-level assertion generation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 SVA 基准在任务表述、设计规模、输入上下文和评估方法上存在显著差异，这反映了其从属性翻译向规格和设计层断言生成方向的演变。

paragraphs.en: AssertLLM [ 23 ] introduced one of the earliest standardized benchmarks for specification-driven SVA generation. It contains 20 samples drawn from open-source IP and system-level designs, pairing specifications with corresponding RTL. This pairing is important because it enables evaluation of both specification-conditioned generation and generated assertions against executable implementations. Its evaluation combines syntax checking, COI analysis, and FPV, providing stronger evidence than syntax-only evaluation. However, the small number of designs limits behavioral and structural diversity and makes broad conclusions about generalization difficult.
paragraphs.zh: AssertLLM [ 23 ] 提出了最早一批用于规范驱动 SVA 生成的标准化基准之一。 它包含 20 个从开源 IP 和系统级设计中选取的样本，将规范与对应的 RTL 配对。 这种配对非常重要，因为它使得既能评估规范条件生成，也能评估所生成断言与可执行实现之间的匹配情况。 其评估结合了语法检查、COI 分析和 FPV，比仅进行语法检查的评估提供了更充分的证据。 然而，设计数量较少限制了行为和结构上的多样性，使得难以对泛化能力得出广泛结论。

sents.zh: AssertLLM [ 23 ] 提出了最早一批用于规范驱动 SVA 生成的标准化基准之一。

paragraphs.en: VERT [ 62 ] takes a substantially different approach. Its dataset contains approximately 20,000 snippets extracted from open-source hardware repositories, including BOOM, Rocket Chip, XiangShan, and other RTL projects. Rather than emphasizing complete specification-to-design tasks, VERT targets recurring SVA-generation patterns and errors, including temporal and clock-cycle interpretation. Its scale makes it particularly suitable for training and evaluating domain-adapted models, and its combination of syntax, COI, FPV, and mutation testing provides multiple measures of assertion quality. The tradeoff is granularity: snippet-level tasks provide limited evidence that a model can identify verification objectives from a complete specification or reason across large hierarchical designs. Thus, VERT is especially valuable for evaluating the training-time domain adaptation discussed in the previous subsection, whereas specification-level benchmarks better exercise the inference-time reasoning and grounding pipelines reviewed earlier.
paragraphs.zh: VERT [ 62 ] 采取了截然不同的方法。 其数据集包含约 20,000 个从开源硬件仓库中提取的代码片段，包括 BOOM、Rocket Chip、XiangShan 和其他 RTL 项目。 VERT 并未强调从完整规范到设计的完整任务，而是针对重复出现的 SVA 生成模式与错误，包括时序和时钟周期的解释问题。 其规模使其特别适合训练和评估领域自适应模型，而语法、COI、FPV 和突变测试的结合，则为断言质量提供了多种衡量标准。 但代价是颗粒度：片段级任务提供的证据有限，难以证明模型能否从完整规范中识别验证目标，或能对大型分层设计进行跨层级推理。 因此，VERT 对于评估上一小节讨论的训练阶段领域自适应尤为有价值，而规范级基准测试则能更好地检验前文回顾的推理阶段推理与落地流程。

paragraphs.en: AssertionBench [ 64 ] occupies an intermediate position. It contains 100 samples derived from OpenCores designs, with formally proven reference assertions, English descriptions, and corresponding Verilog designs. This construction provides controlled NL-to-SVA tasks while retaining executable RTL for formal validation, making it useful for evaluating in-context learning and property translation. However, its emphasis on syntax and FPV provides limited measurement of assertion-set coverage, fault-detection capability, or fidelity to complete design specifications.
paragraphs.zh: AssertionBench [ 64 ] 处于一个中间位置。 它包含 100 个源自 OpenCores 设计的样本，这些样本具有经过形式化证明的参考断言、英文描述以及相应的 Verilog 设计。 这种构建方式在保留可用于形式化验证的可执行 RTL 的同时，提供了受控的 NL-to-SVA 任务，因此对于评估上下文学习和属性转换非常有用。 然而，它侧重于语法和 FPV，因此对断言集覆盖范围、故障检测能力或完整设计规格的忠实度测量有限。

sents.zh: 然而，它侧重于语法和 FPV，因此对断言集覆盖范围、故障检测能力或完整设计规格的忠实度测量有限。

paragraphs.en: FVEval [ 65 ] provides broader task diversity through three complementary sub-benchmarks. NL2SVA-Human contains 79 expert-written assertions from real-world verification environments paired with natural-language descriptions; NL2SVA-Machine contains 300 machine-generated natural-language/SVA pairs; and Design2SVA contains 192 synthetic RTL instances based on arithmetic pipelines and finite-state machines. This decomposition is useful because it distinguishes human-authored property translation, scalable synthetic translation, and direct RTL-to-SVA generation rather than collapsing them into a single task. It therefore enables analysis of how performance changes with the source and form of the input. However, its primary reliance on syntax checking and FPV again leaves specification coverage, realistic fault detection, and full-document semantic alignment largely unmeasured.
paragraphs.zh: FVEval [ 65 ] 通过三个互补的子基准测试提供了更广泛的任务多样性。 NL2SVA-Human 包含来自真实世界验证环境的 79 条专家撰写的断言，并配有自然语言描述；NL2SVA-Machine 包含 300 对由机器生成的自然语言/SVA 配对；而 Design2SVA 则包含基于算术流水线和有限状态机的 192 个合成 RTL 实例。 这种分解之所以有用，是因为它区分了人类撰写的属性翻译、可扩展的合成翻译以及直接的 RTL-to-SVA 生成，而不是将它们合并为单一任务。 因此，它能够分析性能如何随输入的来源和形式而变化。 然而，它主要依赖语法检查和 FPV，这再次导致规格覆盖、真实故障检测以及完整文档的语义对齐等方面在很大程度上未被衡量。

sents.zh: FVEval [ 65 ] 通过三个互补的子基准测试提供了更广泛的任务多样性。

paragraphs.en: CVDP [ 66 ] differs from these assertion-specific benchmarks by evaluating SVA generation as one component of a broader suite of LLM-based EDA tasks. Its assertion subset contains 98 tasks with prompts, relevant context, design files, and test harnesses, using checklist-based evaluation and syntax checking. This task-oriented formulation is valuable for assessing SVA generation within a broader hardware-engineering context rather than an isolated translation setting. However, its evaluation provides less evidence about formal correctness, non-vacuity, coverage, and fault-detection strength than assertion-specific benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: CVDP [ 66 ] 与这些针对断言的基准测试不同，它将 SVA 生成评估为更广泛的基于 LLM 的 EDA 任务套件中的一个组成部分。 其断言子集包含 98 个带有提示、相关上下文、设计文件和测试框架的任务，并采用基于检查表的评估和语法检查方法。 这种以任务为导向的构建方式对于在更广泛的硬件工程背景下评估 SVA 生成具有价值，而非局限于孤立的翻译场景。 然而，与针对断言的基准测试相比，其评估在形式正确性、非空性、覆盖率和故障检测能力方面提供的证据较少。

sents.zh: 然而，与针对断言的基准测试相比，其评估在形式正确性、非空性、覆盖率和故障检测能力方面提供的证据较少。

paragraphs.en: AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] moves toward a more comprehensive design-level evaluation. It contains 83 samples collected from open-source Verilog/SystemVerilog repositories together with corresponding specifications, while filtering out designs below 200 lines of RTL to increase task complexity and normalizing specification structure. More importantly, its evaluation combines syntax checking, FPV, COI, proof coverage, formal coverage, and mutation testing. Compared with earlier benchmarks that emphasize one or two dimensions, AssertLLM2 therefore evaluates both whether assertions are executable and provable and whether they exercise meaningful portions of the design and detect injected faults. Its remaining limitation is shared by the broader literature: these tool-based metrics remain proxies for whether generated assertions faithfully and comprehensively represent the original specification.
paragraphs.zh: AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] 正朝着更全面的架构级评估方向迈进。 它包含从开源 Verilog/SystemVerilog 仓库中收集的 83 个样本及其对应的规范，同时过滤掉了 RTL 代码少于 200 行的设计，以提高任务复杂度并标准化规范结构。 更重要的是，其评估结合了语法检查、FPV、COI、证明覆盖、形式化覆盖和变异测试。 与以往仅强调一两个维度的基准测试相比，AssertLLM2 因此同时评估了断言是否可执行且可被证明，以及它们是否覆盖了设计的有意义部分并检测到了注入的故障。 其剩余的局限性也与更广泛的文献研究共通：这些基于工具的指标仍然是衡量所生成断言是否忠实且全面地反映了原始规范的一种替代手段。

sents.en: AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] moves toward a more comprehensive design-level evaluation.
sents.zh: AssertLLM2 [ 67 ] 正朝着更全面的架构级评估方向迈进。

sents.en: It contains 83 samples collected from open-source Verilog/SystemVerilog repositories together with corresponding specifications, while filtering out designs below 200 lines of RTL to increase task complexity and normalizing specification structure.
sents.zh: 它包含从开源 Verilog/SystemVerilog 仓库中收集的 83 个样本及其对应的规范，同时过滤掉了 RTL 代码少于 200 行的设计，以提高任务复杂度并标准化规范结构。

sents.en: More importantly, its evaluation combines syntax checking, FPV, COI, proof coverage, formal coverage, and mutation testing.
sents.zh: 更重要的是，其评估结合了语法检查、FPV、COI、证明覆盖、形式化覆盖和变异测试。

sents.en: Compared with earlier benchmarks that emphasize one or two dimensions, AssertLLM2 therefore evaluates both whether assertions are executable and provable and whether they exercise meaningful portions of the design and detect injected faults.
sents.zh: 与以往仅强调一两个维度的基准测试相比，AssertLLM2 因此同时评估了断言是否可执行且可被证明，以及它们是否覆盖了设计的有意义部分并检测到了注入的故障。

sents.en: Its remaining limitation is shared by the broader literature: these tool-based metrics remain proxies for whether generated assertions faithfully and comprehensively represent the original specification.
sents.zh: 其剩余的局限性也与更广泛的文献研究共通：这些基于工具的指标仍然是衡量所生成断言是否忠实且全面地反映了原始规范的一种替代手段。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these benchmarks reveal a progression in both task complexity and evaluation strength . Property-level benchmarks such as AssertionBench and portions of FVEval provide controlled evaluation of NL-to-SVA translation, while VERT emphasizes scale and is particularly suited to training-time domain adaptation. AssertLLM and AssertLLM2 move toward complete specification- and design-conditioned generation, better exercising the reasoning, retrieval, signal-grounding, and refinement capabilities of inference-time systems. CVDP instead evaluates assertion generation within a broader EDA task environment. Similarly, evaluation has progressed from syntax checking toward FPV, coverage, and mutation testing, with recent benchmarks increasingly combining these metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些基准测试揭示了任务复杂度和评估强度的逐步提升。 像 AssertionBench 和 FVEval 的部分内容这样的属性级基准测试，为自然语言到 SVA 的翻译提供了受控的评估，而 VERT 则强调规模，尤其适合训练时的领域自适应。 AssertLLM 和 AssertLLM2 正朝着完全基于规范和条件的设计生成方向发展，从而更好地发挥推理时系统的推理、检索、信号接地和精炼能力。 相比之下，CVDP 则在更广泛的 EDA 任务环境中评估断言生成。 同样，评估已从语法检查逐步发展到 FPV、覆盖率和变异测试，近期的基准测试也越来越多地结合这些指标。

sents.en: Taken together, these benchmarks reveal a progression in both task complexity and evaluation strength .
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些基准测试揭示了任务复杂度和评估强度的逐步提升。

sents.zh: 相比之下，CVDP 则在更广泛的 EDA 任务环境中评估断言生成。

sents.en: Similarly, evaluation has progressed from syntax checking toward FPV, coverage, and mutation testing, with recent benchmarks increasingly combining these metrics.
sents.zh: 同样，评估已从语法检查逐步发展到 FPV、覆盖率和变异测试，近期的基准测试也越来越多地结合这些指标。

paragraphs.en: However, direct comparison across reported results remains difficult because benchmarks differ in design source, scale, input information, property granularity, formal environment, and evaluation criteria. Training-time evaluations introduce the additional concern of contamination or repository overlap, particularly when both training and evaluation examples originate from public RTL repositories. Inference-time methods face a related concern when specifications, RTL, or reference assertions may have appeared in model pretraining data. Evaluation on held-out designs and, where possible, previously unpublished or carefully contamination-controlled benchmarks is therefore important for establishing generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，由于基准测试在设计来源、规模、输入信息、属性粒度、形式化环境和评估标准方面存在差异，直接比较已报告的结果仍然具有挑战性。 训练阶段的评估还会带来污染或知识库重叠的额外问题，尤其是当训练和评估示例都来自公共 RTL 知识库时。 推理阶段的方法也面临类似的问题，因为规格说明、RTL 或参考断言可能曾出现在模型预训练数据中。 因此，在预留的设计上进行评估，并在可能的情况下使用此前未发布或经过严格污染控制的基准测试，对于验证模型的泛化能力至关重要。

sents.zh: 然而，由于基准测试在设计来源、规模、输入信息、属性粒度、形式化环境和评估标准方面存在差异，直接比较已报告的结果仍然具有挑战性。

sents.zh: 推理阶段的方法也面临类似的问题，因为规格说明、RTL 或参考断言可能曾出现在模型预训练数据中。

sents.zh: 因此，在预留的设计上进行评估，并在可能的情况下使用此前未发布或经过严格污染控制的基准测试，对于验证模型的泛化能力至关重要。

paragraphs.en: More fundamentally, existing benchmarks still provide limited measurement of assertion-set quality . Evaluating assertions independently does not determine whether the generated set adequately covers the specification, contains redundant or contradictory properties, or omits critical requirements. Future benchmarks should therefore preserve explicit relationships among specifications, RTL, reference verification objectives, assertions, and realistic faults, enabling separate measurement of syntactic validity, semantic fidelity, specification coverage, non-vacuity, consistency, behavioral diversity, and fault-detection capability. For iterative and agentic methods, evaluation should additionally report inference cost, verification-tool runtime, number of refinement iterations or tool calls, robustness across repeated runs, and human intervention. Such multidimensional evaluation is necessary to compare increasingly sophisticated inference- and training-time approaches and to determine whether improvements in SVA generation translate into more effective hardware verification.
paragraphs.zh: 更根本的是，现有的基准测试仍然无法充分衡量断言集的质量。 独立评估各个断言，并不能确定所生成的集合是否充分覆盖了规范、是否包含冗余或矛盾的属性，或者是否遗漏了关键需求。 因此，未来的基准测试应保留规范、RTL、参考验证目标、断言和真实故障之间的显式关系，从而能够分别衡量句法有效性、语义保真度、规范覆盖性、非空性、一致性、行为多样性和故障检测能力。 对于迭代和智能体驱动的方法，评估还应报告推理成本、验证工具的运行时、精炼迭代次数或工具调用次数、重复运行下的鲁棒性以及人工干预情况。 这种多维度的评估对于比较日益复杂的推理和训练阶段方法，以及判断 SVA 生成方面的改进是否真正能带来更有效的硬件验证，是必要的。

paragraphs.en: Despite substantial progress from direct NL-to-SVA translation toward structured, tool-guided, fine-tuned, and agentic approaches, several challenges remain before LLM-generated SVAs can be reliably used in practical verification.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管从直接的 NL-to-SVA 翻译到结构化、工具引导、微调以及智能体驱动的方法已取得显著进展，但在 LLM 生成的 SVA 能够可靠地用于实际验证之前，仍然存在若干挑战。

paragraphs.en: Semantic alignment and evaluation. A fundamental challenge is determining whether generated assertions faithfully represent the specification. Existing methods commonly rely on syntax checking, formal property verification (FPV), coverage, and mutation testing. These provide complementary evidence of executability, consistency with RTL, design interaction, and fault-detection capability, respectively, but none directly establishes specification fidelity. SpecAlign [ 72 ] represents an initial step toward explicitly evaluating the semantic alignment between generated SVAs and their corresponding specifications. Nevertheless, specification-level evaluation remains challenging, particularly when golden RTL is used for both generation and validation, since an incorrect property derived from faulty RTL may still be formally proven against that RTL. Future evaluation should therefore combine complementary metrics with independent specification-level assessment. Standardized benchmarks should also include diverse unseen designs, realistic specifications and faults, and contamination controls to enable meaningful comparison across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 语义对齐与评估。 一个根本性挑战是判断生成的断言是否忠实反映了规范。 现有方法通常依赖语法检查、形式化属性验证（FPV）、覆盖率和变异测试。 这些方法分别提供了关于可执行性、与 RTL 的一致性、设计交互和故障检测能力的互补证据，但没有一种能直接证明对规范的忠实度。 SpecAlign [ 72 ] 是明确评估生成的 SVA 与其对应规范之间语义对齐的初步尝试。 然而，在规范层面上的评估仍然充满挑战，尤其是在使用黄金 RTL 进行生成和验证时，因为从有缺陷的 RTL 中推导出的错误属性可能仍能被针对该 RTL 形式化证明。 因此，未来的评估应将互补的指标与独立的规范层面评估相结合。 标准化基准还应包含多样化的未见过的设计、逼真的规范和故障，以及污染控制，以实现不同方法之间的有意义比较。

paragraphs.en: From individual assertions to assertion sets. Existing evaluations primarily assess individual properties, whereas practical verification depends on whether the complete assertion set adequately captures design intent. Generating many simple and correct assertions may produce favorable aggregate results while missing complex behaviors or interactions. Future evaluation should therefore consider specification coverage, non-vacuity, redundancy, consistency, behavioral diversity, and fault-detection effectiveness at the assertion-set level. Explicit traceability between specification requirements and generated properties would further reveal missing or inadequately represented requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 从单个断言到断言集。 现有的评估主要关注单个属性，而实际验证则取决于完整的断言集是否充分捕捉了设计意图。 生成大量简单且正确的断言可能会带来良好的整体结果，但可能遗漏复杂的行为或交互。 因此，未来的评估应在断言集层面考虑规范覆盖性、非空性、冗余性、一致性、行为多样性和故障检测有效性。 规范需求与生成的属性之间的明确可追溯性将有助于进一步发现缺失或表示不充分的需求。

sents.en: From individual assertions to assertion sets.
sents.zh: 从单个断言到断言集。

sents.en: Existing evaluations primarily assess individual properties, whereas practical verification depends on whether the complete assertion set adequately captures design intent.
sents.zh: 现有的评估主要关注单个属性，而实际验证则取决于完整的断言集是否充分捕捉了设计意图。

sents.en: Generating many simple and correct assertions may produce favorable aggregate results while missing complex behaviors or interactions.
sents.zh: 生成大量简单且正确的断言可能会带来良好的整体结果，但可能遗漏复杂的行为或交互。

sents.en: Future evaluation should therefore consider specification coverage, non-vacuity, redundancy, consistency, behavioral diversity, and fault-detection effectiveness at the assertion-set level.
sents.zh: 因此，未来的评估应在断言集层面考虑规范覆盖性、非空性、冗余性、一致性、行为多样性和故障检测有效性。

sents.zh: 规范需求与生成的属性之间的明确可追溯性将有助于进一步发现缺失或表示不充分的需求。

paragraphs.en: Generalization, scalability, and cost. Training-time approaches show the benefits of domain adaptation, while inference-time methods improve design-specific reasoning through retrieval, structured representations, and tool feedback. However, both remain sensitive to data quality and are largely evaluated on relatively small designs or localized properties. Scaling to complex SoCs requires reasoning across hierarchical RTL and specifications while selectively retrieving relevant information across modules and abstraction levels. Moreover, multimodal processing, candidate search, agentic workflows, and repeated formal-tool calls increase latency and computational cost. Future evaluations should therefore report inference and verification runtime, tool calls, refinement iterations, and human intervention, together with controlled ablations that isolate the contributions of individual techniques.
paragraphs.zh: 泛化性、可扩展性和成本。 训练阶段的方法体现了领域自适应的优势，而推理阶段的方法则通过检索、结构化表示和工具反馈来改进针对特定设计推理的能力。 然而，这两种方法都对数据质量较为敏感，且大多在相对较小的设计或局部属性上进行评估。 要扩展到复杂的片上系统（SoC），需要在分层 RTL 和规格之间进行推理，同时有选择地跨模块和抽象层检索相关信息。 此外，多模态处理、候选项搜索、智能体工作流程以及重复的形式化工具调用都会增加延迟和计算成本。 因此，未来的评估应报告推理与验证的运行时间、工具调用次数、优化迭代次数和人工干预情况，并结合受控的消融研究，以明确各项技术的具体贡献。

sents.zh: 泛化性、可扩展性和成本。

paragraphs.en: Toward complete verification property sets. Another promising direction is joint generation of assumptions, assertions, and cover properties . Assumptions characterize valid environmental behavior, assertions specify required design behavior, and cover properties establish reachability of important scenarios. Generating and validating them together can reduce spurious failures, expose overconstraint and vacuity, and provide a more complete representation of verification intent than assertions alone.
paragraphs.zh: 迈向完整的验证属性集。 另一个有前景的方向是联合生成假设、断言和覆盖属性。 假设描述了有效的环境行为，断言规定了所需的设计行为，而覆盖属性则确立了重要场景的可达性。 联合生成并验证它们可以减少虚假故障，揭示过度约束和空值问题，并且相比仅使用断言，能更完整地表达验证意图。

sents.en: Toward complete verification property sets.
sents.zh: 迈向完整的验证属性集。

sents.en: Another promising direction is joint generation of assumptions, assertions, and cover properties .
sents.zh: 另一个有前景的方向是联合生成假设、断言和覆盖属性。

sents.en: Assumptions characterize valid environmental behavior, assertions specify required design behavior, and cover properties establish reachability of important scenarios.
sents.zh: 假设描述了有效的环境行为，断言规定了所需的设计行为，而覆盖属性则确立了重要场景的可达性。

sents.en: Generating and validating them together can reduce spurious failures, expose overconstraint and vacuity, and provide a more complete representation of verification intent than assertions alone.
sents.zh: 联合生成并验证它们可以减少虚假故障，揭示过度约束和空值问题，并且相比仅使用断言，能更完整地表达验证意图。

paragraphs.en: Overall, future research should shift from optimizing the generation of individually valid assertions toward constructing specification-aligned and independently validated verification property sets . LLMs are well suited for interpreting requirements, connecting information across heterogeneous artifacts, and proposing candidate properties, while deterministic simulation and formal tools provide essential validation and feedback. Combining these complementary capabilities—while maintaining traceability to the specification, controlling cost, and preserving independence from implementation errors—is a promising path toward reducing manual assertion-development effort and enabling reliable, review-centered assertion-based verification.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，未来研究应从优化单个有效断言的生成，转向构建与规范一致且可独立验证的验证属性集。 大型语言模型非常适合解释需求、连接异构工件之间的信息以及提出候选属性，而确定性模拟和形式化工具则提供了必要的验证和反馈。 结合这些互补的能力——同时保持对规范的追溯性、控制成本并维持与实现错误无关的独立性——是减少手动开发断言的工作量，并实现可靠、以审查为中心的断言式验证的一条有前景的路径。

sents.en: Overall, future research should shift from optimizing the generation of individually valid assertions toward constructing specification-aligned and independently validated verification property sets .
sents.zh: 总体而言，未来研究应从优化单个有效断言的生成，转向构建与规范一致且可独立验证的验证属性集。

sents.en: LLMs are well suited for interpreting requirements, connecting information across heterogeneous artifacts, and proposing candidate properties, while deterministic simulation and formal tools provide essential validation and feedback.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型非常适合解释需求、连接异构工件之间的信息以及提出候选属性，而确定性模拟和形式化工具则提供了必要的验证和反馈。

sents.en: Combining these complementary capabilities—while maintaining traceability to the specification, controlling cost, and preserving independence from implementation errors—is a promising path toward reducing manual assertion-development effort and enabling reliable, review-centered assertion-based verification.
sents.zh: 结合这些互补的能力——同时保持对规范的追溯性、控制成本并维持与实现错误无关的独立性——是减少手动开发断言的工作量，并实现可靠、以审查为中心的断言式验证的一条有前景的路径。

paragraphs.en: This section surveys recent work on automatic testbench and stimulus generation for hardware verification, with emphasis on large language model (LLM) based methods. It situates LLM approaches relative to pre-LLM template and grammar-based tools, then reviews prompt-only generation, EDA-feedback loops, coverage-directed stimulus generation, self-validating testbench construction, UVM/subsystem-level generation, training-time alignment, and benchmark design. The main conclusion is that current LLMs are most useful when embedded in verification-aware workflows that constrain generation with scenarios, templates, simulators, coverage reports, and functional self-checks, rather than when used as unconstrained SystemVerilog authors.
paragraphs.zh: 本节概述了硬件验证中自动测试台和激励生成领域的近期研究，重点介绍基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法。 本节将 LLM 方法置于预 LLM 时代的模板和语法驱动工具背景下进行对比，随后回顾了仅通过提示词生成、EDA 反馈循环、以覆盖率为导向的激励生成、自验证测试台构建、UVM/子系统级生成、训练时的对齐以及基准设计等方法。 主要结论是：当前 LLM 在嵌入到具备验证意识的流程中时最为有效，这些流程通过场景、模板、仿真器、覆盖率报告和功能性自检来约束生成过程，而非将其用作不受限制的 SystemVerilog 编写工具。

sents.en: This section surveys recent work on automatic testbench and stimulus generation for hardware verification, with emphasis on large language model (LLM) based methods.
sents.zh: 本节概述了硬件验证中自动测试台和激励生成领域的近期研究，重点介绍基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法。

sents.en: It situates LLM approaches relative to pre-LLM template and grammar-based tools, then reviews prompt-only generation, EDA-feedback loops, coverage-directed stimulus generation, self-validating testbench construction, UVM/subsystem-level generation, training-time alignment, and benchmark design.

sents.en: The main conclusion is that current LLMs are most useful when embedded in verification-aware workflows that constrain generation with scenarios, templates, simulators, coverage reports, and functional self-checks, rather than when used as unconstrained SystemVerilog authors.
sents.zh: 主要结论是：当前 LLM 在嵌入到具备验证意识的流程中时最为有效，这些流程通过场景、模板、仿真器、覆盖率报告和功能性自检来约束生成过程，而非将其用作不受限制的 SystemVerilog 编写工具。

paragraphs.en: Simulation-based functional verification remains one of the most common pre-silicon verification techniques. A useful testbench is not merely code that compiles: it instantiates the design under test (DUT), drives meaningful stimuli, observes outputs, compares behavior against an oracle or reference model, and records structural or functional coverage. In industrial SystemVerilog flows, this often expands into Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) components such as sequence items, sequencers, drivers, monitors, agents, scoreboards, coverage collectors, and tests [ 73 , 74 ] . Python-based harnesses such as cocotb are also relevant because many LLM workflows exploit Python’s stronger representation in pretraining corpora to implement checkers, reference models, or orchestration code [ 75 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于仿真的功能验证仍然是最常用的一种预硅验证技术。 一个有用的测试平台不仅仅是能够编译的代码：它会实例化待测设计（DUT），施加有意义的刺激，观察输出，将行为与预言机或参考模型进行比较，并记录结构或功能覆盖情况。 在工业级的 SystemVerilog 流程中，这通常会扩展为通用验证方法学（UVM）的组件，例如序列项、序列器、驱动模块、监控模块、智能体、记分板、覆盖收集器和测试 [ 73 , 74 ] 。 基于 Python 的测试框架（如 cocotb）也同样重要，因为许多 LLM 工作流程会利用 Python 在预训练语料库中更强的表现来实现检查器、参考模型或协调代码 [ 75 ] 。

sents.zh: 基于仿真的功能验证仍然是最常用的一种预硅验证技术。

paragraphs.en: The literature on LLM-assisted testbench generation separates into three related but distinct tasks. The first is stimulus generation : producing input vectors, transactions, or sequences that improve code or functional coverage. The second is testbench construction : producing executable drivers, clocks, resets, monitors, and checkers. The third is verification-environment synthesis : generating reusable UVM or subsystem-level verification infrastructure. These tasks differ in difficulty. Stimulus generation can be judged by coverage and simulator output, while full testbench generation also requires correct timing, reset handling, protocol compliance, and a faithful oracle. This distinction explains why many recent systems use the LLM as a planner or repair agent, while deterministic code templates, DSLs, or simulators enforce the final executable structure [ 76 , 77 , 78 , 79 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 关于大型语言模型（LLM）辅助测试平台生成的文献可分为三个相关但独立的任务。 第一个任务是激励生成：产生输入向量、事务或序列，以提高代码覆盖或功能覆盖。 第二个任务是测试平台构建：生成可执行的驱动程序、时钟、复位信号、监视器和检查器。 第三个任务是验证环境合成：生成可重用的 UVM 或子系统级验证基础设施。 这些任务的难度各不相同。 激励生成可以通过覆盖率和仿真器输出进行评估，而完整的测试平台生成还需要正确的时序、复位处理、协议合规以及忠实的判据。 这种区别解释了为何许多近期系统将 LLM 用作规划或修复智能体，同时由确定性代码模板、领域特定语言（DSL）或仿真器来强制执行最终的可执行结构 [ 76 , 77 , 78 , 79 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes this taxonomy and the feedback signals that cut across the three task levels.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 总结了这一分类体系以及贯穿三个任务层面的反馈信号。

paragraphs.en: Automatic testbench generation predates modern LLMs. Earlier tools demonstrate two lessons that remain important. First, constraining the output space greatly improves syntactic stability. Second, simulation throughput matters because verification requires repeated execution. AVERT, for example, generates Verilog testbenches for grammatical-evolution hardware-design workflows by using DUT port information and standard test-vector files; it supports combinational and sequential circuits and improves simulation efficiency by evaluating multiple DUTs in a single generated testbench [ 80 ] . Such approaches do not solve oracle discovery or semantic adequacy, but they show that structured generation can remove repetitive formatting work and reduce avoidable syntax errors.
paragraphs.zh: 自动测试平台生成技术早于现代大型语言模型。 早期的工具揭示了两个至今仍然重要的经验。 首先，限制输出空间能显著提升句法稳定性。 其次，仿真吞吐量至关重要，因为验证需要重复执行。 例如，AVERT 通过利用被测单元（DUT）端口信息和标准测试向量文件，为基于语法进化的硬件设计流程生成 Verilog 测试平台；它支持组合电路和时序电路，并通过在单个生成的测试平台中评估多个被测单元来提高仿真效率 [80]。 这类方法并未解决“神谕发现”或语义充分性问题，但它们表明，结构化生成可以消除重复的格式设置工作，并减少可避免的句法错误。

sents.en: Automatic testbench generation predates modern LLMs.
sents.zh: 自动测试平台生成技术早于现代大型语言模型。

sents.zh: 早期的工具揭示了两个至今仍然重要的经验。

sents.zh: 这类方法并未解决“神谕发现”或语义充分性问题，但它们表明，结构化生成可以消除重复的格式设置工作，并减少可避免的句法错误。

paragraphs.en: Other pre-LLM work includes coverage-directed test generation, directed testing, and RTL fuzzing. Machine-learning-assisted coverage-directed generation and directed hardware validation emphasizes the same optimization problem that LLM systems now revisit: selecting tests that close coverage efficiently while preserving bug-finding power [ 81 , 82 ] . RFUZZ, DirectFuzz, and FuzzWiz show that fuzzing-style feedback can drive RTL exploration using coverage or hardware-specific guidance, making them important non-LLM baselines for stimulus-generation studies [ 83 , 84 , 85 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其他预 LLM 的研究包括以覆盖为导向的测试生成、定向测试和 RTL 模糊测试。 机器学习辅助的以覆盖为导向的生成和定向硬件验证强调了 LLM 系统如今重新探讨的同一优化问题：选择能够高效完成覆盖同时保持故障发现能力的测试 [ 81 , 82 ] 。 RFUZZ、DirectFuzz 和 FuzzWiz 表明，模糊测试风格的反馈可以利用覆盖或针对硬件的引导来驱动 RTL 探索，因此它们成为刺激生成研究中重要的非 LLM 基准方法 [ 83 , 84 , 85 ] 。

sents.zh: 其他预 LLM 的研究包括以覆盖为导向的测试生成、定向测试和 RTL 模糊测试。

sents.en: RFUZZ, DirectFuzz, and FuzzWiz show that fuzzing-style feedback can drive RTL exploration using coverage or hardware-specific guidance, making them important non-LLM baselines for stimulus-generation studies [ 83 , 84 , 85 ] .
sents.zh: RFUZZ、DirectFuzz 和 FuzzWiz 表明，模糊测试风格的反馈可以利用覆盖或针对硬件的引导来驱动 RTL 探索，因此它们成为刺激生成研究中重要的非 LLM 基准方法 [ 83 , 84 , 85 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Traditional constrained-random verification similarly provides a useful baseline for LLM work. Randomization and coverage feedback can explore large input spaces, especially in UVM-style environments, but engineers still have to write constraints, monitors, scoreboards, and coverage models. LLM-based methods therefore should not be evaluated only against direct prompting; they should also be compared with random, constrained-random, template-based, fuzzing-based, and coverage-directed baselines where appropriate. This is especially important because a generated testbench that improves line coverage may still miss a functional bug if the checker is weak or absent.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的约束随机验证同样为 LLM 工作提供了一个有用的基准。 随机化和覆盖反馈可以探索庞大的输入空间，尤其是在 UVM 风格的环境中，但工程师仍然需要编写约束、监控器、计分板和覆盖模型。 因此，基于 LLM 的方法不应仅通过与直接提示的对比进行评估；在适当的情况下，还应将其与随机、约束随机、模板驱动、模糊测试驱动和覆盖导向的基准进行比较。 这一点尤其重要，因为即使生成的测试平台提高了行覆盖率，如果检查器较弱或缺失，它仍然可能遗漏功能错误。

sents.zh: 传统的约束随机验证同样为 LLM 工作提供了一个有用的基准。

sents.zh: 这一点尤其重要，因为即使生成的测试平台提高了行覆盖率，如果检查器较弱或缺失，它仍然可能遗漏功能错误。

paragraphs.en: The earliest LLM-based testbench studies generally prompt a commercial model with RTL and a natural-language specification, compile or simulate the result, and feed tool output back into subsequent prompts. Bhandari et al. study this pattern for finite-state-machine testbench generation and bug detection. Their workflow asks GPT-3.5 or GPT-4 to generate tests, uses commercial EDA feedback to identify uncovered transitions or errors, and iteratively refines prompts until coverage improves. The work is important because it treats simulator and coverage output as first-class prompt context, not merely as an after-the-fact evaluation step [ 86 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 最早基于大型语言模型（LLM）的测试台研究通常通过提供 RTL 和自然语言规范来提示商业模型，然后编译或模拟结果，并将工具输出反馈到后续提示中。 Bhandari 等人研究了这种模式在有限状态机测试台生成和错误检测中的应用。 他们的工作流程要求 GPT-3.5 或 GPT-4 生成测试用例，利用商业 EDA 的反馈识别未覆盖的转换或错误，并迭代优化提示，直到覆盖率得到提升。 这项工作之所以重要，是因为它将模拟器和覆盖率输出视为一等级的提示上下文，而不仅仅是事后评估步骤 [ 86 ]。

sents.en: The earliest LLM-based testbench studies generally prompt a commercial model with RTL and a natural-language specification, compile or simulate the result, and feed tool output back into subsequent prompts.

paragraphs.en: The FSM study also exposes a recurring limitation: LLMs struggle with long traces, many states, and multi-bit outputs. The authors mitigate this by chunking traces, resetting after groups of transitions, and decomposing multi-bit outputs into smaller subproblems. This suggests a broader design principle for testbench generation: scalable systems should avoid asking the model to reason over an entire trace or full environment in one context window. Instead, they should decompose the task into local coverage gaps, individual protocol obligations, or smaller signal cones.
paragraphs.zh: 该有限状态机（FSM）研究还揭示了一个反复出现的问题：大型语言模型（LLM）在处理长轨迹、多状态和多比特输出时存在困难。 作者通过将轨迹分块、在一系列状态转换后重置，以及将多比特输出分解为更小的子问题来缓解这一问题。 这表明了测试台生成领域一个更广泛的设计原则：可扩展的系统应避免要求模型在单个上下文窗口中推理整个轨迹或完整环境。 相反，系统应将任务分解为局部的覆盖缺口、独立的协议约束，或更小的信号锥。

sents.en: The FSM study also exposes a recurring limitation: LLMs struggle with long traces, many states, and multi-bit outputs.
sents.zh: 该有限状态机（FSM）研究还揭示了一个反复出现的问题：大型语言模型（LLM）在处理长轨迹、多状态和多比特输出时存在困难。

sents.en: The authors mitigate this by chunking traces, resetting after groups of transitions, and decomposing multi-bit outputs into smaller subproblems.
sents.zh: 作者通过将轨迹分块、在一系列状态转换后重置，以及将多比特输出分解为更小的子问题来缓解这一问题。

sents.en: This suggests a broader design principle for testbench generation: scalable systems should avoid asking the model to reason over an entire trace or full environment in one context window.
sents.zh: 这表明了测试台生成领域一个更广泛的设计原则：可扩展的系统应避免要求模型在单个上下文窗口中推理整个轨迹或完整环境。

sents.en: Instead, they should decompose the task into local coverage gaps, individual protocol obligations, or smaller signal cones.
sents.zh: 相反，系统应将任务分解为局部的覆盖缺口、独立的协议约束，或更小的信号锥。

paragraphs.en: A second line of work uses the LLM primarily as a coverage-directed stimulus generator. LLM4DV is an open-source framework that orchestrates LLMs for hardware test-stimuli generation across multiple DUTs. Rather than asking for a complete verification environment, it iteratively samples missed coverage bins, restarts or refines dialogue context, and uses few-shot prompting to guide the generation of input stimuli [ 87 ] . This narrower framing is valuable because coverage bins and simulator feedback provide an executable objective: the model is rewarded for reaching untested behavior, not for producing aesthetically plausible HDL.
paragraphs.zh: 第二类工作主要将 LLM 用作以覆盖率为导向的刺激生成器。 LLM4DV 是一个开源框架，用于协调 LLM 为多个被测设备（DUT）生成硬件测试刺激。 与其要求一个完整的验证环境，它更倾向于迭代地采样未覆盖的覆盖率区间、重启或优化对话上下文，并利用少样本提示来指导输入刺激的生成 [87]。 这种更聚焦的框架很有价值，因为覆盖率区间和模拟器反馈提供了一个可执行的目标：模型因触达未测试的行为而获得奖励，而非生成在外观上看似合理的 HDL 代码。

sents.zh: 第二类工作主要将 LLM 用作以覆盖率为导向的刺激生成器。

paragraphs.en: VerilogReader takes a related but more code-coverage-oriented view. It integrates an LLM into a coverage-directed generation loop where the model acts as a “Verilog reader” that interprets RTL and coverage reports, then proposes stimuli for uncovered branches [ 22 ] . The system’s Coverage Explainer and DUT Explainer modules illustrate a practical prompt-engineering pattern: raw Verilator output is not ideal LLM context, so an intermediate explanation layer translates simulator artifacts into natural-language goals. The method performs best when the design remains within the model’s comprehension scope, and its degradation on larger FSMs reinforces the scalability concerns observed in FSM-focused work.
paragraphs.zh: VerilogReader 采取了一种相关但更侧重于代码覆盖率的视角。 它将一个大语言模型（LLM）整合到一个以覆盖率为导向的生成循环中，其中该模型充当“Verilog 阅读器”，负责解释 RTL 和覆盖率报告，然后为未覆盖的分支提出刺激信号 [ 22 ] 。 系统中的覆盖率解释器和 DUT 解释器模块展示了一种实用的提示工程模式：原始的 Verilator 输出并非理想的 LLM 上下文，因此需要一个中间解释层，将模拟器的产物转化为自然语言目标。 当设计仍处于模型的理解范围内时，该方法表现最佳；而在较大的有限状态机（FSM）上其性能下降，也再次印证了在专注于 FSM 的研究中观察到的可扩展性问题。

paragraphs.en: Spec2Cov generalizes this agentic coverage-closure perspective by driving test-stimulus generation directly from design specifications and iteratively coordinating compilation, simulation, coverage-report parsing, and prompt refinement [ 88 ] . Its results show that agentic coverage closure can reach full coverage on simpler designs but remains significantly harder on complex designs, which is consistent with the broader literature: coverage feedback is powerful, but it does not eliminate the need for design understanding, good oracles, and scalable decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: Spec2Cov 通过直接从设计规格中生成测试刺激，并迭代协调编译、仿真、覆盖率报告解析和提示优化，对这种智能体驱动的覆盖闭合视角进行了推广 [ 88 ]。 其结果表明，在较简单的设计中，智能体驱动的覆盖闭合能够达到完全覆盖；但在复杂设计中，这一过程仍然明显更具挑战性。这与更广泛的文献一致：覆盖率反馈虽然强大，但并未消除对设计理解、优质判据和可扩展分解的需求。

paragraphs.en: Several newer systems frame coverage closure as part of a broader verification-agent loop. PRO-V-R1 combines an LLM with reinforcement learning and simulation feedback to improve automatic RTL verification, while UCAgent proposes an end-to-end block-level verification agent that traverses states and goals toward coverage closure [ 89 , 90 ] . These systems are not only testbench generators; they combine planning, test generation, execution, and refinement. They are therefore best viewed as adjacent evidence that testbench generation is becoming an agentic workflow rather than a single prompt-completion task.
paragraphs.zh: 一些较新的系统将覆盖闭合视为更广泛的验证-智能体循环的一部分。 PRO-V-R1 将大型语言模型与强化学习和模拟反馈相结合，以改进自动 RTL 验证；而 UCAgent 则提出了一种端到端的块级验证智能体，该智能体通过遍历状态和目标来实现覆盖闭合 [ 89 , 90 ] 。 这些系统不仅仅是测试平台生成器；它们将规划、测试生成、执行和精炼相结合。 因此，最恰当的视角是将其视为相邻的证据，表明测试平台生成正逐渐成为一种智能体式的工作流程，而非单一提示补全任务。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 abstracts the recurring loop shared by these systems.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 概括了这些系统所共有的重复循环。

paragraphs.en: AutoBench is a key transition from stimulus-only work to complete LLM-generated testbenches. It proposes a staged workflow that separates scenario specification, Verilog driver generation, and Python checker generation. This architecture deliberately uses Python for checking because LLMs are generally stronger at Python than HDL, while Verilog remains necessary for driving and integrating with RTL simulation [ 76 ] . AutoBench also introduces AutoEval, which evaluates generated testbenches at multiple levels: basic execution, functional behavior, and mutation-based adequacy. The mutation-based step is particularly important because a testbench can compile and even pass the golden design while still failing to reject incorrect RTL mutants.
paragraphs.zh: AutoBench 是从仅基于刺激的工作转向由大型语言模型（LLM）完整生成测试台的關鍵过渡。 它提出了一种分阶段的工作流程，将场景规范、Verilog 驱动生成以及 Python 检查器生成分离开来。 这种架构有意使用 Python 进行检查，因为大型语言模型在 Python 方面的能力通常强于硬件描述语言（HDL），而 Verilog 在驱动和与 RTL 仿真集成方面仍然不可或缺 [76]。 AutoBench 还引入了 AutoEval，用于在多个层面评估生成的测试台：基础执行、功能行为以及基于突变的充分性。 基于突变的步骤尤为重要，因为一个测试台可能能够编译并通过黄金设计测试，但仍然无法拒绝错误的 RTL 突变体。

sents.en: AutoBench is a key transition from stimulus-only work to complete LLM-generated testbenches.
sents.zh: AutoBench 是从仅基于刺激的工作转向由大型语言模型（LLM）完整生成测试台的關鍵过渡。

sents.zh: AutoBench 还引入了 AutoEval，用于在多个层面评估生成的测试台：基础执行、功能行为以及基于突变的充分性。

sents.zh: 基于突变的步骤尤为重要，因为一个测试台可能能够编译并通过黄金设计测试，但仍然无法拒绝错误的 RTL 突变体。

paragraphs.en: CorrectBench extends this direction by adding functional self-validation and self-correction. Its central insight is that syntax-level debugging is insufficient: the generated checker or driver may be functionally wrong even after it compiles. CorrectBench uses scenario-based validation with imperfect RTL variants to infer whether a generated testbench can distinguish correct and incorrect behavior, then feeds detected bug information to an LLM-based corrector [ 77 ] . This shifts the target from “does the testbench run?” to “does the testbench detect meaningful behavioral differences?”
paragraphs.zh: CorrectBench 通过增加功能性的自我验证和自我纠正，拓展了这一方向。 其核心观点是，仅进行语法层面的调试是不够的：即使生成的检查器或驱动程序通过编译，其功能仍可能存在问题。 CorrectBench 采用基于场景的验证方法，结合不完整的 RTL 变体，推断生成的测试平台能否区分正确与错误的行为，然后将检测到的错误信息反馈给基于 LLM 的纠正器 [77]。 这将目标从“测试平台能否运行？”转变为“测试平台能否检测到有意义的行为差异？”

paragraphs.en: ConfiBench further extends the AutoBench/CorrectBench family with confidence-based scenario masking and a multi-testbench ensemble. Instead of trusting a single generated testbench in all scenarios, it masks high-risk scenarios and combines multiple generated testbenches to compensate for coverage loss. Reported results show a higher overall pass rate than AutoBench and CorrectBench-style baselines, especially on sequential circuits [ 91 ] . The broader lesson is that ensemble and confidence mechanisms can be useful when individual LLM outputs remain unstable.
paragraphs.zh: ConfiBench 进一步扩展了 AutoBench/CorrectBench 系列，引入了基于置信度的场景掩码和多测试台集成方法。 它不再像以往那样在所有场景中都信任单个生成的测试台，而是对高风险场景进行掩码处理，并结合多个生成的测试台来弥补覆盖率的损失。 报告结果显示，其整体通过率高于 AutoBench 和 CorrectBench 风格的基线方法，尤其是在序列电路方面 [ 91 ] 。 更广泛的启示是，当单个 LLM 的输出仍然不稳定时，集成和置信度机制可能会非常有用。

paragraphs.en: Moving from module-level Verilog testbenches to UVM environments introduces a substantial jump in complexity. UVM code is class-heavy, convention-driven, and protocol-sensitive; a generated environment must coordinate transaction definitions, sequences, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, configuration databases, coverage groups, and simulator-specific build rules. VerifLLMBench addresses this evaluation gap by benchmarking LLM-generated UVM testbenches using verified DUTs, generated UVM components, iterative syntax repair, linting, compilation, simulation, and coverage analysis [ 92 ] . Its importance is methodological: UVM generation must be evaluated as an environment-construction problem, not merely as a single-file code-generation task.
paragraphs.zh: 从模块级的 Verilog 测试平台转向 UVM 环境，复杂性会显著提升。 UVM 代码以类为基础、遵循约定且对协议高度敏感；一个生成的环境必须协调交易定义、序列、驱动、监视器、计分板、配置数据库、覆盖组以及模拟器特定的构建规则。 VerifLLMBench 通过利用经过验证的 DUT、生成的 UVM 组件，并结合迭代语法修复、linting、编译、仿真和覆盖分析，对 LLM 生成的 UVM 测试平台进行基准测试，从而填补了这一评估空白 [ 92 ] 。 其重要性体现在方法论层面：UVM 生成必须被视作一个环境构建问题来评估，而不仅仅是一项单文件代码生成任务。

sents.en: Moving from module-level Verilog testbenches to UVM environments introduces a substantial jump in complexity.
sents.zh: 从模块级的 Verilog 测试平台转向 UVM 环境，复杂性会显著提升。

sents.en: VerifLLMBench addresses this evaluation gap by benchmarking LLM-generated UVM testbenches using verified DUTs, generated UVM components, iterative syntax repair, linting, compilation, simulation, and coverage analysis [ 92 ] .

sents.en: Its importance is methodological: UVM generation must be evaluated as an environment-construction problem, not merely as a single-file code-generation task.

paragraphs.en: UVM 2 demonstrates a more automated UVM workflow that generates UVM testbenches and refines stimuli with coverage feedback on RTL designs up to roughly 1.6K lines of code [ 93 ] . HAVEN pushes the structured-generation principle further by preventing the LLM from writing raw UVM code directly. Instead, LLM agents extract an architectural plan, protocol-specific Jinja2 templates instantiate UVM components, and a protocol-aware sequence DSL generates bus-correct stimulus. On open-source IPs spanning Direct, Wishbone, and AXI4-Lite interfaces, HAVEN reports complete compilation success and strong average code and functional coverage [ 78 ] . This is one of the clearest examples that reducing LLM freedom can improve verification trust.
paragraphs.zh: UVM 2 展示了一种更自动化的 UVM 工作流程，该流程能够生成 UVM 测试平台，并通过覆盖率反馈对 RTL 设计（代码行数最多约 1.6K 行）的刺激信号进行优化 [ 93 ] 。 HAVEN 通过阻止 LLM 直接编写原始 UVM 代码，进一步推动了结构化生成的原则。 相反，LLM 智能体会提取架构计划，协议特定的 Jinja2 模板会实例化 UVM 组件，而一个具备协议意识的序列 DSL 则会生成符合总线规范的刺激信号。 在涵盖 Direct、Wishbone 和 AXI4-Lite 接口的开源 IP 上，HAVEN 报告了完整的编译成功以及较高的平均代码覆盖率和功能覆盖率 [ 78 ] 。 这是减少 LLM 自由度能够提升验证可靠性的最清晰示例之一。

sents.en: UVM 2 demonstrates a more automated UVM workflow that generates UVM testbenches and refines stimuli with coverage feedback on RTL designs up to roughly 1.6K lines of code [ 93 ] .
sents.zh: UVM 2 展示了一种更自动化的 UVM 工作流程，该流程能够生成 UVM 测试平台，并通过覆盖率反馈对 RTL 设计（代码行数最多约 1.6K 行）的刺激信号进行优化 [ 93 ] 。

sents.en: HAVEN pushes the structured-generation principle further by preventing the LLM from writing raw UVM code directly.
sents.zh: HAVEN 通过阻止 LLM 直接编写原始 UVM 代码，进一步推动了结构化生成的原则。

sents.en: Instead, LLM agents extract an architectural plan, protocol-specific Jinja2 templates instantiate UVM components, and a protocol-aware sequence DSL generates bus-correct stimulus.
sents.zh: 相反，LLM 智能体会提取架构计划，协议特定的 Jinja2 模板会实例化 UVM 组件，而一个具备协议意识的序列 DSL 则会生成符合总线规范的刺激信号。

sents.en: On open-source IPs spanning Direct, Wishbone, and AXI4-Lite interfaces, HAVEN reports complete compilation success and strong average code and functional coverage [ 78 ] .
sents.zh: 在涵盖 Direct、Wishbone 和 AXI4-Lite 接口的开源 IP 上，HAVEN 报告了完整的编译成功以及较高的平均代码覆盖率和功能覆盖率 [ 78 ] 。

sents.en: This is one of the clearest examples that reducing LLM freedom can improve verification trust.
sents.zh: 这是减少 LLM 自由度能够提升验证可靠性的最清晰示例之一。

paragraphs.en: UVMarvel extends the UVM story to subsystem-level verification. It introduces an intermediate representation, a bus protocol library, signal tracking, and a Verilog patching library to translate heterogeneous specifications into protocol-correct UVM environments and refine stimuli [ 79 ] . Compared with module-level benchmarks, this is closer to industrial verification because subsystems involve protocol interactions, generated interconnect, and multiple coordinated blocks. However, it also shows that successful LLM-aided UVM generation currently depends on substantial handcrafted infrastructure: protocol libraries, IRs, templates, and tool-specific repair loops.
paragraphs.zh: UVMarvel 将 UVM 方法扩展到了子系统的验证层面。 它引入了一种中间表示、总线协议库、信号跟踪以及 Verilog 补丁库，用于将异构规范转换为协议正确的 UVM 环境并优化激励 [ 79 ] 。 与模块级基准测试相比，这种方法更接近工业验证，因为子系统涉及协议交互、生成的互连以及多个协同工作的模块。 然而，这也表明目前成功的 LLM 辅助 UVM 生成依赖于大量手工构建的基础设施：协议库、中间表示、模板以及针对特定工具的修复循环。

sents.en: UVMarvel extends the UVM story to subsystem-level verification.
sents.zh: UVMarvel 将 UVM 方法扩展到了子系统的验证层面。

sents.en: It introduces an intermediate representation, a bus protocol library, signal tracking, and a Verilog patching library to translate heterogeneous specifications into protocol-correct UVM environments and refine stimuli [ 79 ] .
sents.zh: 它引入了一种中间表示、总线协议库、信号跟踪以及 Verilog 补丁库，用于将异构规范转换为协议正确的 UVM 环境并优化激励 [ 79 ] 。

sents.zh: 与模块级基准测试相比，这种方法更接近工业验证，因为子系统涉及协议交互、生成的互连以及多个协同工作的模块。

sents.en: However, it also shows that successful LLM-aided UVM generation currently depends on substantial handcrafted infrastructure: protocol libraries, IRs, templates, and tool-specific repair loops.
sents.zh: 然而，这也表明目前成功的 LLM 辅助 UVM 生成依赖于大量手工构建的基础设施：协议库、中间表示、模板以及针对特定工具的修复循环。

paragraphs.en: Other UVM-oriented and end-to-end verification studies support the same trend. Exploratory APB UVM case studies show that generative models can help scaffold protocol-specific UVM components, but also that human review is still needed for completeness and correctness [ 94 ] . Multi-agent verification frameworks and security-verification agents extend the idea beyond plain functional testbenches by combining LLM-generated collateral with simulator execution, assertion/security checks, or tool-guided debug loops [ 95 , 96 , 97 ] . These works are useful related literature even when their primary target is broader verification automation rather than testbench generation alone.
paragraphs.zh: 其他面向 UVM 和端到端的验证研究也支持这一趋势。 探索性的 APB UVM 案例研究表明，生成式模型有助于构建特定协议的 UVM 组件，但同时也表明，为确保完整性和正确性，仍需人工审查 [ 94 ] 。 多智能体验证框架和安全验证智能体通过将 LLM 生成的辅助材料与模拟器执行、断言/安全检查或工具引导的调试循环相结合，使这一理念超越了单纯的功能测试平台 [ 95 , 96 , 97 ] 。 即使这些研究的主要目标更侧重于广义的验证自动化，而非仅局限于测试平台生成，它们仍属于有价值的相關文献。

sents.zh: 其他面向 UVM 和端到端的验证研究也支持这一趋势。

sents.zh: 多智能体验证框架和安全验证智能体通过将 LLM 生成的辅助材料与模拟器执行、断言/安全检查或工具引导的调试循环相结合，使这一理念超越了单纯的功能测试平台 [ 95 , 96 , 97 ] 。

sents.zh: 即使这些研究的主要目标更侧重于广义的验证自动化，而非仅局限于测试平台生成，它们仍属于有价值的相關文献。

paragraphs.en: Prompting and agentic refinement improve inference-time behavior, but they do not directly teach the model which testbench patterns produce high verification value. TB or Not TB addresses this by fine-tuning models with Coverage-Driven Direct Preference Optimization (CD-DPO). It constructs PairaNet, a preference dataset of higher- and lower-quality testbenches labeled by simulation-derived coverage metrics, and trains models to prefer stimuli that improve coverage [ 98 ] . This is important because it turns coverage from a prompt-time hint into a training signal.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词引导和智能体式优化能够改善推理时的行为，但它们并未直接教会模型哪些测试平台模式能产生较高的验证价值。 TB or Not TB 方法通过采用覆盖率驱动的直接偏好优化（CD-DPO）对模型进行微调来解决这一问题。 该方法构建了 PairaNet——一个由模拟得出的覆盖率指标标注的高、低质量测试平台组成的偏好数据集，并训练模型优先选择能够提升覆盖率的输入刺激 [ 98 ] 。 这一点很重要，因为它将覆盖率从提示词阶段的线索转变为了训练信号。

sents.en: Prompting and agentic refinement improve inference-time behavior, but they do not directly teach the model which testbench patterns produce high verification value.
sents.zh: 提示词引导和智能体式优化能够改善推理时的行为，但它们并未直接教会模型哪些测试平台模式能产生较高的验证价值。

sents.zh: 该方法构建了 PairaNet——一个由模拟得出的覆盖率指标标注的高、低质量测试平台组成的偏好数据集，并训练模型优先选择能够提升覆盖率的输入刺激 [ 98 ] 。

sents.zh: 这一点很重要，因为它将覆盖率从提示词阶段的线索转变为了训练信号。

paragraphs.en: LLM4Cov similarly argues that online reinforcement learning with simulators is often too slow and expensive, so it builds an offline execution-aware agent-learning framework. The framework uses execution-validated data curation, policy-aware synthesis, and worst-state-prioritized sampling to train compact models for high-coverage testbench generation [ 99 ] . These training-time approaches indicate a likely future direction: instead of relying only on increasingly large general models, verification-specific generators may be trained on simulator-labeled examples, coverage traces, failed repair attempts, and tool-grounded preferences.
paragraphs.zh: LLM4Cov 同样认为，使用模拟器进行的在线强化学习通常过于缓慢且成本高昂，因此它构建了一个考虑离线执行的智能体学习框架。 该框架利用经过执行验证的数据筛选、策略感知合成以及最差状态优先采样，来训练紧凑型模型，以实现高覆盖率的测试台生成 [ 99 ] 。 这些训练阶段的方案表明了一个可能的未来方向：与其仅依赖规模不断扩大的通用模型，不如针对验证的专用生成器在模拟器标注的示例、覆盖率轨迹、失败的修复尝试以及基于工具的偏好数据上进行训练。

sents.en: LLM4Cov similarly argues that online reinforcement learning with simulators is often too slow and expensive, so it builds an offline execution-aware agent-learning framework.
sents.zh: LLM4Cov 同样认为，使用模拟器进行的在线强化学习通常过于缓慢且成本高昂，因此它构建了一个考虑离线执行的智能体学习框架。

sents.en: The framework uses execution-validated data curation, policy-aware synthesis, and worst-state-prioritized sampling to train compact models for high-coverage testbench generation [ 99 ] .
sents.zh: 该框架利用经过执行验证的数据筛选、策略感知合成以及最差状态优先采样，来训练紧凑型模型，以实现高覆盖率的测试台生成 [ 99 ] 。

sents.en: These training-time approaches indicate a likely future direction: instead of relying only on increasingly large general models, verification-specific generators may be trained on simulator-labeled examples, coverage traces, failed repair attempts, and tool-grounded preferences.
sents.zh: 这些训练阶段的方案表明了一个可能的未来方向：与其仅依赖规模不断扩大的通用模型，不如针对验证的专用生成器在模拟器标注的示例、覆盖率轨迹、失败的修复尝试以及基于工具的偏好数据上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Structured Testbench Generation (STG) takes an even stronger stance against unconstrained LLM generation. Rather than iteratively prompting an LLM to synthesize testbenches, STG exploits hardware structure to generate deterministic testbenches, reduce false passes, and curate verification-oriented data for model training [ 100 ] . STG’s results support a recurring conclusion across this section: testbench generation benefits from deterministic structure wherever possible, with LLMs used for planning, classification, repair, or data augmentation rather than unrestricted final-code authorship.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化测试平台生成（STG）对不受约束的 LLM 生成采取了更为严格的限制。 STG 并非通过迭代提示 LLM 来合成测试平台，而是利用硬件结构生成确定性测试平台，减少误判，并为模型训练整理验证导向的数据 [ 100 ] 。 STG 的结果支持了本节反复出现的一个结论：只要可行，测试平台生成就应受益于确定性结构；而 LLM 则应用于规划、分类、修复或数据增强，而非用于不受限制的最终代码编写。

sents.en: Structured Testbench Generation (STG) takes an even stronger stance against unconstrained LLM generation.
sents.zh: 结构化测试平台生成（STG）对不受约束的 LLM 生成采取了更为严格的限制。

sents.en: Rather than iteratively prompting an LLM to synthesize testbenches, STG exploits hardware structure to generate deterministic testbenches, reduce false passes, and curate verification-oriented data for model training [ 100 ] .

sents.en: STG’s results support a recurring conclusion across this section: testbench generation benefits from deterministic structure wherever possible, with LLMs used for planning, classification, repair, or data augmentation rather than unrestricted final-code authorship.
sents.zh: STG 的结果支持了本节反复出现的一个结论：只要可行，测试平台生成就应受益于确定性结构；而 LLM 则应用于规划、分类、修复或数据增强，而非用于不受限制的最终代码编写。

paragraphs.en: The newest papers increasingly describe testbench generation as one component of an agentic verification loop. In these systems, the LLM may decompose a verification goal, generate or repair testbench code, execute tools, interpret compiler or simulator output, update coverage goals, and repeat. This matches the “prompt, verify, repeat” pattern articulated in recent verification-cycle work [ 97 ] . The important distinction from earlier self-debugging is that the agent owns more of the verification workflow: it can select which scenario to target, which tool output to inspect, and when to revise code or stimuli.
paragraphs.zh: 最新的论文越来越多地将测试平台生成描述为智能体验证循环的一个组成部分。 在这些系统中，大语言模型可能会分解验证目标、生成或修复测试平台代码、执行工具、解释编译器或模拟器的输出、更新覆盖率目标，然后重复这一过程。 这与近期关于验证周期研究 [97] 中提出的“提示、验证、重复”模式相符。 与早期的自我调试方法的重要区别在于，智能体对验证工作流程拥有更多控制权：它可以选择要针对的具体场景、要检查的工具输出结果，以及何时修改代码或激励信号。

sents.en: The newest papers increasingly describe testbench generation as one component of an agentic verification loop.
sents.zh: 最新的论文越来越多地将测试平台生成描述为智能体验证循环的一个组成部分。

sents.zh: 这与近期关于验证周期研究 [97] 中提出的“提示、验证、重复”模式相符。

sents.en: The important distinction from earlier self-debugging is that the agent owns more of the verification workflow: it can select which scenario to target, which tool output to inspect, and when to revise code or stimuli.
sents.zh: 与早期的自我调试方法的重要区别在于，智能体对验证工作流程拥有更多控制权：它可以选择要针对的具体场景、要检查的工具输出结果，以及何时修改代码或激励信号。

paragraphs.en: This agentic framing has two consequences for a survey. First, related work should include papers whose output is not only a testbench file but a verification process that includes testbench generation. PRO-V-R1, UCAgent, MAVF, and SV-LLM are examples because they use generated programs, tests, or verification collateral inside larger automatic RTL verification pipelines [ 89 , 90 , 95 , 96 ] . Second, evaluation needs to include cost and convergence, not only final coverage: the number of compile/simulation attempts, failed repairs, prompts, and tool calls becomes part of the method’s practicality.
paragraphs.zh: 这种智能体式的框架对一项调查会产生两个影响。 首先，相关研究应包含那些输出不仅是一个测试平台文件，而且是一个包括测试平台生成的验证过程的论文。 PRO-V-R1、UCAgent、MAVF 和 SV-LLM 就是这样的例子，因为它们会在更大的自动 RTL 验证流程中使用生成的程序、测试或验证辅助材料 [ 89 , 90 , 95 , 96 ] 。 其次，评估需要包括成本和收敛性，而不仅仅是最终的覆盖率：编译/仿真尝试的次数、修复失败的情况、提示词和工具调用次数都将成为该方法实用性的组成部分。

sents.en: This agentic framing has two consequences for a survey.
sents.zh: 这种智能体式的框架对一项调查会产生两个影响。

sents.en: First, related work should include papers whose output is not only a testbench file but a verification process that includes testbench generation.
sents.zh: 首先，相关研究应包含那些输出不仅是一个测试平台文件，而且是一个包括测试平台生成的验证过程的论文。

sents.en: PRO-V-R1, UCAgent, MAVF, and SV-LLM are examples because they use generated programs, tests, or verification collateral inside larger automatic RTL verification pipelines [ 89 , 90 , 95 , 96 ] .

sents.en: Second, evaluation needs to include cost and convergence, not only final coverage: the number of compile/simulation attempts, failed repairs, prompts, and tool calls becomes part of the method’s practicality.
sents.zh: 其次，评估需要包括成本和收敛性，而不仅仅是最终的覆盖率：编译/仿真尝试的次数、修复失败的情况、提示词和工具调用次数都将成为该方法实用性的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: A serious testbench-generation benchmark must evaluate several layers of correctness. At minimum, the generated artifact should compile, elaborate, and simulate. However, these checks are only gateway metrics. A stronger benchmark asks whether the testbench drives meaningful scenarios, reaches structural and functional coverage targets, detects injected bugs or RTL mutants, and avoids false passes. AutoBench and CorrectBench make this explicit through multi-stage evaluation and mutant-based checks [ 76 , 77 ] . CVDP broadens the benchmark landscape by including hardware design and verification tasks in both non-agentic and agentic forms, revealing that tool-using verification tasks remain difficult for current models [ 101 ] . Benchmarking should also include fuzzing and directed-test baselines because classical CDG, RFUZZ, DirectFuzz, and FuzzWiz attack the same coverage-closure objective with non-LLM search strategies [ 81 , 83 , 84 , 85 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一个严肃的测试平台生成基准必须评估多个正确性层面。 至少，生成的产物应能通过编译、展开和仿真。 然而，这些检查仅仅是入门级指标。 更严格的基准会考察测试平台是否能驱动有意义的场景、达到结构和功能覆盖目标、检测注入的缺陷或 RTL 变异体，并避免误判通过。 AutoBench 和 CorrectBench 通过多阶段评估和基于变异体的检查明确体现了这一点 [ 76 , 77 ] 。 CVDP 通过将硬件设计与验证任务以非智能体和智能体两种形式纳入其中，拓展了基准的范畴，并揭示出使用工具的验证任务对当前模型而言依然具有挑战性 [ 101 ] 。 基准测试还应包含模糊测试和定向测试基线，因为经典的 CDG、RFUZZ、DirectFuzz 和 FuzzWiz 均使用非 LLM 搜索策略来攻击相同的覆盖闭合目标 [ 81 , 83 , 84 , 85 ] 。

sents.en: A serious testbench-generation benchmark must evaluate several layers of correctness.
sents.zh: 一个严肃的测试平台生成基准必须评估多个正确性层面。

sents.en: At minimum, the generated artifact should compile, elaborate, and simulate.
sents.zh: 至少，生成的产物应能通过编译、展开和仿真。

sents.en: However, these checks are only gateway metrics.
sents.zh: 然而，这些检查仅仅是入门级指标。

sents.en: A stronger benchmark asks whether the testbench drives meaningful scenarios, reaches structural and functional coverage targets, detects injected bugs or RTL mutants, and avoids false passes.
sents.zh: 更严格的基准会考察测试平台是否能驱动有意义的场景、达到结构和功能覆盖目标、检测注入的缺陷或 RTL 变异体，并避免误判通过。

sents.en: AutoBench and CorrectBench make this explicit through multi-stage evaluation and mutant-based checks [ 76 , 77 ] .
sents.zh: AutoBench 和 CorrectBench 通过多阶段评估和基于变异体的检查明确体现了这一点 [ 76 , 77 ] 。

sents.en: CVDP broadens the benchmark landscape by including hardware design and verification tasks in both non-agentic and agentic forms, revealing that tool-using verification tasks remain difficult for current models [ 101 ] .
sents.zh: CVDP 通过将硬件设计与验证任务以非智能体和智能体两种形式纳入其中，拓展了基准的范畴，并揭示出使用工具的验证任务对当前模型而言依然具有挑战性 [ 101 ] 。

sents.en: Benchmarking should also include fuzzing and directed-test baselines because classical CDG, RFUZZ, DirectFuzz, and FuzzWiz attack the same coverage-closure objective with non-LLM search strategies [ 81 , 83 , 84 , 85 ] .
sents.zh: 基准测试还应包含模糊测试和定向测试基线，因为经典的 CDG、RFUZZ、DirectFuzz 和 FuzzWiz 均使用非 LLM 搜索策略来攻击相同的覆盖闭合目标 [ 81 , 83 , 84 , 85 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The most useful metrics for this subfield include:
paragraphs.zh: 该子领域中最有用的指标包括：

paragraphs.en: Build success : parsing, elaboration, simulator compatibility, and lint cleanliness;
paragraphs.zh: 构建成功：解析、详细设计、模拟器兼容性和代码整洁度；

paragraphs.en: Stimulus effectiveness : line, branch, toggle, FSM-state, FSM-transition, and user-defined functional coverage;
paragraphs.zh: 刺激有效性：线、分支、切换、FSM状态、FSM转换以及用户定义的功能覆盖；

paragraphs.en: Oracle strength : ability to reject faulty designs, RTL mutants, or injected bugs;
paragraphs.zh: Oracle 强度：拒绝有缺陷的设计、RTL 突变体或注入错误的能力；

paragraphs.en: Repair convergence : number of tool-feedback iterations, token cost, and simulator runs required;
paragraphs.zh: 修复收敛性：所需的工具反馈迭代次数、令牌成本以及模拟器运行次数；

paragraphs.en: Scalability : performance on sequential circuits, larger FSMs, bus protocols, and subsystem-level designs;
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展性：在序列电路、更大的有限状态机、总线协议和子系统级设计中的性能；

paragraphs.en: Portability : whether generated collateral works across open-source and commercial simulators.
paragraphs.zh: 可移植性：生成的担保品是否能在开源和商业模拟器之间通用。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based testbench generation has evolved from generating directed tests for small RTL modules toward self-checking testbenches, coverage-guided refinement, UVM environments, and subsystem-level verification. In parallel, workflows have progressed from one-shot generation toward iterative and agentic approaches that incorporate simulation and coverage feedback. Despite this progress, unconstrained SystemVerilog and UVM generation remains unreliable for complex sequential and protocol-intensive designs. The strongest approaches therefore combine LLM reasoning with deterministic structures such as templates, intermediate representations (IRs), domain-specific languages (DSLs), protocol libraries, and verification-tool feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的测试平台生成方法已从为小型 RTL 模块生成定向测试，逐步发展为自检查测试平台、以覆盖率为导向的优化、UVM 环境以及子系统级验证。 与此同时，工作流程也已从一次性生成，转向迭代且具备智能体特性的方法，这些方法整合了仿真和覆盖率反馈。 尽管取得了这些进展，但对于复杂的时序和协议密集型设计，不受约束的 SystemVerilog 和 UVM 生成仍然不可靠。 因此，最强大的方法将 LLM 推理与确定性结构相结合，例如模板、中间表示（IR）、领域特定语言（DSL）、协议库以及验证工具的反馈。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge is oracle quality . Effective stimuli provide limited value without trustworthy mechanisms for determining correctness. High coverage or successful execution against golden RTL does not necessarily imply strong bug-detection capability. Mutation testing, imperfect RTL variants, and controlled bug injection therefore provide important complementary evaluation [ 76 , 77 , 100 ] . Future work should place greater emphasis on generating and validating scoreboards, reference models, assertions, and other checking mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心挑战是预言机的质量。 如果没有可靠的正确性判定机制，有效的刺激提供的价值有限。 对黄金 RTL 的高覆盖率或成功执行并不必然意味着强大的缺陷检测能力。 因此，突变测试、不完整的 RTL 变体以及受控的缺陷注入提供了重要的补充性评估方法 [76, 77, 100]。 未来的工作应更加重视生成和验证计分板、参考模型、断言以及其他检查机制。

paragraphs.en: Sequential and temporal reasoning remains difficult for resets, handshakes, long-latency operations, pipelines, FSMs, and subsystem protocols. Existing approaches mitigate this challenge by decomposing behavior into scenarios, transactions, DSL operations, or targeted coverage gaps [ 86 , 22 , 78 ] . Extending such structured reasoning to longer traces and interacting protocols is important for scaling beyond small designs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于重置、握手、高延迟操作、流水线、有限状态机（FSM）和子系统协议，序列性和时序推理仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法通过将行为分解为场景、事务、领域特定语言（DSL）操作或特定的覆盖缺口来缓解这一挑战 [ 86 , 22 , 78 ] 。 将此类结构化推理扩展到更长的轨迹和相互作用的协议中，对于超越小型设计的扩展至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Industrial-scale UVM generation introduces additional challenges because useful environments must correctly connect components, obey protocol timing, implement meaningful scoreboards and coverage models, and integrate with simulator workflows. HAVEN, UVM 2 , UVMarvel, and VerifLLMBench demonstrate progress, but also indicate that UVM generation benefits substantially from templates, IRs, and reusable protocol libraries [ 92 , 93 , 78 , 79 ] . This suggests a hybrid approach in which LLMs perform high-level planning and reasoning while deterministic mechanisms generate structurally constrained verification components.
paragraphs.zh: 工业规模的 UVM 生成带来了额外的挑战，因为有效的环境必须正确连接组件、遵循协议时序、实现有意义的计分板和覆盖模型，并与模拟器工作流程集成。 HAVEN、UVM 2、UVMarvel 和 VerifLLMBench 展示了进展，但也表明 UVM 生成能从模板、中间表示（IR）和可重用的协议库中获益显著 [92, 93, 78, 79]。 这表明可以采用一种混合方法：由 LLM 执行高层规划和推理，同时由确定性机制生成具有结构约束的验证组件。

paragraphs.en: Scalability and evaluation also remain open problems. HDLBits- and VerilogEval-derived tasks provide reproducibility but are generally too small and public to establish industrial readiness and may introduce contamination concerns. CVDP and UVM-oriented benchmarks improve realism [ 101 , 92 ] , but broader evaluation is needed across hidden designs, large subsystems, mixed-language repositories, multiple simulators, and standardized bug suites. Richer datasets aligning specifications, RTL, testbenches, execution traces, coverage, and bugs would further support both evaluation and verification-aware training.
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展性和评估问题也仍然是悬而未决的挑战。 源自 HDLBits 和 VerilogEval 的任务虽然具备可重复性，但通常规模过小且过于公开，难以验证其工业适用性，并可能引发污染问题。 面向 CVDP 和 UVM 的基准测试提升了现实性 [101, 92]，但仍需对隐藏设计、大型子系统、混合语言代码库、多种仿真器以及标准化错误集进行更广泛的评估。 更丰富的数据集若能整合规格说明、RTL 代码、测试台、执行轨迹、覆盖率和错误信息，将能进一步支持评估与面向验证的训练。

sents.zh: 更丰富的数据集若能整合规格说明、RTL 代码、测试台、执行轨迹、覆盖率和错误信息，将能进一步支持评估与面向验证的训练。

paragraphs.en: Finally, execution-driven refinement can be costly . Repeated LLM and simulator interactions increase inference cost, simulator usage, and verification time. Promising directions include learning from execution traces, deterministic structural generation, targeted repair, and agentic controllers that obtain more useful feedback from fewer tool runs [ 98 , 99 , 89 , 90 , 100 ] . Evaluation should therefore report simulator runs, refinement iterations, inference cost, and human intervention in addition to functional results.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，执行驱动的优化可能代价高昂。 LLM 与模拟器的重复交互会增加推理成本、模拟器使用量和验证时间。 有前景的方向包括从执行轨迹中学习、确定性结构生成、针对性修复，以及能够从更少的工具运行中获得更有用反馈的智能体控制器 [98, 99, 89, 90, 100]。 因此，评估报告除功能结果外，还应包含模拟器运行次数、优化迭代次数、推理成本以及人工干预情况。

sents.en: Finally, execution-driven refinement can be costly .
sents.zh: 最后，执行驱动的优化可能代价高昂。

sents.en: Repeated LLM and simulator interactions increase inference cost, simulator usage, and verification time.
sents.zh: LLM 与模拟器的重复交互会增加推理成本、模拟器使用量和验证时间。

sents.en: Promising directions include learning from execution traces, deterministic structural generation, targeted repair, and agentic controllers that obtain more useful feedback from fewer tool runs [ 98 , 99 , 89 , 90 , 100 ] .

sents.en: Evaluation should therefore report simulator runs, refinement iterations, inference cost, and human intervention in addition to functional results.
sents.zh: 因此，评估报告除功能结果外，还应包含模拟器运行次数、优化迭代次数、推理成本以及人工干预情况。

paragraphs.en: Overall, existing work suggests that progress in LLM-based testbench generation depends less on unconstrained code-generation capability or model scale than on how effectively the LLM is integrated with the verification process. The field is consequently shifting from prompt-based testbench generation toward verification-aware automation , in which simulator outcomes serve as validation signals, refinement feedback, or training preferences, while deterministic structures constrain generation. Future progress will likely depend on stronger oracle generation, improved temporal and protocol reasoning, richer specification–RTL–testbench datasets, simulator-portable and contamination-resistant evaluation, and scalable workflows that combine LLM planning with deterministic verification infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有研究表明，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的测试平台生成技术的进步，与其不受约束的代码生成能力或模型规模关系不大，而更取决于 LLM 与验证流程的有效整合程度。 因此，该领域正从基于提示词的测试平台生成转向面向验证的自动化方法：其中，模拟器的输出结果可作为验证信号、优化反馈或训练偏好，同时确定性结构则对生成过程施加约束。 未来的进展可能取决于更强大的“神谕”生成能力、更出色的时序与协议推理能力、更丰富的规范–RTL–测试平台数据集、支持跨模拟器且抗污染的能力评估方法，以及能够结合 LLM 规划与确定性验证基础设施的可扩展工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Sections III and IV examined how LLMs can assist pre-silicon verification by generating assertions, stimuli, testbenches, and other verification artifacts to expose incorrect RTL behavior. Once a failure is detected, however, compiler diagnostics, simulation mismatches, assertion violations, or formal counterexamples must be translated into an actionable diagnosis and a validated correction. This motivates debugging and design repair , which closes the verification loop by identifying the fault, determining its cause, correcting the RTL, and re-verifying the design.
paragraphs.zh: 第三部分和第四部分探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）如何通过生成断言、刺激信号、测试台和其他验证工件来辅助预硅验证，从而暴露不正确的 RTL 行为。 然而，一旦检测到故障，编译器诊断信息、仿真结果的不一致、断言违规或形式化反例都必须被转化为可操作的诊断和经过验证的修正方案。 这推动了调试与设计修复流程，通过识别故障、确定其成因、修正 RTL 并重新验证设计，从而完成验证闭环。

sents.en: Sections III and IV examined how LLMs can assist pre-silicon verification by generating assertions, stimuli, testbenches, and other verification artifacts to expose incorrect RTL behavior.
sents.zh: 第三部分和第四部分探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）如何通过生成断言、刺激信号、测试台和其他验证工件来辅助预硅验证，从而暴露不正确的 RTL 行为。

sents.en: Once a failure is detected, however, compiler diagnostics, simulation mismatches, assertion violations, or formal counterexamples must be translated into an actionable diagnosis and a validated correction.
sents.zh: 然而，一旦检测到故障，编译器诊断信息、仿真结果的不一致、断言违规或形式化反例都必须被转化为可操作的诊断和经过验证的修正方案。

sents.en: This motivates debugging and design repair , which closes the verification loop by identifying the fault, determining its cause, correcting the RTL, and re-verifying the design.
sents.zh: 这推动了调试与设计修复流程，通过识别故障、确定其成因、修正 RTL 并重新验证设计，从而完成验证闭环。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 5 , RTL debugging is an iterative failure-to-repair process. Bug localization narrows an observed failure to suspicious RTL modules, blocks, expressions, signals, or assignments using the RTL and failure evidence such as waveforms, assertion reports, or formal counterexamples [ 102 , 26 , 103 ] . Root cause analysis (RCA) determines how the localized logic produces the observed deviation, while RTL repair generates a corrective modification for re-verification [ 104 ] . If the failure persists or new violations emerge, the relevant stages are repeated. These stages should not be conflated: accurate localization does not establish the root cause, a plausible diagnosis does not guarantee a correct repair, and a patch that passes the available checks may not preserve behavior outside those checks. Source-only localization further identifies suspicious RTL without an observed failure, whereas assertion repair corrects the verification property rather than the RTL implementation [ 105 , 26 , 106 ] . Manual execution of this loop remains a major verification bottleneck [ 102 ] , increasingly aggravated by design scale and integration complexity [ 104 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 如图 5 所示，RTL 调试是一个迭代式的故障修复过程。 故障定位通过 RTL 和故障证据（例如波形、断言报告或形式化反例）[102, 26, 103]，将观察到的故障范围缩小到可疑的 RTL 模块、块、表达式、信号或赋值。 根本原因分析（RCA）确定已定位的逻辑如何产生观察到的偏差，而 RTL 修复则生成修正性修改以进行重新验证 [104]。 如果故障仍然存在或出现新的违规，则需重复相关阶段。 这些阶段不应被混淆：准确的故障定位并不等同于确定了根本原因，合理的诊断也不保证修复正确，而通过现有检查的补丁可能无法在检查范围之外保持原有行为。 仅基于源代码的故障定位还能在没有观察到故障的情况下识别可疑的 RTL，而断言修复则修正验证属性而非 RTL 实现 [105, 26, 106]。 手动执行这一循环仍然是验证过程中的主要瓶颈 [102]，并且随着设计规模和集成复杂性的增加而愈发严重 [104]。

sents.en: As illustrated in Fig. 5 , RTL debugging is an iterative failure-to-repair process.
sents.zh: 如图 5 所示，RTL 调试是一个迭代式的故障修复过程。

sents.en: Bug localization narrows an observed failure to suspicious RTL modules, blocks, expressions, signals, or assignments using the RTL and failure evidence such as waveforms, assertion reports, or formal counterexamples [ 102 , 26 , 103 ] .
sents.zh: 故障定位通过 RTL 和故障证据（例如波形、断言报告或形式化反例）[102, 26, 103]，将观察到的故障范围缩小到可疑的 RTL 模块、块、表达式、信号或赋值。

sents.en: Root cause analysis (RCA) determines how the localized logic produces the observed deviation, while RTL repair generates a corrective modification for re-verification [ 104 ] .
sents.zh: 根本原因分析（RCA）确定已定位的逻辑如何产生观察到的偏差，而 RTL 修复则生成修正性修改以进行重新验证 [104]。

sents.en: If the failure persists or new violations emerge, the relevant stages are repeated.
sents.zh: 如果故障仍然存在或出现新的违规，则需重复相关阶段。

sents.en: These stages should not be conflated: accurate localization does not establish the root cause, a plausible diagnosis does not guarantee a correct repair, and a patch that passes the available checks may not preserve behavior outside those checks.
sents.zh: 这些阶段不应被混淆：准确的故障定位并不等同于确定了根本原因，合理的诊断也不保证修复正确，而通过现有检查的补丁可能无法在检查范围之外保持原有行为。

sents.en: Source-only localization further identifies suspicious RTL without an observed failure, whereas assertion repair corrects the verification property rather than the RTL implementation [ 105 , 26 , 106 ] .
sents.zh: 仅基于源代码的故障定位还能在没有观察到故障的情况下识别可疑的 RTL，而断言修复则修正验证属性而非 RTL 实现 [105, 26, 106]。

sents.en: Manual execution of this loop remains a major verification bottleneck [ 102 ] , increasingly aggravated by design scale and integration complexity [ 104 ] .
sents.zh: 手动执行这一循环仍然是验证过程中的主要瓶颈 [102]，并且随着设计规模和集成复杂性的增加而愈发严重 [104]。

paragraphs.en: RTL concurrency and hierarchy make this process particularly challenging. A defect may propagate across multiple modules and clock cycles before becoming observable, making the reported failure structurally and temporally distant from its source [ 102 , 103 ] . Repair must further relate the suspected logic to the specification and timing behavior, remove the failure, and preserve unaffected functionality. Errors in localization or diagnosis can therefore propagate to invalid or incomplete repairs and additional debugging iterations [ 104 ] .
paragraphs.zh: RTL 并发性和层次结构使这一过程尤为具有挑战性。 一个缺陷可能在变得可观测之前，通过多个模块和时钟周期传播，导致所报告的故障在结构和时间上都与其源头相距甚远 [ 102 , 103 ] 。 修复工作还必须将可疑的逻辑与规格和时序行为关联起来，消除故障，并保留未受影响的功能。 因此，定位或诊断中的错误可能导致无效或不完整的修复，以及额外的调试迭代 [ 104 ] 。

sents.en: RTL concurrency and hierarchy make this process particularly challenging.
sents.zh: RTL 并发性和层次结构使这一过程尤为具有挑战性。

sents.en: A defect may propagate across multiple modules and clock cycles before becoming observable, making the reported failure structurally and temporally distant from its source [ 102 , 103 ] .
sents.zh: 一个缺陷可能在变得可观测之前，通过多个模块和时钟周期传播，导致所报告的故障在结构和时间上都与其源头相距甚远 [ 102 , 103 ] 。

sents.en: Repair must further relate the suspected logic to the specification and timing behavior, remove the failure, and preserve unaffected functionality.
sents.zh: 修复工作还必须将可疑的逻辑与规格和时序行为关联起来，消除故障，并保留未受影响的功能。

sents.en: Errors in localization or diagnosis can therefore propagate to invalid or incomplete repairs and additional debugging iterations [ 104 ] .
sents.zh: 因此，定位或诊断中的错误可能导致无效或不完整的修复，以及额外的调试迭代 [ 104 ] 。

paragraphs.en: LLMs can support this workflow by jointly processing RTL, specifications, diagnostics, simulation traces, and formal counterexamples to assist localization, causal diagnosis, and repair [ 103 , 26 , 107 ] . Hardware-specific methods strengthen these capabilities through RAG for external design or repair knowledge [ 108 ] , RTL-specific fine-tuning [ 103 , 109 ] , explicit dependency representations [ 107 ] , and multi-agent coordination of localization and repair [ 110 , 111 ] . These techniques provide complementary mechanisms for implementing the failure-to-repair workflow.
paragraphs.zh: LLMs 可以通过联合处理 RTL、规格说明、诊断信息、仿真轨迹和形式化反例来支持这一工作流程，从而协助故障定位、因果诊断和修复 [ 103 , 26 , 107 ] 。 针对硬件的具体方法通过 RAG 获取外部设计或修复知识 [ 108 ] 、针对 RTL 的微调 [ 103 , 109 ] 、显式依赖关系表示 [ 107 ] ，以及故障定位与修复的多智能体协同 [ 110 , 111 ] 来增强这些能力。 这些技术为实施“从故障到修复”的工作流程提供了互补的机制。

sents.en: LLMs can support this workflow by jointly processing RTL, specifications, diagnostics, simulation traces, and formal counterexamples to assist localization, causal diagnosis, and repair [ 103 , 26 , 107 ] .
sents.zh: LLMs 可以通过联合处理 RTL、规格说明、诊断信息、仿真轨迹和形式化反例来支持这一工作流程，从而协助故障定位、因果诊断和修复 [ 103 , 26 , 107 ] 。

sents.en: Hardware-specific methods strengthen these capabilities through RAG for external design or repair knowledge [ 108 ] , RTL-specific fine-tuning [ 103 , 109 ] , explicit dependency representations [ 107 ] , and multi-agent coordination of localization and repair [ 110 , 111 ] .
sents.zh: 针对硬件的具体方法通过 RAG 获取外部设计或修复知识 [ 108 ] 、针对 RTL 的微调 [ 103 , 109 ] 、显式依赖关系表示 [ 107 ] ，以及故障定位与修复的多智能体协同 [ 110 , 111 ] 来增强这些能力。

sents.en: These techniques provide complementary mechanisms for implementing the failure-to-repair workflow.
sents.zh: 这些技术为实施“从故障到修复”的工作流程提供了互补的机制。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we survey 25 papers on LLM-assisted hardware debugging, encompassing bug detection and localization, RCA, RTL and assertion repair, and integrated debugging workflows. Section V-A classifies the works by their primary debugging methodology, while Section V-B compares their coverage of the debugging pipeline. Section V-C examines debugging embedded within RTL generation workflows. Section V-D concludes with open challenges and future directions. General-purpose software-repair methods without hardware evaluation are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们综述了 25 篇关于 LLM 辅助硬件调试的论文，内容涵盖错误检测与定位、根本原因分析（RCA）、RTL 和断言修复，以及集成式调试流程。 第五节 A 部分按主要调试方法对这些研究进行了分类，而第五节 B 部分则比较了它们在调试流程中的覆盖范围。 第五节 C 部分探讨了嵌入在 RTL 生成流程中的调试方法。 第五节 D 部分最后总结了当前的开放挑战与未来方向。 未经硬件评估的通用软件修复方法被排除在外。
