paragraphs.en: LLM-assisted debugging methods span multiple stages of the debugging pipeline but differ in how they acquire and use information to guide localization, diagnosis, and repair. To characterize these methodological differences, we group the reviewed works into four categories according to their principal mechanism: (1) prompting and tool-feedback-based debugging; (2) retrieval-augmented debugging; (3) model adaptation; and (4) structured and agentic reasoning. These categories capture complementary sources of knowledge and control, enabling comparison of their capabilities, requirements, and limitations beyond the pipeline stages they address. The categories are not mutually exclusive or indicative of capability. Many frameworks combine multiple mechanisms; each work is categorized by its principal contribution, with additional mechanisms identified in Tables VII and VIII .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型辅助的调试方法涵盖了调试流程的多个阶段，但在获取和使用信息以指导定位、诊断和修复的方式上存在差异。 为了描述这些方法上的差异，我们根据主要机制将所综述的研究分为四类：（1）提示与工具反馈驱动的调试；（2）检索增强型调试；（3）模型自适应；以及（4）结构化与智能体式推理。 这些类别涵盖了互补的知识与控制来源，使得我们能够超越其覆盖的调试流程阶段，对其能力、需求与局限性进行比较。 这些类别之间并非互斥，也不必然反映能力的强弱。 许多框架融合了多种机制；每项研究均根据其核心贡献进行分类，而额外采用的机制则在表 VII 和表 VIII 中列出。

paragraphs.en: This category uses prompting to guide LLMs in identifying defects or generating candidate repairs. Some methods regenerate RTL and analyze differences from the original code to locate potential defects [ 105 ] . Others incorporate compiler or simulation feedback to iteratively refine repairs [ 110 ] . These approaches primarily rely on knowledge encoded in the LLM and information provided in the prompt, without external retrieval or model parameter updates.
paragraphs.zh: 这一类方法通过提示词引导大型语言模型识别缺陷或生成候选修复方案。 一些方法会重新生成 RTL，并分析与原始代码的差异，以定位潜在缺陷 [ 105 ] 。 另一些方法则结合编译器或仿真反馈，迭代优化修复方案 [ 110 ] 。 这些方法主要依赖大型语言模型中编码的知识以及提示词提供的信息，不涉及外部检索或模型参数更新。

paragraphs.en: Prompting methods can inject task-specific knowledge without modifying model parameters. Ahmad et al. [ 112 ] investigate repair of human-introduced hardware security bugs using CWE-conditioned prompts and model/prompt sampling. Across 15 bugs, every case has at least one successful repair candidate, while GPT-4 produces 3,862 correct repairs in 7,500 attempts. For selected weaknesses, CWEAT is used for bug detection and post-repair checking. Self-HWDebug [ 113 ] instead derives reusable repair instructions from vulnerable/secure RTL pairs. Its two-shot configuration repairs all 25 test snippets spanning five CWE categories. Both approaches encode vulnerability knowledge through prompts rather than external retrieval or model adaptation. Beyond repair, prompting can support bug detection and localization. FLAG [ 105 ] prompts an LLM to regenerate RTL and uses differences from the original code, token confidence, and distance from comments as features for defect localization. Because it does not require a failing testbench, it can screen incomplete or non-compiling designs. Its line-level method detects 38 of 120 OpenTitan bugs, demonstrating how prompted RTL regeneration can provide diagnostic features for source-level screening.
paragraphs.zh: 提示方法可以在不修改模型参数的情况下注入任务特定的知识。Ahmad 等人 [ 112 ] 研究了使用 CWE 条件提示和模型/提示采样来修复由人类引入的硬件安全漏洞的方法。 在 15 个漏洞中，每个案例至少有一个成功的修复候选方案，而 GPT-4 在 7,500 次尝试中产生了 3,862 个正确的修复。 对于选定的弱点，使用 CWEAT 进行漏洞检测和修复后的检查。 Self-HWDebug [ 113 ] 则从脆弱/安全的 RTL 对中提取可重用的修复指令。 其两样本配置能够修复所有 25 个测试片段，这些片段涵盖了五个 CWE 类别。 这两种方法都通过提示而非外部检索或模型自适应来编码漏洞知识。 除了修复之外，提示方法还可以支持漏洞检测和定位。 FLAG [ 105 ] 提示一个 LLM 重新生成 RTL，并利用与原始代码的差异、词元置信度以及与注释的距离作为缺陷定位的特征。 由于它不需要失败的测试平台，因此可以筛选出不完整或无法编译的设计。 其行级方法检测到了 120 个 OpenTitan 漏洞中的 38 个，这表明通过提示实现的 RTL 再生可以为源代码级别的筛选提供诊断特征。

paragraphs.en: Tool-feedback-based methods close the loop by using compiler or simulation results to evaluate generated repairs and guide subsequent revisions. MEIC [ 110 ] employs debugging and scoring agents, together with candidate history, rollback, and self-planning, to manage iterative repair. On 178 RTLLM-derived error instances, it reports syntax and functional fix rates of 93% and 78%, respectively. UVLLM [ 114 ] further combines UVM checking with mismatch-driven data-flow slicing and test-score-based rollback. Time-aware slicing narrows the failure context presented to the LLM, while executable UVM checks guide candidate selection. Across 331 error instances from 27 RTLLM-derived modules, it reports syntax and functional fix rates of 86.99% and 71.92%, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 基于工具反馈的方法通过利用编译器或模拟结果来评估生成的修复方案并指导后续修订，从而形成闭环。 MEIC [ 110 ] 采用调试和评分智能体，并结合候选历史、回滚和自我规划，来管理迭代修复过程。 在 178 个源自 RTLLM 的错误实例中，其语法修复率和功能修复率分别为 93% 和 78%。 UVLLM [ 114 ] 进一步将 UVM 检查与由不匹配驱动的数据流切片以及基于测试分数的回滚相结合。 时间感知切片可缩小呈现给 LLM 的故障上下文范围，而可执行的 UVM 检查则能指导候选方案的选择。 在源自 27 个 RTLLM 模块的 331 个错误实例中，其语法修复率和功能修复率分别为 86.99% 和 71.92%。

sents.en: Across 331 error instances from 27 RTLLM-derived modules, it reports syntax and functional fix rates of 86.99% and 71.92%, respectively.
sents.zh: 在源自 27 个 RTLLM 模块的 331 个错误实例中，其语法修复率和功能修复率分别为 86.99% 和 71.92%。

paragraphs.en: These methods demonstrate that prompting and verification feedback can support both source-level detection and iterative RTL repair without model adaptation. Their effectiveness, however, depends strongly on the information exposed by the prompt and verification tools. Ambiguous diagnostics or weak functional feedback may not reveal the underlying cause, causing repeated generation to converge slowly or fail when the required hardware knowledge is unavailable. This limitation motivates retrieval-based methods that explicitly augment the LLM with external debugging knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法表明，提示和验证反馈无需模型适配，即可支持源级检测和迭代 RTL 修复。 然而，它们的有效性在很大程度上取决于提示和验证工具所暴露的信息。 模棱两可的诊断结果或较弱的功能反馈可能无法揭示根本原因，导致在缺乏必要硬件知识时，重复生成过程收敛缓慢甚至失败。 这一局限性推动了基于检索的方法，这些方法通过显式引入外部调试知识来增强 LLM。

sents.zh: 然而，它们的有效性在很大程度上取决于提示和验证工具所暴露的信息。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented methods supplement the LLM with external information, such as specifications, expert repair examples, documentation, or design context, at inference time. This provides task-specific knowledge without modifying model parameters and can improve both diagnosis and repair when the required information is not reliably encoded in the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强方法在推理时通过外部信息（如规格说明、专家维修示例、文档或设计背景）为大型语言模型提供补充。 这种方法无需修改模型参数即可提供特定任务的知识，并且在所需信息未可靠编码于大型语言模型中时，能够提升诊断和维修效果。

paragraphs.en: Qayyum et al. [ 115 ] use RAG to retrieve specification context for HDL bug identification and repair. Their method combines specification retrieval with expression decomposition and repairs all 25 nonconstant mutations across three OpenTitan IPs, but none of the five constant mutations. The failed constants are absent from the specifications, illustrating that retrieval effectiveness depends on the completeness of the underlying knowledge source.
paragraphs.zh: Qayyum 等人 [ 115 ] 使用 RAG 检索规格上下文，以识别和修复 HDL 错误。 他们的方法将规格检索与表达式分解相结合，并修复了三个 OpenTitan IP 中全部 25 个非常量突变，但未能修复五个常量突变中的任何一个。 失败的常量在规格中不存在，这表明检索的有效性取决于底层知识源的完整性。

sents.en: Qayyum et al.
sents.zh: Qayyum 等人

paragraphs.en: Rather than retrieving specifications, RTLFixer [ 108 ] retrieves validated expert solutions associated with compiler-error patterns and combines them with ReAct-style prompting and compiler feedback. The framework reports a 98.5% compilation-error repair rate, with ablations showing complementary contributions from retrieval, iterative feedback, and diagnostic quality. GROVE [ 116 ] further makes the retrieval corpus adaptive by organizing previously resolved cases into an evolving knowledge tree with applicability conditions. Candidate knowledge is validated on its originating cases, while budget-aware retrieval selects relevant entries for new failures. On a module-disjoint SVA-Eval split, GROVE improves Llama-3.3 pass@1 from 72.7% to 84.7% and achieves 86.9% pass@5. These results demonstrate the potential of reusable repair knowledge, although validation on an originating case does not guarantee transfer to other designs.
paragraphs.zh: RTLFixer [ 108 ] 不会直接检索规格说明，而是检索与编译器错误模式相关的已验证专家解决方案，并将其与 ReAct 风格的提示和编译器反馈相结合。 该框架报告的编译错误修复率为 98.5%，消融研究结果表明，信息检索、迭代反馈和诊断质量三者相互补充，共同促成了这一结果。 GROVE [ 116 ] 更进一步地使检索语料库具备适应性，它将先前已解决的问题组织成一棵不断演化的知识树，并附加适用性条件。 候选知识会在其原始案例上进行验证，而预算感知的检索机制则会为新出现的故障选择相关条目。 在模块独立的 SVA-Eval 数据集划分中，GROVE 将 Llama-3.3 的 pass@1 从 72.7% 提升至 84.7%，并实现了 86.9% 的 pass@5。 这些结果展示了可复用修复知识的潜力，尽管在原始案例上的验证并不能保证该知识能迁移到其他设计。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval can also select relevant design structure rather than textual repair knowledge. HDLxGraph [ 117 ] combines AST hierarchy with data-flow traversal to retrieve repository-level RTL context. Its debugging evaluation covers five mor1kx commits and uses ROUGE rather than functionally validated repair, so the results demonstrate context retrieval rather than repair correctness. ViTAD [ 118 ] instead augments signal dependencies with timing information and retrieves repair strategies conditioned on inferred causes of timing violations. Across 54 injected timing cases, ViTAD improves the fix rate from 54.38% to 71.05%, a gain of 16.67 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 检索也可以选择相关的设计结构，而非文本形式的修复知识。 HDLxGraph [ 117 ] 将 AST 层次结构与数据流遍历相结合，以检索存储库级别的 RTL 上下文。 其调试评估涵盖了五个 mor1kx 提交，并使用 ROUGE 而非功能验证过的修复方法，因此结果体现了上下文检索能力，而非修复的正确性。 相比之下，ViTAD [ 118 ] 通过增加时序信息来增强信号依赖关系，并根据推断出的时序违例原因检索相应的修复策略。 在 54 个注入的时序案例中，ViTAD 将修复率从 54.38% 提升至 71.05%，增加了 16.67 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Overall, retrieval-augmented debugging depends on the relevance and completeness of external knowledge and the ability of the LLM to apply it correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，检索增强式调试依赖于外部知识的相关性和完整性，以及大型语言模型正确应用该知识的能力。

paragraphs.en: Model adaptation encodes hardware-specific debugging knowledge in model parameters through continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, or specialized training objectives. These methods aim to improve localization and repair, but their effectiveness depends on representative training data. Public datasets pairing faulty RTL with fault locations, diagnostics, and validated repairs remain limited.
paragraphs.zh: 模型适配通过持续预训练、监督微调、偏好优化或专门的训练目标，将硬件特定的调试知识编码到模型参数中。 这些方法旨在提升故障定位和修复能力，但其有效性取决于是否具有代表性的训练数据。 包含故障 RTL 与故障位置、诊断结果及经验证的修复方案对应关系的公开数据集仍然有限。

sents.en: Model adaptation encodes hardware-specific debugging knowledge in model parameters through continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, or specialized training objectives.
sents.zh: 模型适配通过持续预训练、监督微调、偏好优化或专门的训练目标，将硬件特定的调试知识编码到模型参数中。

sents.en: These methods aim to improve localization and repair, but their effectiveness depends on representative training data.
sents.zh: 这些方法旨在提升故障定位和修复能力，但其有效性取决于是否具有代表性的训练数据。

sents.en: Public datasets pairing faulty RTL with fault locations, diagnostics, and validated repairs remain limited.
sents.zh: 包含故障 RTL 与故障位置、诊断结果及经验证的修复方案对应关系的公开数据集仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: HDLdebugger [ 103 ] addresses this data limitation by constructing a synthetic debugging corpus through reverse engineering. Controlled mutations of correct RTL are paired with compiler diagnostics and reference implementations to provide repair supervision, while code and document retrieval supplies additional context at inference time. The resulting framework reports an 81.93% execution pass rate on its test split drawn from 92,143 industrial HDL instances. LLM4SecHW [ 119 ] instead mines open-source hardware version histories for defect/fix pairs and descriptions and applies lightweight adapter-based fine-tuning. Its evaluation uses per-case ROUGE scores and qualitative examples rather than an aggregate functionally validated repair rate. These approaches illustrate two complementary sources of adaptation data: controlled synthetic defects and naturally occurring development histories.
paragraphs.zh: HDLdebugger [ 103 ] 通过逆向工程构建合成调试语料库，以应对这一数据局限性。 对正确 RTL 进行的受控突变与编译器诊断信息和参考实现相结合，以提供修复监督；同时，代码和文档检索在推理阶段提供额外上下文信息。 由此形成的框架在其测试集上报告了 81.93% 的执行通过率，该测试集源自 92,143 个工业 HDL 实例。 LLM4SecHW [ 119 ] 则从开源硬件版本历史中挖掘缺陷/修复对及其描述，并采用轻量级适配器基微调方法。 其评估采用每个案例的 ROUGE 分数和定性示例，而非汇总的功能验证修复率。 这些方法展示了两种互补的适应数据来源：受控合成的缺陷以及自然产生的开发历史。

paragraphs.en: Model adaptation can also specialize LLMs for fault localization. LiK [ 26 ] combines continual pretraining, supervised localization training, and SimPO preference optimization, achieving 93.38% localization pass@1 compared with 77.9% for GPT-4-Turbo on the same benchmark. Supplying its predicted locations to GPT-3.5 further improves downstream repair from 40.39% to 58.92%, demonstrating the value of localization as an intermediate debugging step. VeriDebug [ 120 ] instead integrates localization and repair within a shared model using contrastive representations of fault locations and bug types. It reports 67.2% top-1 localization accuracy and 64.7% top-1 repair accuracy, where repair requires an exact match to the reference corrected line. Thus, LiK and VeriDebug represent different interfaces between learned localization and repair: explicit localization for a downstream repair model versus joint localization and correction.
paragraphs.zh: 模型自适应也可以将大语言模型专门用于故障定位。 LiK [ 26 ] 结合了持续预训练、监督式定位训练和 SimPO 偏好优化，在同一基准测试中实现了 93.38% 的 pass@1 定位准确率，而 GPT-4-Turbo 仅为 77.9%。 将其预测的位置提供给 GPT-3.5，可进一步将下游修复准确率从 40.39% 提升至 58.92%，这表明定位作为中间调试步骤具有重要价值。 VeriDebug [ 120 ] 则通过利用故障位置和错误类型的对比表示，在共享模型中整合了定位和修复过程。 该模型报告了 67.2% 的 top-1 定位准确率和 64.7% 的 top-1 修复准确率，其中修复要求与参考修正行完全匹配。 因此，LiK 和 VeriDebug 代表了已学习定位与修复之间的不同接口：一种是用于下游修复模型的显式定位，另一种则是联合定位与修正。

paragraphs.en: Adaptation can further target repair generation or constrain its scope. AssertSolver [ 109 ] combines pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization over correct and incorrect responses for assertion-triggering RTL faults. It reports repair pass@1 and pass@5 of 88.54 % 88.54\% and 90.00 % 90.00\% , respectively, and generates explanations alongside candidate corrections. ARSP [ 121 ] instead trains semantic partitioning and fragment-repair models to restrict modification to a selected RTL region while retaining the specification and global code as context. On injected faults in 33 designs, it achieves 77.92 % 77.92\% pass@1 and 83.88 % 83.88\% pass@5. These methods address complementary aspects of repair: response-level supervision improves candidate generation, whereas learned partitioning constrains where modifications are applied.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应可以进一步针对修复生成过程，或限制其范围。 AssertSolver [ 109 ] 将预训练、有监督微调以及对正确和错误响应的直接偏好优化相结合，用于处理触发断言的 RTL 故障。 它报告的修复 pass@1 和 pass@5 分别为 88.54 % 88.54\% 和 90.00 % 90.00\%，并会生成候选修正方案的同时提供解释。 ARSP [ 121 ] 则通过训练语义划分和片段修复模型，将修改限制在选定的 RTL 区域内，同时保留规格说明和全局代码作为上下文。 在 33 个设计中的注入故障上，该方法实现了 77.92 % 77.92\% 的 pass@1 和 83.88 % 83.88\% 的 pass@5。 这些方法解决了修复的不同互补方面：响应层面的监督能改进候选方案生成，而通过学习获得的划分则能限制修改的应用位置。

sents.zh: 在 33 个设计中的注入故障上，该方法实现了 77.92 % 77.92\% 的 pass@1 和 83.88 % 83.88\% 的 pass@5。

sents.en: These methods address complementary aspects of repair: response-level supervision improves candidate generation, whereas learned partitioning constrains where modifications are applied.
sents.zh: 这些方法解决了修复的不同互补方面：响应层面的监督能改进候选方案生成，而通过学习获得的划分则能限制修改的应用位置。

paragraphs.en: Overall, model adaptation enables hardware-specific localization and repair knowledge to be internalized rather than repeatedly retrieved or supplied through prompts. The reviewed methods show that adaptation can improve localization, guide downstream repair, and specialize models for particular defect classes, while synthetic data, repository histories, and preference signals provide different forms of supervision. However, performance depends strongly on the quality and representativeness of the training data, and metrics such as exact patch match or textual similarity do not necessarily establish functional correctness. Moreover, parameter adaptation alone does not resolve failures whose causes span large RTL hierarchies, multiple clock cycles, or long verification traces. These limitations motivate the structured representations, explicit search, and agent coordination examined in the next category.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，模型适应使硬件特定的定位和修复知识能够被内化，而无需通过提示反复检索或提供。 所审查的方法表明，适应可以改进定位、指导下游修复，并使模型针对特定缺陷类别进行专门优化；同时，合成数据、仓库历史和偏好信号提供了不同形式的监督。 然而，性能在很大程度上取决于训练数据的质量和代表性，而诸如精确补丁匹配或文本相似性等指标并不一定能证明功能正确性。 此外，仅靠参数适应无法解决那些原因跨越大型 RTL 层次结构、多个时钟周期或长验证轨迹的故障。 这些局限性促使我们研究下一类别中探讨的结构化表示、显式搜索和智能体协调方法。

paragraphs.en: Prompting, retrieval, and model adaptation improve the knowledge available to an LLM, but complex RTL failures may still require reasoning across multiple signals, modules, clock cycles, and candidate repairs. Structured and agentic methods address this challenge by explicitly organizing failure evidence, intermediate hypotheses, repair search, or tool interactions. This category therefore includes graph-based reasoning, structured search, and agent coordination, with classification determined by the principal methodological contribution rather than the use of multiple agents alone.
paragraphs.zh: 提示工程、信息检索和模型自适应能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）可用的知识，但复杂的 RTL 故障可能仍然需要跨越多个信号、模块、时钟周期和候选修复方案进行推理。 结构化和智能体导向的方法通过明确组织故障证据、中间假设、修复搜索或工具交互来应对这一挑战。 因此，这一类别包括基于图的推理、结构化搜索和智能体协调，其分类依据是主要的方法论贡献，而非单纯使用多个智能体。

paragraphs.en: FVDebug [ 107 ] structures formal counterexamples as a directed acyclic graph that captures signal dependencies across timesteps. A Graph Scanner uses batched LLM inference with paired for-and-against prompting to identify suspicious nodes, after which a reasoning agent develops causal hypotheses and generates patches. On 38 38 SVA-Eval-Human cases, FVDebug reports a Quality@Best score of 0.956 0.956 under an LLM judge and repair pass@1/pass@5 of 71.1 % 71.1\% / 86.8 % 86.8\% . Its additional CVA6 and proprietary industrial examples primarily demonstrate RCA on larger designs and should not be interpreted as achieving the same repair rates. VeriPilot [ 122 ] instead aligns RTL variables with internal variables of a supplied golden model and traces control- and data-flow dependencies to guide iterative repair. On adapted CVDP tasks, this approach improves GPT-4o repair success from 54.3 % 54.3\% to 85.71 % 85.71\% , demonstrating the value of explicit reference alignment while requiring an executable golden model.
paragraphs.zh: FVDebug [ 107 ] 将形式化反例构建为有向无环图，以捕捉不同时间步之间的信号依赖关系。 图扫描器通过批量 LLM 推理与成对的“支持-反对”提示相结合，识别可疑节点；随后由推理智能体提出因果假设并生成修复方案。 在 38 个 SVA-Eval-Human 案例中，FVDebug 在 LLM 裁判下的 Quality@Best 得分为 0.956，修复 pass@1/pass@5 分别为 71.1% / 86.8%。 其额外的 CVA6 和专有工业用例主要展示了更大规模设计中的根本原因分析能力，不应被解读为达到了相同的修复率。 VeriPilot [ 122 ] 则将 RTL 变量与提供的黄金模型内部变量进行对齐，并追踪控制流和数据流依赖关系以指导迭代修复。 在适配后的 CVDP 任务中，该方法将 GPT-4o 的修复成功率从 54.3% 提升至 85.71%，体现了显式参考对齐的价值，但也需要可执行的黄金模型支持。

paragraphs.en: VeriTrace [ 123 ] introduces Agentic Temporal Exploration , in which an Inspector agent iteratively selects internal signals and time windows for hypothesis-driven waveform analysis before a separate RTL Debugger performs targeted repair. The Inspector reasons over the specification, RTL, and waveform evidence without direct access to the testbench, while candidate repairs are re-simulated against the supplied golden testbench and retained when they reduce mismatches. On VerilogEval-V2, VeriTrace achieves 100 % 100\% with Claude Sonnet 4.5, with notable gains on sequential FSM tasks. However, repair acceptance is determined by the supplied testbench, so passing establishes consistency with the exercised behaviors rather than independent conformance to the complete specification; behaviors, corner cases, or temporal conditions omitted by the testbench remain unverified.
paragraphs.zh: VeriTrace [ 123 ] 引入了智能体时序探索方法，其中检查器智能体迭代选择内部信号和时间窗口，以进行假设驱动的波形分析，随后由独立的 RTL 调试器执行针对性修复。 检查器基于规范、RTL 和波形证据进行推理，而无需直接访问测试平台；同时，候选修复方案会在提供的黄金测试平台上重新模拟，并在减少不匹配时予以保留。 在 VerilogEval-V2 上，VeriTrace 使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 实现了 100% 的准确率，尤其在顺序有限状态机任务中表现显著提升。 然而，修复方案是否被接受取决于提供的测试平台，因此通过测试仅能证明其与所执行行为的一致性，而非完全符合完整规范；测试平台未涵盖的行为、边界情况或时序条件则仍处于未验证状态。

paragraphs.en: Structured reasoning can also organize the search over candidate repairs. R3A [ 111 ] separates multi-agent fault localization from patch exploration, using ranked candidate locations to initialize a stochastic tree-of-thoughts search. A heuristic balances exploration and exploitation under a fixed time budget, enabling R3A to solve 29 29 of 32 32 RTL-Repair cases, with mean pass@1 and pass@5 of 75.0 % 75.0\% and 86.7 % 86.7\% , respectively. Clover [ 124 ] extends this approach by dispatching repair tasks between LLM-based editing and SMT-based repair within a dialogue-state tree. It solves 31 31 of 32 32 RTL-Repair cases and achieves 87.5 % 87.5\% mean pass@1, compared with 29 of 32 cases and 75.0 % 75.0\% for R3A . These results suggest the potential of combining generative search with constrained symbolic repair, although the cross-study comparison does not isolate the contribution of SMT reasoning and both methods depend on the adequacy of the waveform checks.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化推理还可以组织对候选修复方案的搜索。 R3A [ 111 ] 将多智能体故障定位与补丁探索分离，利用排序后的候选位置来初始化一个随机树状思维搜索。 一种启发式方法在固定时间预算下平衡探索与利用，使 R3A 能够解决 32 个 RTL-Repair 案例中的 29 个，其 pass@1 和 pass@5 的平均值分别为 75.0 % 和 86.7 %。 Clover [ 124 ] 通过在一个对话状态树内分配基于 LLM 的编辑和基于 SMT 的修复任务，扩展了这一方法。 它解决了 32 个 RTL-Repair 案例中的 31 个，并实现了 87.5 % 的平均 pass@1，而 R3A 仅解决了其中的 29 个，平均 pass@1 为 75.0 %。 这些结果表明，结合生成式搜索与受约束的符号化修复具有潜力，尽管跨研究比较未能明确区分 SMT 推理的贡献，且两种方法都依赖于波形检查的充分性。

paragraphs.en: Agentic workflows can also target debugging outputs other than RTL repair. MARVEL [ 125 ] coordinates a security-policy supervisor with tool-specialized executors to identify SoC vulnerabilities rather than generate patches. Its 51 reported findings comprise 19 vulnerabilities, 14 warnings, and 18 hallucinated findings, highlighting both the coverage and false-positive challenges of agentic security analysis. AssertFix [ 106 ] targets assertion repair by retrieving relevant RTL and distinguishing timing from logic errors before correction. It achieves formal assertion-fix rates of 73.7 % − − 83.8 % 73.7\%--83.8\% across four designs, but assumes golden RTL and therefore addresses a different repair target from faulty-RTL correction.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体工作流也可以针对除 RTL 修复之外的调试输出。 MARVEL [ 125 ] 协调一个安全策略监督器与工具专用执行器，以识别 SoC 漏洞，而非生成补丁。 其报告的 51 项发现包括 19 个漏洞、14 个警告和 18 个误判发现，凸显了智能体安全分析在覆盖范围和误报方面的挑战。 AssertFix [ 106 ] 通过检索相关 RTL 并在校正前区分时序错误与逻辑错误，来实现断言修复。 它在四个设计中实现了 73.7% − − 83.8% 73.7\%--83.8\% 的正式断言修复率，但假设存在标准 RTL，因此其修复目标不同于故障 RTL 的校正。

paragraphs.en: LintLLM [ 126 ] illustrates structured diagnostic reasoning without an explicitly established multi-agent architecture. Its Logic-Tree prompt decomposes diagnosis into ordered steps, while a Defect Tracker tentatively fixes detected defects and reruns LLM-based detection to identify primary defects. Because this feedback comes from repeated LLM detection rather than independent EDA-tool validation, the resulting diagnoses still require external confirmation. Across 90 designs spanning 11 defect categories and three difficulty levels, it reports an 83.33 % 83.33\% correct rate and a 12.22 % 12.22\% false-positive rate.
paragraphs.zh: LintLLM [ 126 ] 展示了结构化诊断推理，但并未明确建立多智能体架构。 其逻辑树提示将诊断分解为有序步骤，而缺陷跟踪器则临时修复检测到的缺陷，并重新运行基于大语言模型的检测以识别主要缺陷。 由于这种反馈来自重复的大语言模型检测，而非独立的电子设计自动化工具验证，因此得出的诊断结果仍需外部确认。 在涵盖 11 类缺陷和三种难度级别的 90 个设计中，其正确率报告为 83.33 % 83.33\%，假阳性率为 12.22 % 12.22\%。

paragraphs.en: Overall, structured and agentic methods complement the knowledge-oriented mechanisms of the preceding categories by explicitly controlling how debugging evidence is represented, analyzed, and searched. Dependency graphs can expose spatial and temporal fault propagation, structured search can explore alternative repairs, and specialized agents or symbolic tools can decompose and constrain complex debugging tasks. These mechanisms are particularly useful when failures cannot be resolved from a single prompt or local code context, but their effectiveness remains bounded by the quality of the available verification evidence, reference models, and tool feedback. In practice, the four categories are complementary rather than exclusive: hybrid frameworks increasingly combine prompting, retrieval, model adaptation, structured reasoning, and verification tools to address different information and control requirements throughout the debugging process.

sents.zh: 接下来，我们将在图 5 中通过比较所研究工作在调试流程各阶段的覆盖范围来展开分析，重点关注缺陷定位、根本原因分析、修复以及集成式重新验证。

sents.en: Tables VII and VIII summarize these capabilities and the corresponding evaluation evidence.
sents.zh: 表 VII 和表 VIII 总结了这些能力以及相应的评估证据。

paragraphs.en: Bug localization. Localization methods differ in both the granularity of their outputs and how directly those outputs identify faulty RTL. LiK [ 26 ] predicts fault locations that guide downstream correction, while VeriDebug [ 120 ] jointly learns localization and repair. In contrast, ARSP [ 121 ] identifies a candidate repair region, and HDLxGraph [ 117 ] retrieves repository context relevant to diagnosis. These outputs serve related purposes but provide different levels of localization evidence. Notably, LiK shows that its predicted locations improve downstream GPT-3.5 repair from 40.39% to 58.92%, demonstrating practical value beyond localization accuracy. By comparison, candidate-region extraction or context retrieval alone does not establish line-level localization accuracy or improved repair. Localization should therefore be evaluated by both the specificity of the identified region and its demonstrated contribution to subsequent debugging.
paragraphs.zh: 错误定位。 不同定位方法在输出结果的精细程度以及这些结果直接识别故障 RTL 的方式上存在差异。 LiK [ 26 ] 预测故障位置以指导后续修正，而 VeriDebug [ 120 ] 则联合学习定位与修复。 相比之下，ARSP [ 121 ] 会识别一个候选修复区域，而 HDLxGraph [ 117 ] 则会检索与诊断相关的代码库上下文信息。 这些输出结果服务于相关目的，但提供的定位证据层次不同。 值得注意的是，LiK 的研究表明，其预测的位置将下游 GPT-3.5 的修复成功率从 40.39% 提升至 58.92%，证明了其价值不仅限于定位准确性。 相比之下，仅通过候选区域提取或上下文检索本身，既无法实现行级定位的准确性，也无法提升修复效果。 因此，定位方法应通过所识别区域的特异性及其对后续调试的实际贡献度两方面进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Root cause analysis. RCA goes beyond localization by explaining how the suspected RTL produces the observed failure. Its evaluation should therefore distinguish a causally supported diagnosis from reasoning generated only as an intermediate step toward repair. FVDebug [ 107 ] separately evaluates generated causal hypotheses and checked repair outcomes, reporting a Quality@Best score of 0.956 for RCA in addition to its repair results. AssertSolver [ 109 ] also generates explanations with proposed corrections, but explanation generation alone does not establish causal accuracy. Similarly, a successful patch validates the correction only under the supplied checks and does not necessarily validate every step of its accompanying explanation. Evaluation scale must also be associated with the pipeline stage: FVDebug ’s larger CVA6 and industrial demonstrations establish RCA capability at that scale, but not equivalent automated repair performance. RCA evaluation should therefore report whether causal hypotheses are independently assessed and distinguish such evidence from intermediate reasoning used to guide repair.
paragraphs.zh: 根本原因分析。 RCA 不仅限于定位问题，还通过解释可疑的 RTL 如何导致观察到的故障来实现这一点。 因此，其评估应能区分具有因果支持的诊断与仅为修复过程中的中间步骤而生成的推理。 FVDebug [ 107 ] 会分别评估生成的因果假设和已验证的修复结果，并在报告修复结果的同时，给出 RCA 的 Quality@Best 评分为 0.956。 AssertSolver [ 109 ] 也会生成包含建议修正的解释，但仅凭解释的生成过程无法确立因果关系的准确性。 同样地，一个成功的补丁仅在所提供的检查条件下验证了修正的有效性，并不一定验证了其附带解释中的每一步。 评估尺度还必须与流程阶段相关联：FVDebug 在更大规模的 CVA6 和工业演示中证明了其 RCA 能力，但这并不意味着它具有同等水平的自动化修复性能。 因此，RCA 评估应报告因果假设是否经过独立评估，并将此类证据与用于指导修复的中间推理区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Repair and closed-loop debugging. Repair methods differ in both the artifact being corrected and the criterion used to accept a candidate. For RTL repair, RTLFixer [ 108 ] evaluates compilation success, whereas VeriDebug [ 120 ] measures exact agreement with a reference corrected line. These criteria differ from behavioral validation through simulation, assertions, or formal checking, as used by other repair frameworks [ 114 , 107 ] . AssertFix [ 106 ] further targets incorrect assertions while assuming golden RTL, and therefore addresses a different repair problem from correcting a faulty implementation. Closed-loop integration adds another dimension by automatically rechecking candidate repairs and using the resulting feedback for further correction. For example, UVLLM [ 114 ] combines candidate generation with UVM-based rechecking to support iterative repair. Such re-verification strengthens the debugging loop but establishes correctness only with respect to the checks exercised by the workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 修复与闭环调试。 修复方法在需要修正的实体以及用于接受候选方案的标准方面均存在差异。 对于 RTL 修复，RTLFixer [ 108 ] 评估编译是否成功，而 VeriDebug [ 120 ] 则衡量其与参考修正行的完全一致性。 这些标准不同于其他修复框架 [ 114 , 107 ] 所采用的通过仿真、断言或形式化检查进行的行为验证。 AssertFix [ 106 ] 更进一步针对错误的断言，同时假设 RTL 是正确的，因此它解决的问题与修正有缺陷的实现不同。 闭环集成引入了另一个维度：自动重新检查候选修复方案，并利用由此产生的反馈进行进一步修正。 例如，UVLLM [ 114 ] 将候选方案生成与基于 UVM 的重新检查相结合，以支持迭代修复。 这种重新验证增强了调试循环，但仅能针对工作流程所执行的检查来确立正确性。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the reviewed methods provide increasingly broad coverage of the debugging pipeline, ranging from source-level localization to integrated localization, diagnosis, repair, and re-verification. However, pipeline coverage alone does not determine debugging capability or correctness. Localization outputs vary in granularity, RCA requires evidence that generated explanations reflect the observed failure, and repair results depend strongly on the acceptance criterion and behavioral oracle. Accordingly, comparisons should distinguish which pipeline stages are automated from what evidence validates the output of each stage . This distinction is particularly important for closed-loop workflows, where repeated tool feedback can improve repair success without guaranteeing correctness beyond the supplied verification checks.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，所审查的方法为调试流程提供了日益广泛的覆盖范围，从源代码级别的定位到集成的定位、诊断、修复和重新验证。 然而，仅靠流程覆盖本身并不能决定调试能力或正确性。 定位结果的粒度各不相同，根本原因分析需要证据来证明生成的解释能够反映观察到的故障，而修复结果则高度依赖于接受标准和行为预言机。 因此，比较时应区分哪些流程阶段是自动化的，以及哪些证据验证了每个阶段的输出。 这种区分对于闭环工作流程尤为重要，因为重复的工具反馈可以在不超出所提供的验证检查的情况下提高修复成功率，但无法保证正确性。

paragraphs.en: The preceding subsections consider debugging primarily as the diagnosis and repair of faulty RTL. Debugging also serves as an integral component of LLM-based RTL generation, where generated candidates are iteratively corrected before being accepted. In this setting, correction occurs at two levels: compilation errors can be addressed using compiler diagnostics, whereas functional errors require behavioral feedback from a testbench or reference model.
paragraphs.zh: 前面的小节主要将调试视为对有缺陷的 RTL 的诊断和修复。 调试也是基于 LLM 的 RTL 生成中不可或缺的一部分，在此过程中，生成的候选方案在被接受之前会经过迭代修正。 在这种设定下，修正发生在两个层面：编译错误可以通过编译器诊断来解决，而功能错误则需要来自测试台或参考模型的行为反馈。

sents.en: The preceding subsections consider debugging primarily as the diagnosis and repair of faulty RTL.
sents.zh: 前面的小节主要将调试视为对有缺陷的 RTL 的诊断和修复。

sents.en: Debugging also serves as an integral component of LLM-based RTL generation, where generated candidates are iteratively corrected before being accepted.
sents.zh: 调试也是基于 LLM 的 RTL 生成中不可或缺的一部分，在此过程中，生成的候选方案在被接受之前会经过迭代修正。

sents.en: In this setting, correction occurs at two levels: compilation errors can be addressed using compiler diagnostics, whereas functional errors require behavioral feedback from a testbench or reference model.
sents.zh: 在这种设定下，修正发生在两个层面：编译错误可以通过编译器诊断来解决，而功能错误则需要来自测试台或参考模型的行为反馈。

paragraphs.en: RTLFixer [ 108 ] illustrates compilation-oriented correction of LLM-generated Verilog. It combines compiler feedback with retrieved expert repair guidance to iteratively revise erroneous candidates. This improves RTL executability, but compilation alone does not establish functional correctness.
paragraphs.zh: RTLFixer [ 108 ] 展示了面向编译的 LLM 生成的 Verilog 代码修正方法。 它将编译器反馈与检索到的专家修复指导相结合，以迭代方式修正错误的候选方案。 这提升了 RTL 的可执行性，但仅靠编译本身并不能确保功能正确性。

sents.en: RTLFixer [ 108 ] illustrates compilation-oriented correction of LLM-generated Verilog.
sents.zh: RTLFixer [ 108 ] 展示了面向编译的 LLM 生成的 Verilog 代码修正方法。

sents.en: It combines compiler feedback with retrieved expert repair guidance to iteratively revise erroneous candidates.
sents.zh: 它将编译器反馈与检索到的专家修复指导相结合，以迭代方式修正错误的候选方案。

sents.zh: 这提升了 RTL 的可执行性，但仅靠编译本身并不能确保功能正确性。

paragraphs.en: Functional correction requires stronger behavioral feedback. VerilogCoder [ 128 ] integrates graph-based task planning with coding and debugging agents. Its debugging agent uses simulation mismatches and AST-based waveform tracing to revise generated RTL against a supplied testbench. With GPT-4 Turbo, the complete workflow achieves a 94.2% pass rate on 156 VerilogEval-Human v2. VeriTrace [ 123 ] extends this paradigm by allowing a dedicated Inspector agent to iteratively select internal signals and temporal windows for hypothesis-driven waveform analysis before targeted RTL repair.
paragraphs.zh: 功能修正需要更强的行为反馈。 VerilogCoder [ 128 ] 将基于图的任务规划与编码和调试智能体相结合。 其调试智能体利用仿真不匹配和基于 AST 的波形追踪，根据提供的测试平台来修正生成的 RTL。 借助 GPT-4 Turbo，完整的工作流程在 156 个 VerilogEval-Human v2 测试中实现了 94.2% 的通过率。 VeriTrace [ 123 ] 通过允许一个专门的 Inspector 智能体迭代选择内部信号和时间窗口，进行假设驱动的波形分析，然后再执行针对性的 RTL 修复，从而扩展了这一范式。

paragraphs.en: AutoVeriFix [ 127 ] instead constructs its own behavioral reference from the natural-language specification. Its first stage generates a Python reference model and tests, which are refined using Python coverage feedback. The second stage generates Verilog and iteratively corrects compilation errors and behavioral mismatches against this reference. With GPT-4, AutoVeriFix achieves 77.2% pass@1 on VerilogEval-Human, 83.7% pass@1 on VerilogEval-Machine, and 83.5% pass@5 on RTLLM v2.0. These results characterize the complete generation-and-correction workflow rather than repair of a fixed set of pre-existing RTL defects.
paragraphs.zh: AutoVeriFix [ 127 ] 反而从自然语言规范中构建自己的行为参考。 其第一阶段生成一个 Python 参考模型和测试用例，并使用 Python 覆盖反馈进行优化。 第二阶段生成 Verilog，并迭代修正编译错误以及与该参考模型的行为不匹配问题。 借助 GPT-4，AutoVeriFix 在 VerilogEval-Human 上的 pass@1 达到 77.2%，在 VerilogEval-Machine 上为 83.7%，在 RTLLM v2.0 上为 83.5%（pass@5）。 这些结果体现了完整的生成与修正工作流程，而非对一组预先存在的 RTL 缺陷进行修复。

paragraphs.en: Another recent work, VeriRefine [ 129 ] , also integrates verification and debugging directly into RTL generation through a structured intermediate representation. Unlike VerilogCoder , which uses a supplied benchmark testbench to guide debugging, VeriRefine generates its verification environment from the specification, keeping both generation and correction grounded in the same source of intended behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项近期研究 VeriRefine [ 129 ] 也通过一种结构化的中间表示，将验证和调试直接整合到 RTL 生成过程中。 与 VerilogCoder 不同，后者使用提供的基准测试平台来指导调试；而 VeriRefine 则从规格说明中生成其验证环境，从而确保生成与修正都基于同一预期行为来源。

paragraphs.en: Overall, debugging turns RTL generation into an iterative process guided by verification feedback. Its reliability depends on both the coverage of the checks and the correctness of the expected behavior. Verification artifacts generated from the specification may share interpretation errors with the RTL. Evaluation should therefore report feedback access and iteration budgets and use benchmark simulation or properties withheld during repair to assess functional correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，调试使 RTL 生成成为一个由验证反馈指导的迭代过程。 其可靠性既取决于检查的覆盖范围，也取决于预期行为的正确性。 从规范中生成的验证产物可能与 RTL 共享解释错误。 因此，评估应报告反馈访问和迭代预算，并使用基准模拟或在修复期间保留的属性来评估功能正确性。

sents.zh: 总体而言，调试使 RTL 生成成为一个由验证反馈指导的迭代过程。

sents.zh: 其可靠性既取决于检查的覆盖范围，也取决于预期行为的正确性。

sents.zh: 从规范中生成的验证产物可能与 RTL 共享解释错误。

sents.en: Evaluation should therefore report feedback access and iteration budgets and use benchmark simulation or properties withheld during repair to assess functional correctness.
sents.zh: 因此，评估应报告反馈访问和迭代预算，并使用基准模拟或在修复期间保留的属性来评估功能正确性。

paragraphs.en: The reviewed methods demonstrate a progression from prompt-based correction toward retrieval, model adaptation, structured reasoning, agentic search, and verification-guided repair. However, most systems learn little from completed debugging tasks and restart subsequent tasks with the same knowledge and strategies. A promising direction is self-evolving hardware debugging , in which agents accumulate validated experience across designs and revisions and use it to improve bug localization, diagnosis, repair, and verification.
paragraphs.zh: 经过评估的方法表明，研究正从基于提示的纠正逐步转向检索、模型自适应、结构化推理、智能体搜索以及验证引导的修复。 然而，大多数系统在完成调试任务后几乎无法学到新知识，并在后续任务中继续使用相同的知识和策略重新开始。 一个有前景的方向是自我演化的硬件调试，其中智能体能够跨不同设计和修订积累经过验证的经验，并利用这些经验来改进错误定位、诊断、修复和验证。

sents.en: The reviewed methods demonstrate a progression from prompt-based correction toward retrieval, model adaptation, structured reasoning, agentic search, and verification-guided repair.
sents.zh: 经过评估的方法表明，研究正从基于提示的纠正逐步转向检索、模型自适应、结构化推理、智能体搜索以及验证引导的修复。

sents.en: However, most systems learn little from completed debugging tasks and restart subsequent tasks with the same knowledge and strategies.
sents.zh: 然而，大多数系统在完成调试任务后几乎无法学到新知识，并在后续任务中继续使用相同的知识和策略重新开始。

sents.en: A promising direction is self-evolving hardware debugging , in which agents accumulate validated experience across designs and revisions and use it to improve bug localization, diagnosis, repair, and verification.
sents.zh: 一个有前景的方向是自我演化的硬件调试，其中智能体能够跨不同设计和修订积累经过验证的经验，并利用这些经验来改进错误定位、诊断、修复和验证。

paragraphs.en: A self-evolving system should retain more than successful patches. Each debugging episode should associate the failure and repair with its fault location, causal evidence, relevant signal dependencies, specification assumptions, applicability conditions, and validation results. GROVE [ 116 ] provides an initial example of organizing validated repair knowledge for reuse, while MEIC , R3A , and Clover [ 110 , 111 , 124 ] maintain candidate states and feedback within individual debugging sessions. Extending such mechanisms across tasks could allow previous experience to guide retrieval, fault localization, repair selection, and tool invocation rather than merely provide another repair example.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自我演化的系统应当保留成功补丁之外的更多内容。 每次调试过程都应将故障与修复关联到其故障位置、因果证据、相关信号依赖关系、规格假设、适用条件以及验证结果上。 GROVE [ 116 ] 提供了一个初步的示例，展示了如何组织经过验证的修复知识以供复用，而 MEIC、R3A 和 Clover [ 110 , 111 , 124 ] 则在单个调试会话中维护候选状态和反馈信息。 若将此类机制扩展到多个任务中，则以往的经验便可用于指导检索、故障定位、修复选择与工具调用，而不仅仅是提供另一个修复示例。

sents.zh: 一个自我演化的系统应当保留成功补丁之外的更多内容。

sents.en: Extending such mechanisms across tasks could allow previous experience to guide retrieval, fault localization, repair selection, and tool invocation rather than merely provide another repair example.
sents.zh: 若将此类机制扩展到多个任务中，则以往的经验便可用于指导检索、故障定位、修复选择与工具调用，而不仅仅是提供另一个修复示例。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge is reliable transfer across designs and revisions . A repair that succeeds on one design may become invalid when interfaces, timing behavior, implementation structure, or specifications change. Persistent knowledge must therefore retain the conditions under which it was learned and be revalidated before reuse rather than treating every successful repair as universally applicable. Evaluation should correspondingly use sequences of unseen designs or design revisions and compare systems with and without accumulated experience under equivalent resource budgets. Such experiments should measure whether experience reduces localization effort and improves independently validated repair rates without increasing regressions or false positives.
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心挑战是在不同设计和修订版本之间实现可靠的迁移。 一种在一项设计中成功的修复，在接口、时序行为、实现结构或规格发生变化时可能变得无效。 因此，持久性知识必须保留其学习时的条件，并在重新使用之前再次验证，而不是将每一次成功的修复都视为普遍适用。 评估应相应地使用未见过的设计或设计修订序列，并在等效的资源预算下比较具备和缺乏累积经验的系统。 此类实验应衡量经验是否减少了局部化工作，并提高了经过独立验证的修复率，同时不增加回归问题或误报。

sents.zh: 一个核心挑战是在不同设计和修订版本之间实现可靠的迁移。

sents.zh: 此类实验应衡量经验是否减少了局部化工作，并提高了经过独立验证的修复率，同时不增加回归问题或误报。

paragraphs.en: A second challenge is evolving debugging strategies rather than only accumulating repair knowledge . The structured and agentic methods reviewed above show that debugging performance depends on decisions about which fault hypotheses to explore, which signal or temporal dependencies to trace, which context to retrieve, and when to invoke simulation, formal, or symbolic tools. Future agents could adapt these policies from previous validated outcomes, progressively learning which reasoning and tool-use strategies are effective for different failure classes. Such adaptation must be separated experimentally from gains due simply to additional retrieval, repair attempts, or computation. Runtime, token consumption, tool calls, and solver budgets should therefore accompany repair accuracy when evaluating self-evolving strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个挑战是演化调试策略，而不仅仅是积累修复知识。 上文回顾的结构化与智能体方法表明，调试性能取决于对哪些故障假设需要探索、哪些信号或时间依赖关系需要追溯、哪些上下文需要检索，以及何时调用模拟、形式化或符号工具的决策。 未来的智能体可以从先前验证的结果中调整这些策略，逐步学习哪些推理和工具使用策略对不同类型的故障有效。 在实验中，这种适应性必须与单纯因额外检索、修复尝试或计算带来的增益区分开来。 因此，在评估自我演化的策略时，应同时考虑运行时间、令牌消耗、工具调用和求解器预算等因素，而不仅仅是修复准确性。

sents.zh: 第二个挑战是演化调试策略，而不仅仅是积累修复知识。

sents.zh: 因此，在评估自我演化的策略时，应同时考虑运行时间、令牌消耗、工具调用和求解器预算等因素，而不仅仅是修复准确性。

paragraphs.en: A third challenge is maintaining independent and trustworthy verification . The preceding studies show that compiler success, exact patch matching, simulation tests, assertion checking, and formal verification provide different levels of evidence, and no single metric establishes correctness in all settings. Moreover, when the same testbench or reference model guides repair and determines acceptance, the system can overfit to the available verification environment. A self-evolving agent could amplify this problem by retaining such locally successful but incomplete repairs as future knowledge. New experience should therefore be admitted to persistent memory only after independent validation, preferably using held-out tests, properties, or formal checks that are not available during repair. The agent should also distinguish faults in the RTL from errors in assertions, reference models, specifications, or environmental assumptions rather than modifying the artifact that defines its own acceptance criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个挑战是维持独立且值得信赖的验证。 前述研究表明，编译器成功、精确的补丁匹配、仿真测试、断言检查和形式化验证提供了不同层级的证据，而没有任何单一指标能在所有情况下确立正确性。 此外，当相同的测试平台或参考模型指导修复并决定是否接受修复结果时，系统可能会过度拟合现有的验证环境。 一个自我演化的智能体可能会通过保留这类在局部成功但尚不完整的修复方案作为未来知识，从而加剧这一问题。 因此，新的经验只有在经过独立验证之后，才应被写入持久化存储；最好使用在修复过程中无法使用的预留测试、属性或形式化检查来进行验证。 智能体还应能够区分 RTL 中的故障与断言、参考模型、规范或环境假设中的错误，而不是修改定义其自身接受标准的组件。

sents.zh: 第三个挑战是维持独立且值得信赖的验证。

sents.zh: 前述研究表明，编译器成功、精确的补丁匹配、仿真测试、断言检查和形式化验证提供了不同层级的证据，而没有任何单一指标能在所有情况下确立正确性。

sents.en: Moreover, when the same testbench or reference model guides repair and determines acceptance, the system can overfit to the available verification environment.
sents.zh: 此外，当相同的测试平台或参考模型指导修复并决定是否接受修复结果时，系统可能会过度拟合现有的验证环境。

sents.en: A self-evolving agent could amplify this problem by retaining such locally successful but incomplete repairs as future knowledge.
sents.zh: 一个自我演化的智能体可能会通过保留这类在局部成功但尚不完整的修复方案作为未来知识，从而加剧这一问题。

sents.en: New experience should therefore be admitted to persistent memory only after independent validation, preferably using held-out tests, properties, or formal checks that are not available during repair.
sents.zh: 因此，新的经验只有在经过独立验证之后，才应被写入持久化存储；最好使用在修复过程中无法使用的预留测试、属性或形式化检查来进行验证。

sents.en: The agent should also distinguish faults in the RTL from errors in assertions, reference models, specifications, or environmental assumptions rather than modifying the artifact that defines its own acceptance criterion.
sents.zh: 智能体还应能够区分 RTL 中的故障与断言、参考模型、规范或环境假设中的错误，而不是修改定义其自身接受标准的组件。

paragraphs.en: Finally, scalability remains an open challenge because realistic failures can span modules, clock cycles, and long execution traces. Current approaches demonstrate the benefits of dependency graphs, slicing, retrieval, fine-tuning, and agent decomposition, but evidence for large-scale end-to-end repair remains limited. Future systems will require compact representations of spatial and temporal failure evidence, hierarchical localization and reasoning, selective retrieval, and adaptive tool invocation to control context and computational cost. Human oversight will also remain important for ambiguous specifications, high-impact repairs, and final acceptance criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，可扩展性仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战，因为真实的故障可能跨越多个模块、时钟周期和漫长的执行轨迹。 当前的方法展示了依赖图、切片、检索、微调以及智能体分解的优势，但关于大规模端到端修复的证据仍然有限。 未来的系统将需要紧凑的空间和时间故障证据表示、分层定位与推理、选择性检索以及自适应工具调用，以控制上下文和计算成本。 对于模糊的规范、高影响的修复以及最终验收标准而言，人类的监督也将持续重要。

paragraphs.en: Overall, existing work establishes that LLMs can support individual stages of hardware debugging and that combining prompting, retrieval, adaptation, structured reasoning, and verification feedback can substantially strengthen closed-loop repair. The next step is to move from isolated debugging episodes toward systems that learn from validated experience while preserving independent verification . Achieving this goal requires reliable cross-design transfer, persistent knowledge with explicit applicability conditions, adaptive yet resource-efficient debugging policies, scalable reasoning over temporal and hierarchical RTL behavior, and evaluation against verification evidence withheld from the learning and repair process. Addressing these challenges is essential for transforming LLM-based debugging from task-specific repair automation into dependable hardware debugging systems that improve across designs without accumulating incorrect or obsolete knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有研究已证实，大型语言模型（LLM）能够支持硬件调试的各个阶段，而将提示、检索、自适应、结构化推理和验证反馈相结合，可以显著增强闭环修复能力。 下一步是从孤立的调试事件转向能够从验证过的经验中学习，同时保持独立验证能力的系统。 实现这一目标需要可靠的跨设计迁移、具有明确适用条件的持久知识、既具适应性又资源高效的调试策略、对时序和分层RTL行为的可扩展推理，以及基于在训练和修复过程中未使用的验证证据进行评估。 应对这些挑战对于将基于LLM的调试从特定任务的修复自动化转变为可靠的硬件调试系统至关重要，后者能够跨不同设计持续改进，而不会积累错误或过时的知识。

paragraphs.en: Simulation-based validation remains indispensable in hardware verification because of its flexibility and scalability; however, it explores only a finite set of input sequences and execution scenarios and therefore cannot guarantee the absence of bugs. Formal verification (FV), in contrast, provides exhaustive mathematical guarantees by proving that a design satisfies specified properties over all states and inputs admitted by a formal model [ 35 , 130 ] . Despite these guarantees, practical adoption of FV is hindered by two fundamental bottlenecks. The first is the specification bottleneck, which requires engineers to translate design intent into precise properties, environmental assumptions, invariants, and verification models. The second is the computational bottleneck arising from state-space explosion and the complexity of SAT/SMT-based reasoning for large designs. Industrial FV further requires engineers to select appropriate proof engines and strategies, analyze counterexamples, diagnose root causes, and iteratively refine verification models. These challenges are compounded by incomplete or ambiguous specifications, bounded-verification limitations, vacuous properties, multi-property interactions, and solver scalability, making formal verification both labor intensive and computationally demanding.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模拟的验证因其灵活性和可扩展性，在硬件验证中仍然不可或缺；然而，它仅探索有限数量的输入序列和执行场景，因此无法保证不存在错误。 相比之下，形式化验证（FV）通过证明设计在所有状态和形式化模型所允许的所有输入下均满足指定属性，从而提供全面的数学保障 [ 35 , 130 ] 。 尽管具有这些保障，FV 的实际应用仍受到两个根本性瓶颈的阻碍。 第一个是规格瓶颈，它要求工程师将设计意图转化为精确的属性、环境假设、不变量和验证模型。 第二个是计算瓶颈，源于状态空间爆炸以及大型设计中基于 SAT/SMT 推理的复杂性。 工业级 FV 还要求工程师选择合适的证明引擎和策略，分析反例，诊断根本原因，并迭代优化验证模型。 这些挑战因规格不完整或模糊、有限验证的限制、空泛属性、多属性交互以及求解器的可扩展性问题而进一步加剧，使得形式化验证既劳动密集又计算需求高。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities to address both the specification and computational bottlenecks of formal verification. By processing natural-language specifications, RTL, assertions, source code, and verification traces, LLMs can generate candidate properties, invariants, verification models, proof strategies, and solver optimization heuristics, while also assisting with counterexample analysis and verification workflow orchestration. Rather than relying directly on LLM outputs, recent research increasingly adopts a neuro-symbolic paradigm in which LLMs perform semantic reasoning and heuristic generation, while model checkers, SAT/SMT solvers, and other formal engines validate the generated artifacts and provide corrective feedback. This separation combines the flexibility of generative models with the soundness of formal verification and has enabled applications spanning property generation, model checking, logic equivalence checking, solver optimization, and end-to-end verification workflow automation.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为应对形式化验证中的规范定义和计算瓶颈问题创造了机遇。 通过处理自然语言规范、RTL、断言、源代码和验证轨迹，LLM 能够生成候选属性、不变量、验证模型、证明策略和求解器优化启发式方法，同时还能辅助反例分析和验证工作流程的协调。 与直接依赖 LLM 输出不同，近期研究越来越多地采用神经符号主义范式：LLM 负责语义推理和启发式生成，而模型检查器、SAT/SMT 求解器及其他形式化引擎则对生成的产物进行验证并提供纠正反馈。 这种分离方式将生成模型的灵活性与形式化验证的严谨性相结合，并已催生出涵盖属性生成、模型检查、逻辑等价性检查、求解器优化以及端到端验证工作流程自动化的多种应用。

paragraphs.en: SystemVerilog assertion generation using LLMs has been treated in Section III . This section reviews the emerging landscape of LLM-driven formal verification and examines how LLMs are being integrated with formal engines to address proof construction, equivalence checking, solver optimization, and workflow automation. It also analyzes the limitations that currently constrain reliability and scalability, including hallucination, limited context and reasoning depth, data scarcity, benchmark overfitting and contamination, verification latency, and solver scalability. By organizing existing approaches according to their verification objectives, LLM roles, formal back ends, and evaluation methodologies, this review identifies common design patterns and limitations and highlights research directions toward reliable, scalable, and increasingly autonomous LLM-assisted formal verification for production-grade hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 使用大型语言模型（LLM）生成 SystemVerilog 断言已在第三节中进行了讨论。 本节回顾了由大型语言模型驱动的形式化验证领域的新发展，并探讨了如何将大型语言模型与形式化验证引擎相结合，以解决证明构建、等价性检查、求解器优化和流程自动化等问题。 本节还分析了目前制约可靠性和可扩展性的局限性，包括幻觉、上下文和推理深度有限、数据稀缺、基准测试过拟合与污染、验证延迟以及求解器的可扩展性问题。 通过按照验证目标、大型语言模型的角色、形式化验证后端以及评估方法对现有方法进行分类，本综述识别出了常见的设计模式与局限性，并指出了实现可靠、可扩展且日益自主的大型语言模型辅助形式化验证（适用于生产级硬件）的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: Beyond formal property generation, recent research has increasingly employed LLMs to assist the proof process itself. These approaches use LLMs to construct intermediate proof artifacts, guide proof search, optimize model-checking algorithms, and coordinate verification workflows, thereby moving LLMs deeper into the formal verification pipeline while retaining conventional formal engines as the source of correctness guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 除了形式化属性生成之外，近期的研究还越来越多地利用大型语言模型（LLM）来辅助证明过程本身。 这些方法利用大型语言模型（LLM）构建中间证明产物、引导证明搜索、优化模型检查算法以及协调验证工作流程，从而将大型语言模型（LLM）更深入地融入形式化验证流程，同时仍保留传统形式化引擎作为正确性保证的来源。

sents.en: These approaches use LLMs to construct intermediate proof artifacts, guide proof search, optimize model-checking algorithms, and coordinate verification workflows, thereby moving LLMs deeper into the formal verification pipeline while retaining conventional formal engines as the source of correctness guarantees.
sents.zh: 这些方法利用大型语言模型（LLM）构建中间证明产物、引导证明搜索、优化模型检查算法以及协调验证工作流程，从而将大型语言模型（LLM）更深入地融入形式化验证流程，同时仍保留传统形式化引擎作为正确性保证的来源。

paragraphs.en: One important direction is incremental and hierarchical proof generation, which decomposes large verification problems into smaller proof obligations. Qayyum et al. [ 131 ] proposed an LLM-assisted framework that partitions a design into smaller modules and generates module-level invariants and interface properties. Each generated property is independently validated using SAT/SMT-based formal verification before being composed into higher-level proofs. This decomposition reduces the reasoning burden on the LLM and improves proof scalability by avoiding direct reasoning over the complete flattened design.
paragraphs.zh: 一个重要的方向是增量式分层证明生成，该方法将大型验证问题分解为更小的证明义务。Qayyum 等人 [ 131 ] 提出了一种由 LLM 辅助的框架，该框架将设计划分为较小的模块，并生成模块级的不变量和接口属性。 每个生成的属性都通过基于 SAT/SMT 的形式化验证进行独立验证，然后再组合成更高层级的证明。 这种分解减轻了 LLM 的推理负担，并通过避免直接对完整的扁平化设计进行推理，提高了证明的可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: A closely related direction is LLM-assisted invariant synthesis, where the LLM generates candidate inductive invariants that are subsequently validated by formal engines. Hassan et al. [ 132 ] combined GPT-4-generated invariants with formal verification and mutation testing. Mutation testing provides a stronger assessment of invariant quality than syntactic validity or proof success alone because it evaluates whether generated invariants can distinguish the original design from intentionally modified implementations, thereby exposing semantically weak or vacuous properties. CIll [ 133 ] further introduced a counterexample-to-induction (CTI)-guided approach in which candidate invariants are checked using bounded model checking and inductiveness checking, and counterexamples are returned to the LLM to guide iterative refinement. Integration with IC3 and k k -induction enabled verification of multiple RISC-V processor designs. Together, these studies demonstrate the potential of closed-loop LLM–formal-engine interactions for synthesizing nontrivial proof artifacts, while also showing that effectiveness depends strongly on the quality of counterexample interpretation and the efficiency of formal feedback.

paragraphs.en: A complementary direction applies LLMs not to individual proof artifacts but to the model-checking algorithms themselves. IC3-Evolve [ 134 ] , for example, uses an LLM offline to evolve IC3/PDR heuristics through auditable code modifications. Candidate changes are accepted only when SAFE executions produce independently verifiable proof certificates and UNSAFE executions generate replayable counterexamples. The resulting optimized model checker operates without an LLM at runtime, separating heuristic discovery from trusted proof reasoning. This approach illustrates an important distinction between LLM-assisted verification, where the LLM participates in an individual verification instance, and LLM-driven verification optimization, where the LLM searches for improvements to the underlying formal engine.
paragraphs.zh: 一种互补的方向是将 LLM 应用于模型检查算法本身，而非单个证明产物。 例如，IC3-Evolve [ 134 ] 使用 LLM 离线演化 IC3/PDR 启发式方法，并通过可审计的代码修改实现。 只有当 SAFE 执行产生可独立验证的证明证书，且 UNSAFE 执行生成可重放的反例时，候选变更才会被接受。 最终优化后的模型检查器在运行时无需 LLM，从而将启发式方法的发现与可信的证明推理分离开来。 这种方法揭示了 LLM 辅助验证（LLM 参与单个验证实例）与 LLM 驱动的验证优化（LLM 搜索底层形式化引擎的改进方案）之间的一个重要区别。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has further expanded the role of LLMs from assisting individual verification tasks to orchestrating complete formal verification workflows. Saarthi [ 20 ] , for example, organizes specification analysis, verification planning, assertion generation, property proving, counterexample analysis, and coverage closure into an integrated multi-agent workflow coupled with commercial formal verification tools. Although its reported end-to-end automation rate remains approximately 40 % 40\% , the framework demonstrates a transition toward agentic formal verification in which multiple reasoning and verification activities are coordinated within a unified workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究进一步拓展了大型语言模型（LLM）的角色，使其从辅助单个验证任务转向协调完整的形式化验证工作流程。 例如，Saarthi [ 20 ] 将规范分析、验证规划、断言生成、属性证明、反例分析和覆盖闭合整合为一个集成化的多智能体工作流程，并与商业形式化验证工具相耦合。 尽管其报告的全流程自动化率仍约为 40% 40\%，但该框架展示了向智能体驱动的形式化验证的转型，即多个推理和验证活动在统一的工作流程中协同进行。

paragraphs.en: Collectively, these studies indicate an evolution from LLM-based generation of individual proof artifacts toward closed-loop proof refinement, model-checker optimization, and multi-agent verification orchestration. The current state of practice remains fundamentally neuro-symbolic: LLMs are effective as generators, heuristic search mechanisms, decomposition agents, and counterexample interpreters, whereas SAT/SMT solvers, bounded model checkers, IC3/PDR, and commercial formal engines remain responsible for establishing correctness. This division of responsibility is essential because linguistic plausibility cannot establish the soundness or completeness required for formal hardware verification.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些研究表明，相关实践正从基于大型语言模型（LLM）生成单个证明产物，逐步演变为闭环证明优化、模型检查器优化以及多智能体验证协同。 当前的实践状态本质上仍是神经符号化的：LLM 在生成、启发式搜索机制、分解智能体和反例解释方面表现有效，而 SAT/SMT 求解器、有界模型检查器、IC3/PDR 以及商用形式化验证引擎仍负责确立正确性。 这种职责划分至关重要，因为语言上的合理性无法确保形式化硬件验证所需的健全性或完备性。

paragraphs.en: Compared with LLM-assisted property generation and model checking, the use of LLMs for logic equivalence checking (LEC) remains relatively immature. LEC determines whether two hardware implementations exhibit equivalent behavior and is routinely used for RTL-to-RTL comparison, RTL-to-gate verification, and validation of synthesis and engineering-change-order (ECO) transformations. Because conventional LEC provides a proof or counterexample rather than a statistical confidence estimate, current LLM-based approaches generally use LLMs in conjunction with formal equivalence engines rather than as replacements for them. Two complementary directions have emerged: learning-based prediction of equivalence relationships and the use of formal equivalence checking as a correctness oracle for LLM-based RTL generation and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 与 LLM 辅助的生成和模型检查相比，使用 LLM 进行逻辑等价性检查（LEC）仍然相对不成熟。 LEC 用于判断两种硬件实现是否具有等价行为，并常规应用于 RTL 到 RTL 的比较、RTL 到门级电路的验证，以及对综合和工程变更单（ECO）转换的验证。 由于传统的 LEC 提供的是证明或反例，而非统计置信度估计，因此当前的基于 LLM 的方法通常将 LLM 与形式化等价性检查器结合使用，而非将其作为替代方案。 目前出现了两个互补的方向：基于学习的等价关系预测，以及将形式化等价性检查用作基于 LLM 的 RTL 生成与优化的正确性判定依据。

paragraphs.en: DeepRTL2 [ 135 ] explores RTL equivalence as a representation learning problem. It constructs equivalent and non-equivalent RTL pairs through a feedback-driven process in which GPT-4o generates functionality-preserving RTL transformations and a conventional Yosys LEC flow determines whether the resulting designs remain equivalent. The generated pairs are subsequently used to train representations for equivalence classification. DeepRTL2 reports 68.1 % 68.1\% accuracy and 72.3 % 72.3\% F1 score, outperforming the evaluated general-purpose embedding baselines. However, the learned predictor serves primarily as a filtering mechanism rather than a replacement for formal equivalence checking because statistical classification cannot provide exhaustive correctness guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: DeepRTL2 [ 135 ] 将 RTL 等价性探索视为一个表示学习问题。 它通过一个反馈驱动的过程构建等价和非等价的 RTL 对：在此过程中，GPT-4o 生成保持功能不变的 RTL 转换，而传统的 Yosys LEC 流程则判断生成的设计是否仍然等价。 随后，这些生成的配对被用于训练用于等价性分类的表示。 DeepRTL2 报告了 68.1 % 68.1\% 的准确率和 72.3 % 72.3\% 的 F1 分数，优于所评估的通用嵌入基线模型。 然而，由于统计分类无法提供全面的正确性保证，所学到的预测器主要用作过滤机制，而非正式等价检查的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: A more prevalent approach treats formal equivalence checking as a correctness oracle within LLM-driven RTL generation. FormalEval [ 136 ] uses sequential equivalence checking to compare generated RTL with a reference implementation and returns either a proof result or a counterexample. The formal result therefore provides an objective functional-correctness signal for evaluating and refining LLM-generated RTL. FormalRTL [ 137 ] extends this paradigm by coupling LLM-based planning and RTL synthesis with formal equivalence checking and software reference models as executable specifications. Generated RTL is accepted or revised according to formal feedback, transforming RTL generation from a one-shot synthesis task into an iterative generate–verify–repair process.
paragraphs.zh: 一种更普遍的方法是将形式等价性检查视为 LLM 驱动 RTL 生成中的正确性预言机。 FormalEval [ 136 ] 使用顺序等价性检查来比较生成的 RTL 与参考实现，并返回证明结果或反例。 因此，形式化结果为评估和精炼 LLM 生成的 RTL 提供了一个客观的功能正确性信号。 FormalRTL [ 137 ] 通过将基于 LLM 的规划和 RTL 综合与形式等价性检查以及作为可执行规格的软件参考模型相结合，扩展了这一范式。 根据形式化反馈接受或修改生成的 RTL，从而将 RTL 生成从一次性综合任务转变为迭代生成–验证–修复的过程。

paragraphs.en: These studies reveal a common pattern between LLM-assisted model checking and LEC: in both settings, LLMs primarily perform semantic reasoning and generate or refine verification artifacts, while formal engines provide objective feedback that guides subsequent iterations. The key distinction lies in the verification objective: model-checking approaches use LLMs to construct invariants, decompose proof obligations, interpret counterexamples, or guide proof search for properties of a design, whereas LEC approaches use LLMs to reason about correspondences between implementations and to synthesize or repair RTL under equivalence constraints. On the other hand, this common generate–formally validate–refine paradigm suggests that techniques developed for LLM-guided proof refinement, counterexample interpretation, and hierarchical decomposition could potentially be transferred to LEC, particularly for correspondence identification and equivalence-problem partitioning. It is also interesting to extend the role of LLMs toward broader proof assistance, including identification of correspondence points, abstraction and partitioning strategies, and interpretation of equivalence counterexamples.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究揭示了 LLM 辅助模型检查与 LEC 之间的一个共同模式：在这两种情境中，LLM 主要执行语义推理，并生成或优化验证产物，而形式化引擎则提供客观反馈以指导后续迭代。 关键区别在于验证目标：模型检查方法利用 LLM 构建不变量、分解证明义务、解释反例，或为设计属性引导证明搜索；而 LEC 方法则利用 LLM 推理实现之间的对应关系，并在等价性约束下合成或修复 RTL。 另一方面，这种“生成–形式化验证–优化”的通用范式表明，为 LLM 引导的证明优化、反例解释和分层分解所开发的技术，或许可以迁移到 LEC 中，尤其是在对应关系识别和等价性问题划分方面。 将 LLM 的角色扩展到更广泛的证明辅助领域也颇具意义，包括识别对应点、抽象与划分策略，以及对等价性反例的解释。

sents.en: It is also interesting to extend the role of LLMs toward broader proof assistance, including identification of correspondence points, abstraction and partitioning strategies, and interpretation of equivalence counterexamples.

paragraphs.en: Modern formal verification engines, including IC3/PDR-based model checkers, rely heavily on SAT/SMT solvers as their core reasoning engines. Their performance is therefore strongly influenced by solver heuristics and implementation choices, including branching, clause learning and deletion, preprocessing and inprocessing, restarts, and theory propagation. This dependency has motivated research on using LLMs to automate the discovery and optimization of solver heuristics and implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 现代的形式化验证引擎，包括基于 IC3/PDR 的模型检查器，都严重依赖 SAT/SMT 求解器作为其核心推理引擎。 因此，它们的性能受到求解器启发式策略和实现选择的强烈影响，包括分支、子句学习与删除、预处理与内处理、重启以及理论传播。 这种依赖关系推动了利用大语言模型（LLM）自动发现和优化求解器启发式策略及实现的研究。

paragraphs.en: Non-LLM solver specialization provides an important baseline for this research direction. Su et al. developed GipSAT [ 138 ] , a lightweight CDCL solver specialized for IC3 workloads by exploiting structural properties of IC3-generated SAT queries. GipSAT reduces unnecessary decisions, replaces the conventional VSIDS binary heap with a bucket-based data structure, and optimizes temporary-clause management, achieving an average 3.61 × 3.61\times speedup over a MiniSat-based IC3 implementation on HWMCC’20 and HWMCC’24 benchmarks. The subsequent rIC3 framework further combines SAT-level optimizations with IC3 improvements such as dynamic generalization and internal-signal-based reasoning [ 139 ] . These results establish that substantial gains can arise from tailoring both solver and model-checking strategies to verification-specific workloads and motivate LLMs as mechanisms for automating such optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 非LLM求解器的专业化为此研究方向提供了一个重要的基准。 Su等人开发了GipSAT [ 138 ]，这是一种轻量级的CDCL求解器，通过利用IC3生成的SAT查询的结构特性，专门针对IC3工作负载进行了优化。 GipSAT减少了不必要的决策，用基于桶的数据结构取代了传统的VSIDS二进制堆，并优化了临时子句的管理，在HWMCC’20和HWMCC’24基准测试中，相较于基于MiniSat的IC3实现，平均实现了3.61 × 3.61\times的速度提升。 随后的rIC3框架进一步将SAT级别的优化与IC3的改进（如动态泛化和基于内部信号的推理）相结合 [ 139 ]。 这些结果表明，通过将求解器和模型检查策略都针对验证特定的工作负载进行定制，可以获得显著的性能提升，并证明了LLM可作为自动化此类优化的机制。

paragraphs.en: Based on these observations, AutoSAT [ 140 ] and SolSearch [ 141 ] use LLMs to generate and iteratively refine CDCL solver heuristics or source-code modifications based on benchmark performance. AutoModSAT [ 142 ] further combines prompt optimization with evolutionary search to explore modular SAT solver configurations. These approaches formulate solver optimization as an empirical search loop in which the LLM proposes a modification, the resulting solver is compiled and evaluated on representative instances, and performance feedback guides subsequent iterations. The results demonstrate that LLMs can explore a broad design space of solver heuristics and implementation strategies that would otherwise require substantial manual expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些观察，AutoSAT [ 140 ] 和 SolSearch [ 141 ] 利用大语言模型（LLM）生成并迭代优化 CDCL 求解器的启发式方法或源代码修改，其依据是基准测试的性能表现。 AutoModSAT [ 142 ] 更进一步地将提示词优化与进化搜索相结合，以探索模块化的 SAT 求解器配置。 这些方法将求解器优化构建为一个经验性搜索循环：大语言模型提出修改方案，随后编译并基于代表性实例评估所得到的求解器，其性能反馈则指导后续迭代。 研究结果表明，大语言模型能够探索求解器启发式方法和实现策略的广泛设计空间，而这些探索若依赖人工完成，则需要大量专业经验。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based optimization has also been explored for SMT reasoning. LLMs can generate and refine SMT constraints or solver API code from high-level objectives, translating informal requirements into SMT-LIB formulations or APIs such as Z3 Optimize [ 143 ] . For solver optimization, however, syntactic validity is insufficient: generated formulations and solver modifications must preserve semantic correctness while improving solving efficiency and avoiding unsupported or computationally inefficient theory combinations. Consequently, the central challenge is to jointly evaluate correctness and performance rather than optimize either criterion in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的优化方法也已被用于 SMT 推理。 大型语言模型（LLM）能够根据高层目标生成并完善 SMT 约束或求解器 API 代码，将非正式需求转化为 SMT-LIB 公式或 Z3 Optimize [143] 等 API。 然而，对于求解器的优化而言，仅确保句法正确性是不够的：生成的公式和求解器修改必须保持语义正确性，同时提升求解效率，并避免使用不支持或计算效率低下的理论组合。 因此，核心挑战在于联合评估正确性与性能，而非单独优化其中任一标准。

sents.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的优化方法也已被用于 SMT 推理。

sents.en: Consequently, the central challenge is to jointly evaluate correctness and performance rather than optimize either criterion in isolation.
sents.zh: 因此，核心挑战在于联合评估正确性与性能，而非单独优化其中任一标准。

paragraphs.en: Overall, existing work have demonstrated the search capability of LLMs for SAT/SMT solver optimization, particularly when candidate generation is combined with automated compilation, correctness checking, and empirical performance evaluation. However, current results remain vulnerable to benchmark overfitting, unstable optimization trajectories, compilation and execution failures, and loss of generality when optimizations are tuned to particular workloads. Future progress therefore requires evaluation across diverse formal-verification workloads and explicit measurement of both solver performance and generalization, rather than reporting improvements on a single benchmark distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，现有研究已证明了大型语言模型（LLM）在 SAT/SMT 求解器优化方面的搜索能力，尤其是在将候选生成与自动编译、正确性检查和经验性能评估相结合时。 然而，当前结果仍然容易受到基准测试过拟合、优化轨迹不稳定、编译和执行失败以及因针对特定工作负载进行优化而导致的泛化能力丧失等问题。 因此，未来的进展需要在多样化的形式化验证工作负载上进行评估，并明确测量求解器的性能和泛化能力，而不是仅仅报告在单一基准测试分布上的改进。

sents.en: Overall, existing work have demonstrated the search capability of LLMs for SAT/SMT solver optimization, particularly when candidate generation is combined with automated compilation, correctness checking, and empirical performance evaluation.
sents.zh: 总体而言，现有研究已证明了大型语言模型（LLM）在 SAT/SMT 求解器优化方面的搜索能力，尤其是在将候选生成与自动编译、正确性检查和经验性能评估相结合时。

sents.en: Future progress therefore requires evaluation across diverse formal-verification workloads and explicit measurement of both solver performance and generalization, rather than reporting improvements on a single benchmark distribution.
sents.zh: 因此，未来的进展需要在多样化的形式化验证工作负载上进行评估，并明确测量求解器的性能和泛化能力，而不是仅仅报告在单一基准测试分布上的改进。

paragraphs.en: Across these research directions, the state of the art is moving beyond one-shot LLM generation toward closed-loop, tool-grounded, and increasingly agentic formal verification. Current systems can generate assertions and invariants, decompose verification problems, interpret counterexamples, guide proof search, optimize solver implementations, and coordinate multi-stage verification workflows. The most reliable architectures share a common pattern: the LLM performs semantic reasoning, candidate generation, heuristic exploration, or workflow coordination, while deterministic formal tools provide correctness feedback and ultimately establish the validity of the generated artifacts. Nevertheless, current systems remain far from autonomous production-grade verification, and the primary research challenge is no longer simply whether LLMs can generate useful verification artifacts, but whether they can do so reliably, efficiently, scalably, and with sufficient generalization across designs and verification tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些研究方向中，当前最先进的技术正从一次性 LLM 生成转向闭环、基于工具且日益具备智能体能力的形式化验证。 现有系统能够生成断言和不变量、分解验证问题、解释反例、引导证明搜索、优化求解器实现，并协调多阶段验证流程。 最可靠的架构遵循一个共同模式：LLM 执行语义推理、候选生成、启发式探索或流程协调，而确定性形式化工具则提供正确性反馈，并最终确立所生成产物的有效性。 然而，现有系统距离自主的工业级验证仍有很大差距，当前的主要研究挑战已不再仅仅是 LLM 能否生成有用的验证产物，而是它们能否以可靠、高效、可扩展的方式，并在不同设计与验证任务中具备足够的泛化能力来实现这一点。

sents.en: Across these research directions, the state of the art is moving beyond one-shot LLM generation toward closed-loop, tool-grounded, and increasingly agentic formal verification.
sents.zh: 在这些研究方向中，当前最先进的技术正从一次性 LLM 生成转向闭环、基于工具且日益具备智能体能力的形式化验证。

sents.en: Current systems can generate assertions and invariants, decompose verification problems, interpret counterexamples, guide proof search, optimize solver implementations, and coordinate multi-stage verification workflows.
sents.zh: 现有系统能够生成断言和不变量、分解验证问题、解释反例、引导证明搜索、优化求解器实现，并协调多阶段验证流程。

sents.en: The most reliable architectures share a common pattern: the LLM performs semantic reasoning, candidate generation, heuristic exploration, or workflow coordination, while deterministic formal tools provide correctness feedback and ultimately establish the validity of the generated artifacts.
sents.zh: 最可靠的架构遵循一个共同模式：LLM 执行语义推理、候选生成、启发式探索或流程协调，而确定性形式化工具则提供正确性反馈，并最终确立所生成产物的有效性。

sents.en: Nevertheless, current systems remain far from autonomous production-grade verification, and the primary research challenge is no longer simply whether LLMs can generate useful verification artifacts, but whether they can do so reliably, efficiently, scalably, and with sufficient generalization across designs and verification tasks.
sents.zh: 然而，现有系统距离自主的工业级验证仍有很大差距，当前的主要研究挑战已不再仅仅是 LLM 能否生成有用的验证产物，而是它们能否以可靠、高效、可扩展的方式，并在不同设计与验证任务中具备足够的泛化能力来实现这一点。

paragraphs.en: First, correctness remains fundamentally different from linguistic plausibility. LLM-generated assertions, invariants, proof strategies, or solver modifications may appear reasonable while being incomplete, over-constrained, vacuous, or semantically incorrect. Formal validation is therefore essential, but validation alone does not guarantee useful verification if the generated properties do not adequately capture design intent. Future systems should jointly address property quality and proof validity through mechanisms that detect vacuity, measure specification coverage, identify missing behaviors, and use counterexamples to refine both the generated artifact and its underlying specification.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，正确性在根本上仍与语言上的合理性截然不同。 LLM生成的断言、不变量、证明策略或求解器修改可能看似合理，但实际上却是不完整的、过度受限的、空洞的或在语义上不正确的。 因此，形式化验证至关重要；但如果生成的属性未能充分捕捉设计意图，仅靠验证本身并不能保证实现有用的验证。 未来的系统应通过检测空洞性、衡量规范覆盖范围、识别缺失行为以及利用反例来改进所生成产物及其底层规范的机制，共同解决属性质量和证明有效性的问题。

sents.en: First, correctness remains fundamentally different from linguistic plausibility.
sents.zh: 首先，正确性在根本上仍与语言上的合理性截然不同。

sents.en: LLM-generated assertions, invariants, proof strategies, or solver modifications may appear reasonable while being incomplete, over-constrained, vacuous, or semantically incorrect.
sents.zh: LLM生成的断言、不变量、证明策略或求解器修改可能看似合理，但实际上却是不完整的、过度受限的、空洞的或在语义上不正确的。

sents.en: Formal validation is therefore essential, but validation alone does not guarantee useful verification if the generated properties do not adequately capture design intent.
sents.zh: 因此，形式化验证至关重要；但如果生成的属性未能充分捕捉设计意图，仅靠验证本身并不能保证实现有用的验证。

sents.en: Future systems should jointly address property quality and proof validity through mechanisms that detect vacuity, measure specification coverage, identify missing behaviors, and use counterexamples to refine both the generated artifact and its underlying specification.
sents.zh: 未来的系统应通过检测空洞性、衡量规范覆盖范围、识别缺失行为以及利用反例来改进所生成产物及其底层规范的机制，共同解决属性质量和证明有效性的问题。

paragraphs.en: Second, scalability remains a central limitation at both the LLM and formal-engine levels. Large industrial designs exceed practical context limits and contain long-range dependencies that are difficult for LLMs to preserve across iterative interactions. At the same time, formal engines face state-space explosion and expensive SAT/SMT reasoning. Hierarchical verification, modular context management, retrieval of design-relevant information, and multi-agent decomposition are promising approaches, but their effectiveness must be evaluated against the cost of maintaining consistency across agents and abstraction boundaries. In particular, future systems should avoid merely shifting the scalability problem from the formal engine to an increasingly large LLM context.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，可扩展性仍然是大型语言模型（LLM）和形式化引擎两个层面的核心限制。 大型工业设计的规模超出了实际可用的上下文限制，并且包含长距离依赖关系，这些关系很难在迭代交互过程中被大型语言模型完整保留。 与此同时，形式化引擎也面临状态空间爆炸以及高成本的 SAT/SMT 推理问题。 分层验证、模块化上下文管理、设计相关信息检索以及多智能体分解都是颇具前景的方法，但必须评估这些方法的有效性，同时考虑在智能体和抽象边界之间维持一致性的成本。 尤其需要指出的是，未来的系统应避免仅仅将可扩展性问题从形式化引擎转移到规模不断扩大的大型语言模型上下文中。

sents.en: Second, scalability remains a central limitation at both the LLM and formal-engine levels.
sents.zh: 其次，可扩展性仍然是大型语言模型（LLM）和形式化引擎两个层面的核心限制。

sents.en: Large industrial designs exceed practical context limits and contain long-range dependencies that are difficult for LLMs to preserve across iterative interactions.
sents.zh: 大型工业设计的规模超出了实际可用的上下文限制，并且包含长距离依赖关系，这些关系很难在迭代交互过程中被大型语言模型完整保留。

sents.en: At the same time, formal engines face state-space explosion and expensive SAT/SMT reasoning.
sents.zh: 与此同时，形式化引擎也面临状态空间爆炸以及高成本的 SAT/SMT 推理问题。

sents.en: Hierarchical verification, modular context management, retrieval of design-relevant information, and multi-agent decomposition are promising approaches, but their effectiveness must be evaluated against the cost of maintaining consistency across agents and abstraction boundaries.
sents.zh: 分层验证、模块化上下文管理、设计相关信息检索以及多智能体分解都是颇具前景的方法，但必须评估这些方法的有效性，同时考虑在智能体和抽象边界之间维持一致性的成本。

sents.en: In particular, future systems should avoid merely shifting the scalability problem from the formal engine to an increasingly large LLM context.
sents.zh: 尤其需要指出的是，未来的系统应避免仅仅将可扩展性问题从形式化引擎转移到规模不断扩大的大型语言模型上下文中。

paragraphs.en: Third, the interaction between LLMs and formal tools introduces a significant latency bottleneck. Proof attempts and SAT/SMT evaluations may require minutes or hours, making naive generate–verify–repair loops prohibitively expensive. Research should therefore investigate adaptive feedback mechanisms that determine when formal evaluation is necessary, surrogate models that prioritize promising candidates, and compact representations of counterexamples, proof failures, and solver traces that preserve the information most useful for subsequent LLM reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，大语言模型与形式化工具之间的交互会引入显著的延迟瓶颈。 证明尝试和 SAT/SMT 评估可能需要数分钟甚至数小时，这使得简单的“生成–验证–修复”循环成本高昂到无法承受。 因此，研究应探索自适应反馈机制（用于判断何时需要进行形式化评估）、代理模型（用于优先选择有希望的候选方案），以及对反例、证明失败和求解器轨迹的紧凑表示（这些表示需保留对后续大语言模型推理最有用信息）。

sents.en: Third, the interaction between LLMs and formal tools introduces a significant latency bottleneck.
sents.zh: 第三，大语言模型与形式化工具之间的交互会引入显著的延迟瓶颈。

sents.en: Proof attempts and SAT/SMT evaluations may require minutes or hours, making naive generate–verify–repair loops prohibitively expensive.
sents.zh: 证明尝试和 SAT/SMT 评估可能需要数分钟甚至数小时，这使得简单的“生成–验证–修复”循环成本高昂到无法承受。

sents.en: Research should therefore investigate adaptive feedback mechanisms that determine when formal evaluation is necessary, surrogate models that prioritize promising candidates, and compact representations of counterexamples, proof failures, and solver traces that preserve the information most useful for subsequent LLM reasoning.
sents.zh: 因此，研究应探索自适应反馈机制（用于判断何时需要进行形式化评估）、代理模型（用于优先选择有希望的候选方案），以及对反例、证明失败和求解器轨迹的紧凑表示（这些表示需保留对后续大语言模型推理最有用信息）。

paragraphs.en: Fourth, generalization and evaluation remain insufficiently understood. Many existing studies rely on small benchmark suites or task-specific datasets, making it difficult to determine whether reported gains reflect genuine reasoning improvements or overfitting to particular designs, coding styles, solver configurations, or benchmark distributions. Future evaluations should include larger and more diverse hardware designs, unseen architectures, cross-benchmark testing, multiple LLMs, and controlled ablation studies that isolate the contributions of prompting, retrieval, agentic decomposition, formal feedback, and solver optimization. Evaluation should also report not only correctness and proof success, but verification time, tool-call cost, coverage, robustness across repeated runs, and the degree of human intervention required.
paragraphs.zh: 第四，泛化与评估的理解仍显不足。 许多现有研究依赖小型基准套件或特定任务的数据集，这使得难以判断所报告的进步究竟是真正的推理能力提升，还是对特定设计、编码风格、求解器配置或基准分布的过拟合。 未来的评估应涵盖更大规模且更多样化的硬件设计、未见过的架构、跨基准测试、多种大型语言模型（LLM），以及受控的消融研究，以明确提示工程、信息检索、智能体式分解、形式化反馈和求解器优化各自的贡献。 评估还应不仅报告正确性和证明成功情况，还需报告验证时间、工具调用成本、覆盖范围、重复运行中的稳健性，以及所需的人类干预程度。

paragraphs.en: Finally, a major opportunity lies in developing hardware-aware agentic systems that jointly reason about specifications, RTL structure, formal properties, proof strategies, and the underlying SAT/SMT infrastructure. Rather than treating these tasks as independent stages, future frameworks could establish feedback loops in which failures at one level inform decisions at another—for example, counterexamples could guide property refinement, failed proofs could trigger abstraction or decomposition, and solver-performance feedback could influence model-checking strategies. Such systems should remain grounded by independently checkable proof artifacts and formal correctness oracles, enabling increasing levels of automation without sacrificing the soundness guarantees that distinguish formal verification from statistical software generation.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，一个重要的机遇在于开发能够感知硬件的智能体系统，这些系统能联合推理规格说明、RTL 结构、形式属性、证明策略以及底层的 SAT/SMT 基础设施。 未来框架不应将这些任务视为独立阶段，而应建立反馈循环：某一层次的失败可以指导另一层次的决策——例如，反例可以引导属性精炼，证明失败可以触发抽象或分解，而求解器性能的反馈则可以影响模型检测策略。 此类系统应通过可独立验证的证明产物和形式正确性预言机保持根基稳固，从而实现更高程度的自动化，同时不牺牲形式验证与统计软件生成相区别的正确性保证。

paragraphs.en: This survey examined the emerging role of LLMs across hardware functional verification, including assertion generation, stimulus and testbench generation, bug localization and design repair, formal verification, equivalence checking, solver optimization, and agentic verification workflows. Across these areas, a common pattern emerges: LLMs are most effective not as replacements for established verification algorithms, but as semantic reasoning and orchestration layers that connect specifications, design artifacts, verification evidence, and deterministic EDA tools. Prompting, retrieval, model adaptation, structured representations, and agentic reasoning improve different aspects of this interaction, while simulators, formal engines, coverage tools, and SAT/SMT solvers remain essential for evaluating generated artifacts and establishing correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 这项调查研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在硬件功能验证中日益凸显的作用，包括断言生成、刺激信号与测试平台生成、错误定位与设计修复、形式化验证、等价性检查、求解器优化以及智能体驱动验证流程。 在这些领域中出现了一个共同模式：LLM 最有效的用途并非取代成熟的验证算法，而是充当语义推理与协调层，连接规格说明、设计产物、验证证据和确定性电子设计自动化（EDA）工具。 提示工程、信息检索、模型自适应、结构化表示和智能体推理能够提升这种交互的不同方面，而模拟器、形式化验证引擎、覆盖率工具和 SAT/SMT 求解器对于评估生成的产物并确立正确性仍然至关重要。

paragraphs.en: A second cross-cutting finding is the growing importance of closed-loop, verification-grounded workflows. Compilation diagnostics, simulation traces, coverage reports, counterexamples, proof outcomes, and solver statistics increasingly serve not only as acceptance signals but also as feedback for localization, refinement, search, and tool selection. This feedback-driven paradigm appears across assertion and testbench generation, RTL debugging and repair, model checking, equivalence checking, and solver optimization. However, successful interaction with a verification tool should not be confused with complete verification: an artifact may satisfy the available checks while still failing to capture behaviors or requirements that those checks do not represent. The central challenge is therefore not merely generating executable or tool-accepted artifacts, but preserving alignment between design intent and the verification evidence used to justify correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个贯穿性的发现是，基于验证的闭环工作流程的重要性日益凸显。 编译诊断信息、仿真轨迹、覆盖率报告、反例、证明结果和求解器统计数据，越来越多地不仅作为通过验证的信号，也作为定位问题、优化设计、指导搜索和选择工具的反馈依据。 这种以反馈为驱动的模式体现在断言和测试平台生成、RTL调试与修复、模型检查、等价性检查以及求解器优化等多个环节。 然而，成功与验证工具进行交互并不等同于完成了完整的验证：某个产物可能通过所有现有检查，但仍未能涵盖那些检查所无法代表的行为或需求。 因此，核心挑战并非仅仅生成可执行或被工具接受的产物，而是确保设计意图与用于证明其正确性的验证证据始终保持一致。
